function safeAddColumn(table, columnDef) {
  db._rawRun(`ALTER TABLE ${table} ADD COLUMN ${columnDef}`, () => {});
}

function createSyncTriggersForTable(table) {
  db._rawRun(`DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_insert`);
  db._rawRun(`DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_update`);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_insert
    AFTER INSERT ON ${table}
    WHEN NEW.uuid IS NULL OR NEW.uuid = '' OR NEW.updated_at IS NULL OR NEW.updated_at = ''
    BEGIN
      UPDATE ${table}
      SET
        uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
        updated_at = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.updated_at, ''), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
        origin_device = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.origin_device, ''), (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='instance_id')),
        dirty = COALESCE(${table}.dirty, 1)
      WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
    END;
  `);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_update
    AFTER UPDATE ON ${table}
    WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at AND NEW.server_rev IS OLD.server_rev
    BEGIN
      UPDATE ${table}
      SET
        updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        origin_device = COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='instance_id'), ${table}.origin_device),
        dirty = 1
      WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
    END;
  `);
}

function createStockLedgerTriggers() {
  db._rawRun('DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_insert');
  db._rawRun('DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_update');

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_insert
    AFTER INSERT ON inventory_batches
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = '_skip_stock_ledger'), '0') <> '1'
      AND COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) <> 0
    BEGIN
      UPDATE inventory_batches
      SET uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16))))
      WHERE id = NEW.id;

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      SELECT
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        ib.uuid,
        p.uuid,
        pv.uuid,
        COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0),
        'init',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      FROM inventory_batches ib
      LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = ib.product_id
      LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ib.variant_id
      WHERE ib.id = NEW.id AND ib.uuid IS NOT NULL AND ib.uuid <> '';
    END;
  `);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_update
    AFTER UPDATE OF stock ON inventory_batches
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = '_skip_stock_ledger'), '0') <> '1'
      AND ABS(COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) - COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0)) > 0.000001
    BEGIN
      UPDATE inventory_batches
      SET uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16))))
      WHERE id = NEW.id AND (uuid IS NULL OR uuid = '');

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      SELECT
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id)),
        (SELECT uuid FROM products WHERE id = NEW.product_id),
        (SELECT uuid FROM product_variants WHERE id = NEW.variant_id),
        COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0),
        'init',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      WHERE COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0) <> 0
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements sm
          WHERE sm.batch_uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id))
        );

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      VALUES (
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id)),
        (SELECT uuid FROM products WHERE id = NEW.product_id),
        (SELECT uuid FROM product_variants WHERE id = NEW.variant_id),
        COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) - COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0),
        'auto',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      );
    END;
  `);
}

function tombstoneOrphans() {
  const nowStr = new Date().toISOString();
  const childTables = [
    'inventory_batches',
    'product_barcodes',
    'product_prices',
    'product_promotions',
    'product_option_groups',
    'product_variants',
    'bom_recipes'
  ];

  for (const tbl of childTables) {
    db._rawRun(
      `UPDATE ${tbl}
       SET deleted_at = ?, updated_at = ?, dirty = 1
       WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND product_id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL)`,
      [nowStr, nowStr]
    );
  }
}

function initializeDatabase() {
  db.serialize(() => {
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA busy_timeout = 10000');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA temp_store = MEMORY');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA cache_size = -32000');

    // 1. الإعدادات، معلومات المتجر، والمستخدمين
    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
        key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value TEXT DEFAULT ''
      )
    `);

    const setStmt = db._rawPrepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)');
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(DEFAULT_SETTINGS)) {
      setStmt.run(k, String(v));
    }
    setStmt.finalize();

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shop_info (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        uuid TEXT,
        name TEXT,
        description TEXT,
        address TEXT,
        phone TEXT,
        fax TEXT,
        email TEXT,
        rc TEXT,
        nif TEXT,
        ai TEXT,
        nis TEXT,
        logo TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1

    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

    // 2. المنتجات، الباركودات، مستويات الأسعار، المتغيرات، والأرقام التسلسلية

    createStockLedgerTriggers();

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\db-write-queue.js`

```javascript
/**
 * db-write-queue.js
 * محرك طابور الكتابة الذري المتسلسل لقاعدة بيانات SQLite3
 * يمنع أخطاء SQLITE_BUSY ويدعم المعاملات المتداخلة عبر SAVEPOINT
 */

'use strict';

const WRITE_SQL_PATTERN = /^\s*(INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|REPLACE|CREATE|ALTER|DROP|PRAGMA\s+(?!table_info|foreign_key_list|index_list)|BEGIN|COMMIT|ROLLBACK|SAVEPOINT|RELEASE)/i;

class DbWriteQueue {
  constructor(db, options = {}) {
    this.db = db;
    this.maxRetries = Number(options.maxRetries ?? 6);
    this.baseRetryDelayMs = Number(options.baseRetryDelayMs ?? 35);
    this._chain = Promise.resolve();
    this._txDepth = 0;
    this._stats = {
      enqueued: 0,
      completed: 0,
      retries: 0,
      errors: 0,
      transactions: 0
    };
  }

  isWriteQuery(sql) {
    return typeof sql === 'string' && WRITE_SQL_PATTERN.test(sql);
  }

  _sleep(ms) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }

  async _runWithRetry(fn) {
    let attempt = 0;
    while (true) {
      try {
        return await fn();
      } catch (err) {
        const msg = String((err && err.message) || err || '');
        const isLocked =
          (err && (err.code === 'SQLITE_BUSY' || err.code === 'SQLITE_LOCKED')) ||
          /SQLITE_BUSY|SQLITE_LOCKED|database is locked/i.test(msg);

        if (isLocked && attempt < this.maxRetries) {
          attempt += 1;
          this._stats.retries += 1;
          const jitter = Math.floor(Math.random() * 25);
          const delay = Math.round(this.baseRetryDelayMs * Math.pow(1.6, attempt - 1)) + jitter;
          await this._sleep(delay);
          continue;
        }
        this._stats.errors += 1;
        throw err;
      }
    }
  }

  enqueue(taskFn) {
    this._stats.enqueued += 1;
    const nextPromise = this._chain.then(async () => {
      const res = await this._runWithRetry(taskFn);
      this._stats.completed += 1;
      return res;
    });
    this._chain = nextPromise.catch(() => {});
    return nextPromise;
  }

  runAsync(sql, params = []) {
    const runner = this.db._rawRun ? this.db._rawRun.bind(this.db) : this.db.run.bind(this.db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      runner(sql, params, function onRunComplete(err) {
        if (err) return reject(err);
        resolve({
          lastID: this ? this.lastID : undefined,
          changes: this ? this.changes : 0
        });
      });
    });
  }

  getAsync(sql, params = []) {
    const getter = this.db._rawGet ? this.db._rawGet.bind(this.db) : this.db.get.bind(this.db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      getter(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
    });
  }

  allAsync(sql, params = []) {
    const aller = this.db._rawAll ? this.db._rawAll.bind(this.db) : this.db.all.bind(this.db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      aller(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
    });
  }

  execAsync(sql) {
    const execer = this.db._rawExec ? this.db._rawExec.bind(this.db) : this.db.exec.bind(this.db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      execer(sql, (err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(true)));
    });
  }

  withTransaction(workFn) {
    const executeTx = async () => {
      this._stats.transactions += 1;
      const isNested = this._txDepth > 0;
      const spName = `sp_gherbi_${this._txDepth}_${Date.now()}`;
      this._txDepth += 1;

      try {
        if (isNested) {
          await this.runAsync(`SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
        } else {
          await this.runAsync('BEGIN IMMEDIATE TRANSACTION');
        }

        const txContext = {
          db: this.db,
          run: (sql, params = []) => this.runAsync(sql, params),
          get: (sql, params = []) => this.getAsync(sql, params),
          all: (sql, params = []) => this.allAsync(sql, params),
          exec: (sql) => this.execAsync(sql),
          dbRun: (sql, params = []) => this.runAsync(sql, params),
          dbGet: (sql, params = []) => this.getAsync(sql, params),
          dbAll: (sql, params = []) => this.allAsync(sql, params),
          dbExec: (sql) => this.execAsync(sql)
        };

        const output = await workFn(txContext);

        if (isNested) {
          await this.runAsync(`RELEASE SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
        } else {
          await this.runAsync('COMMIT');
        }

        return output;
      } catch (err) {
        try {
          if (isNested) {
            await this.runAsync(`ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
            await this.runAsync(`RELEASE SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
          } else {
            await this.runAsync('ROLLBACK');
          }
        } catch (_) {}
        throw err;
      } finally {
        this._txDepth = Math.max(0, this._txDepth - 1);
      }
    };

    if (this._txDepth > 0) {
      return executeTx();
    }
    return this.enqueue(executeTx);
  }

  getStats() {
    return {
      ...this._stats,
      inTransaction: this._txDepth > 0,
      activeTxDepth: this._txDepth
    };
  }
}

function attachWriteQueue(db, options = {}) {
  if (!db) throw new Error('Valid sqlite3 instance required');
  if (db._writeQueue) return db._writeQueue;

  if (!db._rawRun) db._rawRun = db.run.bind(db);
  if (!db._rawGet) db._rawGet = db.get.bind(db);
  if (!db._rawAll) db._rawAll = db.all.bind(db);
  if (!db._rawExec) db._rawExec = db.exec.bind(db);
  if (!db._rawPrepare) db._rawPrepare = db.prepare.bind(db);

  const queue = new DbWriteQueue(db, options);
  db._writeQueue = queue;
  db.db = db;

  db.enqueueWrite = (fn) => queue.enqueue(fn);
  db.withTransaction = (fn) => queue.withTransaction(fn);
  db.runAsync = (sql, params = []) => queue.runAsync(sql, params);
  db.getAsync = (sql, params = []) => queue.getAsync(sql, params);
  db.allAsync = (sql, params = []) => queue.allAsync(sql, params);
  db.execAsync = (sql) => queue.execAsync(sql);

  db.dbRun = db.runAsync;
  db.dbGet = db.getAsync;
  db.dbAll = db.allAsync;
  db.dbExec = db.execAsync;

  db.getSetting = async (key, fallback = '') => {
    const row = await queue.getAsync('SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?', [String(key)]);
    return row && row.value !== undefined && row.value !== null ? row.value : fallback;
  };

  db.allowExpired = async () => {
    const val = await db.getSetting('manufacturing_allow_expired', 'false');
    return String(val).toLowerCase() === 'true' || val === '1';
  };

  db.nextNumber = async (docType = 'invoice') => {
    const year = new Date().getFullYear();
    const defaultFormats = {
      invoice: 'FAC-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      proforma: 'PRO-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      order: 'BC-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      delivery: 'BL-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      payment_receipt: 'REC-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      avoir: 'AV-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      recap: 'FR-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      sales_summary: 'RM-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      supplier_return: 'RF-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      production: 'PRD-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      stocktake: 'INV-{YYYY}-{0000}'
    };
    const prefixFormat = defaultFormats[docType] || `${String(docType).toUpperCase()}-{YYYY}-{0000}`;

    await queue.runAsync(
      `INSERT INTO document_counters (doc_type, year, last_number, prefix_format)
       VALUES (?, ?, 1, ?)
       ON CONFLICT(doc_type, year) DO UPDATE SET last_number = last_number + 1`,
      [docType, year, prefixFormat]
    );

    const row = await queue.getAsync(
      'SELECT last_number, prefix_format FROM document_counters WHERE doc_type = ? AND year = ?',
      [docType, year]
    );
    const seq = Number((row && row.last_number) || 1);
    const fmt = (row && row.prefix_format) || prefixFormat;

    return fmt
      .replace(/\{YYYY\}/g, String(year))
      .replace(/\{YY\}/g, String(year).slice(-2))
      .replace(/\{(0+)\}/g, (_m, zeros) => String(seq).padStart(zeros.length, '0'));
  };

  db.nextDocNumber = db.nextNumber;

  return queue;
}

module.exports = {
  DbWriteQueue,
  attachWriteQueue,
  createWriteQueue: attachWriteQueue
};
```

  <style>

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\device-auth.js`

```javascript
/**
 * device-auth.js
 * وحدة توثيق الأجهزة، التوقيع الرقمي للطلبات (HMAC-SHA256)، وإصدار رموز اقتران الهاتف
 */

'use strict';

const axios = require('axios');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const os = require('os');
const licenseManager = require('./licenseManager');

async function getSetting(db, key, fallback = '') {
  if (typeof db.getSetting === 'function') return db.getSetting(key, fallback);
  const row = await db.dbGet('SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?', [String(key)]);
  return row && row.value !== undefined && row.value !== null ? row.value : fallback;
}

async function setSetting(db, key, value) {
  await db.dbRun('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)', [
    String(key),
    value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value)
  ]);
}

async function signedRequest(db, { method = 'GET', path: urlPath, data = null, params = null, timeout = 25000 }) {
  const cloudUrl = (await getSetting(db, 'cloud_url', 'https://cloud.gherbi.ai')).replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const cloudToken = await getSetting(db, 'cloud_token', '');
  const instanceId = await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', '');
  const hwid = licenseManager.getHWID();
  const licenseCode = licenseManager.getLicenseCode();
  const timestamp = String(Date.now());

  const bodyHash = data
    ? crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(data)).digest('hex')
    : '';
  const payloadToSign = `${method.toUpperCase()}:${urlPath}:${instanceId}:${hwid}:${timestamp}:${bodyHash}`;
  const signature = crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', cloudToken || licenseCode || 'GHERBI_POS_SECRET')
    .update(payloadToSign)
    .digest('hex');

  const response = await axios.request({
    method,
    url: `${cloudUrl}${urlPath}`,
    data,
    params,
    timeout,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: cloudToken ? `Bearer ${cloudToken}` : undefined,
      'X-Instance-Id': instanceId,
      'X-Device-Hwid': hwid,
      'X-License-Code': licenseCode,
      'X-Timestamp': timestamp,
      'X-Signature': signature
    }
  });

  return response.data;
}

async function joinWithCode(db, joinCode) {
  const cleanCode = String(joinCode || '').trim();
  if (!cleanCode) throw new Error('يرجى إدخال كود الربط السحابي');

  let instanceId = await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', '');
  if (!instanceId) {
    instanceId = crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    await setSetting(db, 'instance_id', instanceId);
  }

  const hwid = licenseManager.getHWID();
  const label = os.hostname() || 'Gherbi POS Terminal';

  const res = await signedRequest(db, {
    method: 'POST',
    path: '/api/devices/join-cloud',
    data: { join_code: cleanCode, instance_id: instanceId, hwid, label }
  });

  const token = (res && (res.token || res.cloud_token)) || '';
  const role = (res && res.role) || 'follower';

  await setSetting(db, 'cloud_token', token);
  await setSetting(db, 'cloud_role', role);
  await setSetting(db, 'network_scope', 'cloud');
  await setSetting(db, 'sync_mode', 'cloud');

  await db.dbRun(
    `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO device_registry (instance_id, label, hwid, is_self, is_owner, last_seen_at)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?)`,
    [instanceId, label, hwid, role === 'owner' ? 1 : 0, new Date().toISOString()]
  );

  return { ok: true, role, instanceId };
}

async function getJoinInfo(db) {
  const instanceId = await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', '');
  const cloudRole = await getSetting(db, 'cloud_role', 'owner');
  const cloudToken = await getSetting(db, 'cloud_token', '');
  const networkScope = await getSetting(db, 'network_scope', 'local');
  const devices = await db.dbAll('SELECT * FROM device_registry ORDER BY is_owner DESC, last_seen_at DESC');

  return {
    connected: Boolean(cloudToken),
    instanceId,
    role: cloudRole,
    networkScope,
    devices
  };
}

async function leaveCloud(db) {
  await setSetting(db, 'cloud_token', '');
  await setSetting(db, 'network_scope', 'local');
  await setSetting(db, 'sync_mode', 'local');
  return { ok: true };
}

async function issueMobilePairCode(db) {
  try {
    const cloudToken = await getSetting(db, 'cloud_token', '');
    if (cloudToken) {
      const res = await signedRequest(db, {
        method: 'POST',
        path: '/api/pos/pair/issue',
        data: {
          instance_id: await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', ''),
          hwid: licenseManager.getHWID()
        }
      });
      if (res && res.code) return res;
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  const localCode = String(Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000));
  return {
    ok: true,
    code: localCode,
    expiresInSeconds: 300
  };
}

async function getRelayTicket(db) {
  return await signedRequest(db, {
    method: 'POST',
    path: '/api/devices/relay-ticket',
    data: {
      instance_id: await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', ''),
      hwid: licenseManager.getHWID()
    }
  });
}

module.exports = {
  signedRequest,
  joinWithCode,
  getJoinInfo,
  leaveCloud,
  issueMobilePairCode,
  getRelayTicket,
  getLicenseCode: licenseManager.getLicenseCode
};
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\extract_code.py`

```python
import os

# ==============================
# الإعدادات
# ==============================

OUTPUT_FILE = "project_structuregherbiaiposCLEANnew1.md"
MAX_DEPTH = 3                 # أقصى عمق للشجرة
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 200 * 1024    # 200KB

IGNORE_DIRS = {
    ".git",
    ".github",
    ".idea",
    ".vscode",
    "node_modules",
    "fet-engine",
    "__pycache__",
    ".venv",
    "venv",
    "env",
    "build",
    "dist",
    "release",
    "out",
    "target",
    "bin",
    "obj",
    "coverage",
    ".next"
}

IGNORE_FILES = {
    "package-lock.json",
    "yarn.lock",
    "pnpm-lock.yaml",
    ".gitignore",
    ".DS_Store",
    "Thumbs.db"
}

IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif",
    ".svg", ".ico",
    ".pdf",
    ".zip", ".rar", ".7z",
    ".mp3", ".mp4", ".wav",
    ".exe", ".dll",
    ".pyc",
    ".log"
}

CODE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".py",
    ".js",
    ".jsx",
    ".ts",
    ".tsx",
    ".json",
    ".css",
    ".html",
    ".md",
    ".sql"
}


def language(ext):
    ext = ext.lower()

    if ext == ".py":
        return "python"

    if ext in [".js", ".jsx"]:
        return "javascript"

    if ext in [".ts", ".tsx"]:
        return "typescript"

    if ext == ".css":
        return "css"

    if ext == ".html":
        return "html"

    if ext == ".json":
        return "json"

    if ext == ".sql":
        return "sql"

    if ext == ".md":
        return "markdown"

    return "text"


def generate(directory):

    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:

        ##################################################
        # Project Tree
        ##################################################

        f.write("# Project Structure\n\n")
        f.write("```text\n")

        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):

            dirs[:] = sorted([d for d in dirs if d not in IGNORE_DIRS])

            level = os.path.relpath(root, directory).count(os.sep)

            if level > MAX_DEPTH:
                dirs.clear()
                continue

            indent = "    " * level

            folder = os.path.basename(root)

            if root == directory:
                f.write(f"{os.path.basename(directory)}/\n")
            else:
                f.write(f"{indent}├── {folder}/\n")

            sub = "    " * (level + 1)

            for file in sorted(files):

                if file in IGNORE_FILES:
                    continue

                ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1].lower()

                if ext in IGNORE_EXTENSIONS:
                    continue

                f.write(f"{sub}├── {file}\n")

        f.write("```\n\n")

        ##################################################
        # Source Code
        ##################################################

        f.write("\n---\n\n")
        f.write("# Source Code\n\n")

        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):

            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in IGNORE_DIRS]

            for file in sorted(files):

                if file in IGNORE_FILES:
                    continue

                ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1].lower()

                if ext not in CODE_EXTENSIONS:
                    continue

                path = os.path.join(root, file)

                if os.path.getsize(path) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
                    continue

                relative = os.path.relpath(path, directory)

                f.write(f"## `{relative}`\n\n")

                f.write(f"```{language(ext)}\n")

                try:
                    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as code:
                        f.write(code.read())
                except UnicodeDecodeError:
                    f.write("// Unable to read file (encoding).")
                except Exception as e:
                    f.write(f"// {e}")

                f.write("\n```\n\n---\n\n")

    print("Done!")
    print("Output:", OUTPUT_FILE)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    generate(os.getcwd())
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\fetch-fonts.js`

```javascript
/**
 * fetch-fonts.js
 * سكربت تحميل الخطوط والأيقونات المحلية آلياً لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS
 */

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const https = require('https');

const FONTS_DIR = path.join(__dirname, 'assets', 'fonts');

// التأكد من وجود المجلد
if (!fs.existsSync(FONTS_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(FONTS_DIR, { recursive: true });
}

// روابط ثابتة ومضمونة لملفات الخطوط بصيغة woff2
const fontsToDownload = [
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/cairo@5.0.8/files/cairo-arabic-400-normal.woff2', name: 'Cairo-Regular.woff2' },
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/cairo@5.0.8/files/cairo-arabic-600-normal.woff2', name: 'Cairo-SemiBold.woff2' },
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/cairo@5.0.8/files/cairo-arabic-700-normal.woff2', name: 'Cairo-Bold.woff2' },
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/cairo@5.0.8/files/cairo-arabic-900-normal.woff2', name: 'Cairo-Black.woff2' },
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/tajawal@5.0.8/files/tajawal-arabic-400-normal.woff2', name: 'Tajawal-Regular.woff2' },
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/tajawal@5.0.8/files/tajawal-arabic-700-normal.woff2', name: 'Tajawal-Bold.woff2' },
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/material-symbols@0.22.1/rounded.woff2', name: 'material-symbols-rounded.woff2' }
];

function downloadFile(url, dest) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    https.get(url, (res) => {
      if (res.statusCode === 301 || res.statusCode === 302) {
        return downloadFile(res.headers.location, dest).then(resolve).catch(reject);
      }
      if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
        return reject(new Error(`فشل التحميل: ${res.statusCode}`));
      }
      const file = fs.createWriteStream(dest);
      res.pipe(file);
      file.on('finish', () => {
        file.close();
        resolve();
      });
    }).on('error', (err) => {
      fs.unlink(dest, () => {});
      reject(err);
    });
  });
}

async function startDownload() {
  console.log('🚀 جاري تحميل الخطوط والأيقونات الرسمية...');
  for (const font of fontsToDownload) {
    const dest = path.join(FONTS_DIR, font.name);
    process.stdout.write(`⏳ تحميل ${font.name}... `);
    try {
      await downloadFile(font.url, dest);
      console.log('✅ تم بنجاح!');
    } catch (err) {
      console.log(`❌ خطأ: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }
  console.log('\n🎉 اكتمل تحميل جميع الخطوط والأيقونات! يمكنك تشغيل النظام الآن.');
}

startDownload();
```

/**

    upload_file: 'M14 2H6c-1.1 0-1.99.9-1.99 2L4 20c0 1.1.89 2 1.99 2H18c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V8l-6-6zm4 18H6V4h7v5h5v11zM8 15.01l1.41 1.41L11 14.84V19h2v-4.16l1.59 1.59L16 15.01 12.01 11 8 15.01z',
    workspace_premium: 'M9.68 13.69L12 11.93l2.31 1.76-.88-2.85L15.75 9h-2.84L12 6.19 11.09 9H8.25l2.31 1.84-.88 2.85zM20 10c0-4.42-3.58-8-8-8s-8 3.58-8 8c0 2.03.76 3.87 2 5.28V23l6-2 6 2v-7.72c1.24-1.41 2-3.25 2-5.28zm-8-6c3.31 0 6 2.69 6 6s-2.69 6-6 6-6-2.69-6-6 2.69-6 6-6z',
    verified_user: 'M12 1L3 5v6c0 5.55 3.84 10.74 9 12 5.16-1.26 9-6.45 9-12V5l-9-4zm-2 16l-4-4 1.41-1.41L10 14.17l6.59-6.59L18 9l-8 8z'
  };

  const DEFAULT_PATH = 'M12 2C6.48 2 2 6.48 2 12s4.48 10 10 10 10-4.48 10-10S17.52 2 12 2zm1 15h-2v-6h2v6zm0-8h-2V7h2v2z';

  function convertSpanToSvg(el) {
    if (!el || el.dataset.svgRendered === '1') return;
    if (el.querySelector('svg')) {
      el.dataset.svgRendered = '1';
      return;
    }
    const rawName = String(el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!rawName) return;

    const d = PATHS[rawName] || DEFAULT_PATH;
    el.dataset.iconName = rawName;
    el.dataset.svgRendered = '1';
    el.innerHTML = \`<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="\${d}"/></svg>\`;
  }

  function scanAndRenderIcons(root = document) {
    if (!root || !root.querySelectorAll) return;
    const nodes = root.querySelectorAll('.material-symbols-rounded');
    nodes.forEach(convertSpanToSvg);
  }

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      scanAndRenderIcons(document);
      const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        for (const m of mutations) {
          for (const node of m.addedNodes) {
            if (node.nodeType === 1) {
              if (node.classList && node.classList.contains('material-symbols-rounded')) {
                convertSpanToSvg(node);
              }
              scanAndRenderIcons(node);
            }
          }
        }
      });
      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    });
  }

  window.SvgIconEngine = { scanAndRenderIcons, convertSpanToSvg };
})();
`;

  window.tailwind.config = { darkMode: 'class' };
</script>`;

['index.html', 'activation.html'].forEach((fileName) => {

  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return;
  let html = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');

  if (!html.includes("darkMode: 'class'")) {
    html = html.replace(
      '<script src="./assets/js/tailwind.min.js"></script>',

    html = html.replace(

    );
  }

});

const polishedStyles = `/**
 * styles.css
 * ملف التنسيقات الرئيسي (Master Stylesheet) لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS
 */

:root {
  --color-primary: #2563eb;
  --color-primary-hover: #1d4ed8;
  --color-secondary: #0f172a;
  --bg-main: #f1f5f9;
  --bg-surface: #ffffff;
  --text-main: #0f172a;
  --text-muted: #64748b;
  --border-color: #e2e8f0;
  --sidebar-width: 255px;
  --sidebar-collapsed-width: 72px;
  --header-height: 64px;
  --font-primary: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --font-numbers: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
}

html.dark {
  --color-primary: #3b82f6;
  --color-primary-hover: #60a5fa;
  --color-secondary: #020617;
  --bg-main: #0f172a;
  --bg-surface: #1e293b;
  --text-main: #f8fafc;
  --text-muted: #94a3b8;
  --border-color: #334155;
}

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100vh;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  background-color: var(--bg-main);
  color: var(--text-main);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.financial-number, .price-tag, .font-mono {
  font-family: var(--font-numbers);
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background-color: #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 9999px;
}
html.dark ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background-color: #475569;
}

#app-container {
  display: flex;
  height: 100vh;
  width: 100vw;
}

#sidebar {
  width: var(--sidebar-width);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0f172a 0%, #020617 100%);
  color: #ffffff;
  transition: width 0.25s ease;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  z-index: 40;
  box-shadow: -4px 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
}

#sidebar.collapsed {
  width: var(--sidebar-collapsed-width);
}
#sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-label {
  display: none;
}

#main-content {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  background-color: var(--bg-main);
}

#top-header {
  height: var(--header-height);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0 1.25rem;
  z-index: 30;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
}

.view-section {
  display: none;
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  padding: 1.25rem;
}
.view-section.active {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease forwards;
}

.pos-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 410px;
  gap: 1rem;
  height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - 2.5rem);
}

.products-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(155px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.85rem;
  align-content: start;
}

.product-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.85rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
}
.product-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px -5px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.15);
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
}

.cart-container {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 1rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
}

.cart-items {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 100;
}
.modal-overlay.active {
  display: flex;
}
.modal-content {
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  color: var(--text-main);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 1.25rem;
  box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  max-width: 92vw;
  max-height: 90vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]):not([type="color"]),
select,
textarea {
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  color: var(--text-main);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}

input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.15);
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
`;

const mainPath = path.join(ROOT, 'main.js');
if (fs.existsSync(mainPath)) {
  let mainCode = fs.readFileSync(mainPath, 'utf8');

  if (!mainCode.includes('ELECTRON_DISABLE_SECURITY_WARNINGS')) {
    mainCode = "process.env.ELECTRON_DISABLE_SECURITY_WARNINGS = 'true';\n" + mainCode;
  }

  if (!mainCode.includes("ipcMain.handle('seed-demo-data'")) {
    const seedHandlerCode = `
  ipcMain.handle('seed-demo-data', async () => {
    const sampleProducts = [
      { barcode: '6130001001', name: 'حليب مجفف لويا 500غ', category: 'مواد غذائية', supplier: 'مؤسسة التوزيع الغذائي', unit: 'علبة', cost_price: 420, selling_price: 500, wholesale_price: 475, stock: 60, min_stock: 10 },
      { barcode: '6130001002', name: 'زيت مائدة إيليو 5 لتر', category: 'مواد غذائية', supplier: 'مجمع سيفيتال', unit: 'قارورة', cost_price: 590, selling_price: 650, wholesale_price: 630, stock: 45, min_stock: 8 },
      { barcode: '6130001003', name: 'قهوة مطحونة بونال 250غ', category: 'مشروبات وقهوة', supplier: 'مؤسسة التوزيع الغذائي', unit: 'علبة', cost_price: 260, selling_price: 320, wholesale_price: 300, stock: 80, min_stock: 15 },
      { barcode: '6130001004', name: 'سكر أبيض 1 كغ', category: 'مواد غذائية', supplier: 'مجمع سيفيتال', unit: 'كيس', cost_price: 85, selling_price: 105, wholesale_price: 98, stock: 120, min_stock: 20 },
      { barcode: '6130001005', name: 'عصير فواكه طبيعي 1 لتر', category: 'مشروبات وقهوة', supplier: 'مؤسسة المشروبات', unit: 'علبة', cost_price: 110, selling_price: 150, wholesale_price: 135, stock: 75, min_stock: 12 },
      { barcode: '6130001006', name: 'فرينة ممتازة 5 كغ', category: 'مواد غذائية', supplier: 'مطاحن الشرق', unit: 'كيس', cost_price: 240, selling_price: 300, wholesale_price: 280, stock: 50, min_stock: 10 },
      { barcode: '6130001007', name: 'جبن طري 16 قطعة', category: 'أجبان وألبان', supplier: 'مؤسسة الألبان', unit: 'علبة', cost_price: 175, selling_price: 230, wholesale_price: 210, stock: 65, min_stock: 10 },
      { barcode: '6130001008', name: 'ماء معدني سعيدة 1.5 لتر', category: 'مشروبات وقهوة', supplier: 'مؤسسة المشروبات', unit: 'قارورة', cost_price: 30, selling_price: 45, wholesale_price: 38, stock: 200, min_stock: 24 },
      { barcode: '00105', plu_code: '00105', name: 'لوز مقشر ممتاز (ميزان)', category: 'مكسرات وحلويات', supplier: 'مؤسسة التوزيع الغذائي', unit: 'كغ', cost_price: 1900, selling_price: 2400, wholesale_price: 2200, stock: 25, min_stock: 5 }
    ];

    await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      for (const p of sampleProducts) {
        const ex = await dbGet('SELECT id FROM products WHERE barcode = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [p.barcode]);
        if (ex) continue;
        await ensureSupplierByName(p.supplier);
        const ins = await dbRun(
          'INSERT INTO products (barcode, name, category, supplier, unit, min_stock, plu_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
          [p.barcode, p.name, p.category, p.supplier, p.unit, p.min_stock, p.plu_code || null]
        );
        await dbRun(
          'INSERT INTO inventory_batches (product_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price, wholesale_price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
          [ins.lastID, p.stock, p.cost_price, p.selling_price, p.wholesale_price]
        );
      }

      const custCount = await dbGet('SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM customers WHERE deleted_at IS NULL');
      if (Number(custCount.c || 0) === 0) {
        await dbRun(
          'INSERT INTO customers (name, phone, address, initial_debt, credit_limit, loyalty_points) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
          ['سوبرماركت النور (زبون جملة)', '0550112233', 'قسنطينة', 4500, 50000, 45]
        );
        await dbRun(
          'INSERT INTO customers (name, phone, address, initial_debt, credit_limit, loyalty_points) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
          ['محمد أمين بن علي', '0661223344', 'الجزائر الوسطى', 0, 20000, 12]
        );
      }
    });
    return { success: true };
  });
`;
    mainCode = mainCode.replace("ipcMain.handle('reset-system'", seedHandlerCode + "\n  ipcMain.handle('reset-system'");
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(mainPath, mainCode, 'utf8');

const preloadPath = path.join(ROOT, 'preload.js');
if (fs.existsSync(preloadPath)) {
  let preCode = fs.readFileSync(preloadPath, 'utf8');
  if (!preCode.includes('seedDemoData:')) {

      "resetSystem: () => invoke('reset-system'),",
      "resetSystem: () => invoke('reset-system'),\n  seedDemoData: () => invoke('seed-demo-data'),"
    );
    fs.writeFileSync(preloadPath, preCode, 'utf8');
  }
}

const rendererPath = path.join(ROOT, 'renderer.js');

  if (!renCode.includes('seedSampleStoreData')) {

          <div class="pt-2">

              + تحميل بيانات متجر جزائري نموذجي للتجربة الفورية
            </button>

    );

    const helperMethod = `
  async seedSampleStoreData() {
    if (!window.api || !window.api.seedDemoData) return;
    await window.api.seedDemoData();
    await this.refreshProducts();
    this.renderPosView();
    showToast('تم تحميل المنتجات والزبائن والموردين النموذجيين بنجاح!', 'success');
  },
`;
    renCode = renCode.replace('selectPosCategory(cat) {', helperMethod + '\n  selectPosCategory(cat) {');

}

```javascript
/**
 * generate-print-templates.js
 * المولد الهندسي الشامل لمنظومة قوالب الطباعة (53 قالب HTML أصلي ونظيف 100%)
 * لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS — يدعم العربية (RTL) والفرنسية/الإنجليزية (LTR) والبيانات الجبائية الجزائرية
 */

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

// تحديد مجلد المشروع تلقائياً (يدعم التشغيل من داخل Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean أو من خارجه)
const TARGET_DIR = fs.existsSync(path.join(__dirname, 'Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean'))
  ? path.join(__dirname, 'Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean')
  : __dirname;

function writeTemplate(fileName, htmlContent) {
  const fullPath = path.join(TARGET_DIR, fileName);
  fs.writeFileSync(fullPath, htmlContent.trim() + '\n', 'utf8');
}

// ============================================================================
// 1. مولد قوالب الفواتير الرسمية A4 / A5 / Detailed (invoice_template_1..9, a5, detailed)
// ============================================================================
function buildStandardInvoiceTemplate({
  themeColor = '#1d4ed8',
  secondaryBg = '#f8fafc',
  borderStyle = 'solid',
  headerLayout = 'split',
  paperSize = 'A4',
  isSixColumn = false,
  isDetailed = false
}) {
  const pageRule = paperSize === 'A5' ? '@page { size: A5 portrait; margin: 8mm; }' : '@page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 10mm; }';
  const baseFont = paperSize === 'A5' ? '11px' : '12px';

  const tableHeadHtml = isSixColumn
    ? `
      <tr>
        <th style="width:14%;">{{LBL_REF}}</th>
        <th style="width:40%;">{{LBL_DESIGNATION}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_QTY}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
      </tr>`
    : `
      <tr>
        <th style="width:6%;">{{LBL_N_INDEX}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_REF}}</th>
        <th style="width:35%;">{{LBL_DESIGNATION}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_QTY}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_UNIT}}</th>
        <th style="width:11%;">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
        <th style="width:7%;">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
      </tr>`;

  return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>{{LBL_INVOICE_TITLE}} - {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/css/fonts.css">
  <style>
    ${pageRule}
    * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: ${baseFont};
      color: #0f172a;
      margin: 0;
      padding: ${paperSize === 'A5' ? '10px' : '18px'};
      background: #ffffff;
    }
    .doc-container {
      max-width: ${paperSize === 'A5' ? '148mm' : '210mm'};
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .header-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 16px;
      padding-bottom: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      border-bottom: 3px ${borderStyle} ${themeColor};
      ${headerLayout === 'banner' ? `background: ${secondaryBg}; padding: 14px; border-radius: 10px;` : ''}
    }
    .company-block { flex: 1; }
    .company-name {
      font-size: ${paperSize === 'A5' ? '18px' : '22px'};
      font-weight: 900;
      color: ${themeColor};
      margin: 0 0 4px 0;
    }
    .company-desc { font-size: 11px; color: #475569; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .company-meta { font-size: 10.5px; color: #334155; line-height: 1.5; }
    .fiscal-pills {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      color: #1e293b;
    }
    .fiscal-pills span {
      background: ${secondaryBg};
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 5px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .doc-badge {
      text-align: left;
      min-width: 190px;
      background: ${secondaryBg};
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-top: 4px solid ${themeColor};
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
    }
    .doc-type {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: ${themeColor};
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .doc-num {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #0f172a;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .doc-date {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #475569;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .party-card {
      background: ${secondaryBg};
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .party-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: ${themeColor};
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }
    .party-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; }
    .party-details { font-size: 10.5px; color: #334155; margin-top: 3px; }
    .party-fiscal {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      color: #334155;
      text-align: left;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    table.items-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    table.items-table th {
      background: ${themeColor};
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 7px 6px;
      border: 1px solid ${themeColor};
      text-align: center;
    }
    table.items-table td {
      padding: 6px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      font-size: 11px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    table.items-table td.text-left,
    table.items-table td.desig {
      text-align: right;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    table.items-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
      background: #f8fafc;
    }
    .summary-section {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .words-and-payment { flex: 1; }
    .words-box {
      background: ${secondaryBg};
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-right: 4px solid ${themeColor};
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .words-prefix { font-size: 10.5px; color: #475569; font-weight: 700; }
    .words-text { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; margin-top: 3px; }
    .payment-meta {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #334155;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .totals-box {
      width: 270px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .totals-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      font-size: 11px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    }
    .totals-row .val {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-weight: 800;
    }
    .totals-row.net-row {
      background: ${themeColor};
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 900;
      padding: 8px 12px;
    }
    .footer-sign {
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding-top: 10px;
      border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #475569;
    }
    .sign-box {
      min-width: 160px;
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #0f172a;
      padding-bottom: 36px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="doc-container">
    <div class="header-bar">
      <div class="company-block">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="Logo" style="max-height:52px;margin-bottom:6px;object-fit:contain;">
        {{/if}}
        <h1 class="company-name">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        {{#if COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}<div class="company-desc">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</div>{{/if}}
        <div class="company-meta">
          {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<div>{{LBL_ADDRESS}} {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>{{/if}}
          <div>
            {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<span>{{LBL_TEL}}: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_FAX}}<span> | {{LBL_FAX}}: {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_EMAIL}}<span> | {{LBL_EMAIL}}: {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</span>{{/if}}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="fiscal-pills">
          <span>RC: {{COMPANY_RC}}</span>
          <span>NIF: {{COMPANY_NIF}}</span>
          <span>AI: {{COMPANY_AI}}</span>
          <span>NIS: {{COMPANY_NIS}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-badge">
        <div class="doc-type">{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="doc-num">N°: {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</div>
        <div class="doc-date">{{LBL_DATE}} {{DATE}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="party-card">
      <div>
        <div class="party-title">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="party-name">{{PARTY_NAME}}</div>
        <div class="party-details">
          {{#if PARTY_ADDRESS}}<span>{{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if PARTY_PHONE}}<span> | {{LBL_TEL}}: {{PARTY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="party-fiscal">
        <div><strong>RC:</strong> {{PARTY_RC}} | <strong>NIF:</strong> {{PARTY_NIF}}</div>
        <div><strong>AI:</strong> {{PARTY_AI}} | <strong>NIS:</strong> {{PARTY_NIS}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table class="items-table">
      <thead>${tableHeadHtml}</thead>
      <tbody>
        {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="summary-section">
      <div class="words-and-payment">
        <div class="words-box">
          <div class="words-prefix">{{LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX}}</div>
          <div class="words-text">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="payment-meta">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} <span>{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="totals-box">
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{#if DISCOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="val">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TAX_TOTAL}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        <div class="totals-row net-row">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        ${
          isDetailed
            ? `
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
        </div>`
            : ''
        }
        {{#if REMAINING_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TOTAL_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer-sign">
      <div>Gherbi.Ai POS — نظام نقاط البيع والمحاسبة المتكامل</div>
      <div class="sign-box">{{LBL_SIGNATURE}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>`;
}

// توليد قوالب الفواتير الـ 9 + A5 + Detailed
const invoiceThemes = [
  { file: 'invoice_template_1.html', themeColor: '#1d4ed8', secondaryBg: '#eff6ff', headerLayout: 'split' },
  { file: 'invoice_template_2.html', themeColor: '#0f172a', secondaryBg: '#f8fafc', headerLayout: 'banner' },
  { file: 'invoice_template_3.html', themeColor: '#047857', secondaryBg: '#ecfdf5', headerLayout: 'split' },
  { file: 'invoice_template_4.html', themeColor: '#4338ca', secondaryBg: '#eef2ff', headerLayout: 'banner' },
  { file: 'invoice_template_5.html', themeColor: '#b45309', secondaryBg: '#fffbeb', headerLayout: 'split' },
  { file: 'invoice_template_6.html', themeColor: '#be123c', secondaryBg: '#fff1f2', headerLayout: 'split' },
  { file: 'invoice_template_7.html', themeColor: '#0f766e', secondaryBg: '#f0fdfa', headerLayout: 'banner' },
  { file: 'invoice_template_8.html', themeColor: '#111827', secondaryBg: '#f3f4f6', borderStyle: 'double' },
  { file: 'invoice_template_9.html', themeColor: '#1e3a8a', secondaryBg: '#f8fafc', isSixColumn: true },

// ============================================================================
// 3. مولد قوالب الوصولات الحرارية الـ 15 (receipt_template_1..5 باللغات الثلاث)
// ============================================================================
function buildReceiptTemplate(styleNum = 1, lang = 'ar') {
  const dir = lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
  const i18n = {
    ar: {
      receipt: 'وصل بيع رقم',
      date: 'التاريخ',
      client: 'الزبون',
      seller: 'البائع',
      item: 'المنتج',
      qty: 'الكمية',
      price: 'السعر',
      total: 'المجموع',
      subtotal: 'المجموع الفرعي:',
      discount: 'التخفيض:',
      net: 'الإجمالي:',
      paid: 'المدفوع:',
      change: 'الباقي للزبون:',
      rest: 'الباقي (دين):',
      thanks: 'شكراً لزيارتكم — مرحباً بكم دائماً'
    },
    fr: {
      receipt: 'Ticket N°',
      date: 'Date',
      client: 'Client',
      seller: 'Caissier',
      item: 'Article',
      qty: 'Qté',
      price: 'P.U',
      total: 'Total',
      subtotal: 'Sous-total :',
      discount: 'Remise :',
      net: 'NET À PAYER :',
      paid: 'Reçu :',
      change: 'Rendu :',
      rest: 'Reste (Crédit) :',
      thanks: 'Merci de votre visite — À bientôt !'
    },
    en: {
      receipt: 'Receipt #',
      date: 'Date',
      client: 'Customer',
      seller: 'Cashier',
      item: 'Item',
      qty: 'Qty',
      price: 'Price',
      total: 'Total',
      subtotal: 'Subtotal:',
      discount: 'Discount:',
      net: 'TOTAL DUE:',
      paid: 'Paid:',
      change: 'Change:',
      rest: 'Balance Due:',
      thanks: 'Thank you for shopping with us!'
    }
  }[lang];

  const headerBorder = styleNum === 2 ? '2px solid #000' : styleNum === 3 ? '3px double #000' : '1px dashed #000';
  const headerBg = styleNum === 4 ? 'background:#000;color:#fff;padding:6px;border-radius:4px;' : '';

  return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="${lang}" dir="${dir}">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>${i18n.receipt} {{RECEIPT_NUMBER}}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/css/fonts.css">
  <style>
    @page { size: 80mm auto; margin: 2mm; }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', Arial, sans-serif;
      width: 74mm;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 4px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #000;
      background: #fff;
    }
    .header { text-align: center; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: ${headerBorder}; ${headerBg} }
    .shop-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 900; }
    .meta { padding: 5px 0; font-size: 10.5px; border-bottom: 1px dashed #000; }
    .meta-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 5px 0; }
    th { border-bottom: 1px solid #000; padding: 3px 2px; font-size: 10px; text-align: center; }
    td { padding: 4px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted #cbd5e1; font-size: 10.5px; text-align: center; }
    td:first-child { text-align: ${dir === 'rtl' ? 'right' : 'left'}; font-weight: 700; }
    .totals { border-top: 1px dashed #000; padding-top: 5px; }
    .t-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 2px 0; font-size: 11px; }
    .t-net { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; border-top: 2px solid #000; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding: 4px 0; margin: 4px 0; }
    .footer { text-align: center; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="header">
    {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
    <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="Logo" style="max-height:38px;margin-bottom:3px;">
    {{/if}}
    <div class="shop-name">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</div>
    {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<div style="font-size:10px;">{{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>{{/if}}
    {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<div style="font-size:10px;">{{COMPANY_PHONE}}</div>{{/if}}
  </div>

  <div class="meta">
    <div class="meta-row"><span><strong>${i18n.receipt}:</strong> {{RECEIPT_NUMBER}}</span><span>{{DATE}} {{TIME}}</span></div>
    <div class="meta-row"><span><strong>${i18n.client}:</strong> {{CLIENT_NAME}}</span><span><strong>${i18n.seller}:</strong> {{SELLER_NAME}}</span></div>
  </div>

  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="text-align:${dir === 'rtl' ? 'right' : 'left'};">${i18n.item}</th>
        <th>${i18n.qty}</th>
        <th>${i18n.price}</th>
        <th>${i18n.total}</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
    </tbody>
  </table>

  <div class="totals">
    <div class="t-row"><span>${i18n.subtotal}</span><span>{{SUBTOTAL}}</span></div>
    {{#if DISCOUNT}}<div class="t-row"><span>${i18n.discount}</span><span>-{{DISCOUNT}}</span></div>{{/if}}
    <div class="t-row t-net"><span>${i18n.net}</span><span>{{TOTAL}}</span></div>
    <div class="t-row"><span>${i18n.paid}</span><span>{{PAID}}</span></div>
    {{#if CHANGE}}<div class="t-row"><span>${i18n.change}</span><span>{{CHANGE}}</span></div>{{/if}}
    {{#if RECEIPT_REST}}<div class="t-row"><span>${i18n.rest}</span><span>{{RECEIPT_REST}}</span></div>{{/if}}
  </div>

  ${styleNum === 5 ? '<div style="font-size:9.5px;margin-top:4px;text-align:center;">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>' : ''}
  <div class="footer">${i18n.thanks}</div>
</body>
</html>`;
}

for (let n = 1; n <= 5; n++) {
  writeTemplate(`receipt_template_${n}.html`, buildReceiptTemplate(n, 'ar'));
  writeTemplate(`receipt_template_${n}_fr.html`, buildReceiptTemplate(n, 'fr'));
  writeTemplate(`receipt_template_${n}_en.html`, buildReceiptTemplate(n, 'en'));
}

// ============================================================================
// 4. قوالب إشعار الدائن (credit_note_ar/fr/en.html)
// ============================================================================
function buildCreditNoteTemplate(lang = 'ar') {
  const dir = lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
  const title =
    lang === 'fr' ? "FACTURE D'AVOIR" : lang === 'en' ? 'CREDIT NOTE' : 'إشعار دائن (فاتورة إلغاء / استرجاع)';
  return buildStandardInvoiceTemplate({
    themeColor: '#be123c',
    secondaryBg: '#fff1f2',
    headerLayout: 'banner'
  })
    .replace('<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">', `<html lang="${lang}" dir="${dir}">`)
    .replace('{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}}', title);
}

writeTemplate('credit_note_ar.html', buildCreditNoteTemplate('ar'));
writeTemplate('credit_note_fr.html', buildCreditNoteTemplate('fr'));
writeTemplate('credit_note_en.html', buildCreditNoteTemplate('en'));

// ============================================================================
// 5. قوالب وصولات التوصيل (delivery_note_ar/fr/en/a5/thermal.html)
// ============================================================================
function buildDeliveryNoteTemplate(lang = 'ar', mode = 'a4') {
  const dir = lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
  const titles = {
    ar: { doc: 'وصل تسليم وتوصيل بضاعة', client: 'الزبون المستلم', driver: 'السائق / الموزع', vehicle: 'ترقيم المركبة', sigClient: 'إمضاء وختم المستلم', sigSeller: 'إمضاء المسلّم' },
    fr: { doc: 'BON DE LIVRAISON', client: 'Client Destinataire', driver: 'Chauffeur / Livreur', vehicle: 'Matricule Véhicule', sigClient: 'Signature Client', sigSeller: 'Cachet Fournisseur' },
    en: { doc: 'DELIVERY NOTE', client: 'Recipient Customer', driver: 'Driver Name', vehicle: 'Vehicle Plate', sigClient: 'Receiver Signature', sigSeller: 'Sender Stamp' }
  }[lang];

  if (mode === 'thermal') {
    return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="${lang}" dir="${dir}">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>${titles.doc}</title>
  <style>
    @page { size: 80mm auto; margin: 2mm; }
    body { font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif; width: 74mm; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 11px; }
    .hdr { text-align: center; font-weight: 900; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding-bottom: 5px; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 6px; }
    th, td { border: 1px solid #000; padding: 4px; font-size: 10.5px; text-align: center; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="hdr">
    <div style="font-size:15px;">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</div>
    <div>${titles.doc} — {{DOC_NUMBER}}</div>
    <div>{{DATE}}</div>
  </div>
  <div style="margin:6px 0;">
    <div><strong>${titles.client}:</strong> {{PARTY_NAME}}</div>

function buildPaymentReceiptTemplate(lang = 'ar') {
  const dir = lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';

    lang === 'fr'
      ? {
          title: 'REÇU DE PAIEMENT / VERSEMENT',
          num: 'Reçu N°:',
          date: 'Date:',
          party: 'Reçu de:',
          debtBefore: 'Ancien Solde (Dette):',
          paid: 'Montant Versé:',
          debtAfter: 'Nouveau Solde Restant:',
          words: 'Arrêté le présent reçu à la somme de:',
          sig: 'Cachet & Signature'
        }
      : {
          title: 'وصل تسديد دفعة حساب',
          num: 'رقم الوصل:',
          date: 'التاريخ:',
          party: 'استلمنا من السيد / المؤسسة:',
          debtBefore: 'الرصيد / الدين السابق:',
          paid: 'المبلغ المدفوع حالياً:',
          debtAfter: 'الرصيد / الدين المتبقي:',
          words: 'المبلغ بالحروف:',
          sig: 'الختم والإمضاء'
        };

  return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="${lang}" dir="${dir}">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>${lbl.title} - {{RECEIPT_NUMBER}}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/css/fonts.css">
  <style>
    @page { size: A5 landscape; margin: 10mm; }
    body { font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #0f172a; padding: 16px; }
    .card { border: 2px solid #1d4ed8; border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px; background: #fff; }
    .hdr { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; color: #1d4ed8; }
    .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; margin: 14px 0; }
    .stat { background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px; text-align: center; }
    .stat.highlight { background: #ecfdf5; border-color: #10b981; color: #047857; }
    .val { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 900; font-family: monospace; margin-top: 4px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="card">
    <div class="hdr">
      <div>
        <div class="title">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</div>
        <div>{{COMPANY_ADDRESS}} | {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</div>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align:left;">
        <div class="title">${lbl.title}</div>
        <div><strong>${lbl.num}</strong> {{RECEIPT_NUMBER}} | <strong>${lbl.date}</strong> {{DATE}}</div>

    <div class="grid">
      <div class="stat"><div>${lbl.debtBefore}</div><div class="val">{{DEBT_BEFORE}}</div></div>
      <div class="stat highlight"><div>${lbl.paid}</div><div class="val">{{PAID_AMOUNT}}</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div>${lbl.debtAfter}</div><div class="val">{{DEBT_AFTER}}</div></div>
    </div>
    <div style="background:#eff6ff;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;">
      ${lbl.words} {{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}

    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:24px;font-weight:800;">
      <div>{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</div>
      <div>${lbl.sig}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>`;
}

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\imageUtils.js`

```javascript
/**
 * imageUtils.js
 * وحدة معالجة وتحويل وحفظ صور المنتجات والمتغيرات وشعار المتجر
 */

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const crypto = require('crypto');

const DATA_URL_PATTERN = /^data:image\/([a-zA-Z0-9+.-]+);base64,([\s\S]+)$/;

function getImagesDir() {
  let baseDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data');
  try {
    const electron = require('electron');
    const app = electron.app || (electron.remote && electron.remote.app);
    if (app && typeof app.getPath === 'function') {
      baseDir = app.getPath('userData');
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  const dir = path.join(baseDir, 'product_images');
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  }
  return dir;
}

function subtypeToExt(sub = '') {
  const s = String(sub).toLowerCase().trim();
  if (s === 'jpeg' || s === 'jpg') return 'jpg';
  if (s === 'webp') return 'webp';
  if (s === 'gif') return 'gif';
  if (s === 'svg+xml' || s === 'svg') return 'svg';
  return 'png';
}

function processImage(imageInput, options = {}) {
  if (!imageInput || typeof imageInput !== 'string') return null;
  const trimmed = imageInput.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;

  const match = DATA_URL_PATTERN.exec(trimmed);
  if (!match) {
    if (
      !trimmed.startsWith('http://') &&
      !trimmed.startsWith('https://') &&
      !trimmed.startsWith('file://') &&
      !trimmed.startsWith('data:') &&
      fs.existsSync(trimmed)
    ) {
      try {
        const ext = path.extname(trimmed).replace('.', '').toLowerCase() || 'png';
        const buf = fs.readFileSync(trimmed);
        const mime = ext === 'jpg' ? 'jpeg' : ext;
        return `data:image/${mime};base64,${buf.toString('base64')}`;
      } catch (_) {
        return trimmed;
      }
    }
    return trimmed;
  }

  if (options.saveToDisk) {
    try {
      const ext = subtypeToExt(match[1]);
      const buf = Buffer.from(match[2].replace(/\s+/g, ''), 'base64');
      const hash = crypto.createHash('sha1').update(buf).digest('hex').slice(0, 20);
      const filePath = path.join(getImagesDir(), `${options.prefix || 'img'}_${hash}.${ext}`);
      if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        fs.writeFileSync(filePath, buf);
      }
      return filePath;
    } catch (_) {
      return trimmed;
    }
  }

  return trimmed;
}

function imageToDataUrl(pathOrUrl) {
  if (!pathOrUrl || typeof pathOrUrl !== 'string') return null;
  const trimmed = pathOrUrl.trim();
  if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('data:image/')) return trimmed || null;

  const cleanPath = trimmed.replace(/^file:\/\/\/?/, '');
  if (fs.existsSync(cleanPath)) {
    try {
      const ext = path.extname(cleanPath).replace('.', '').toLowerCase() || 'png';
      const mime = ext === 'jpg' ? 'jpeg' : ext;
      const buf = fs.readFileSync(cleanPath);
      return `data:image/${mime};base64,${buf.toString('base64')}`;
    } catch (_) {
      return trimmed;
    }
  }
  return trimmed;
}

function deleteLocalImage(imagePath) {
  if (!imagePath || typeof imagePath !== 'string') return false;
  if (imagePath.startsWith('data:') || imagePath.startsWith('http')) return false;
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(imagePath)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(imagePath);
      return true;
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  return false;
}

module.exports = {
  getImagesDir,
  processImage,
  saveProductImage: processImage,
  imageToDataUrl,
  deleteLocalImage
};
```

    <main id="main-content">

        <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-1 max-w-2xl">
          <div class="relative flex-1">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400">search</span>
            <input id="globalPosSearch" type="text"
              oninput="App.onPosSearchInput(this.value)"

              class="w-full pr-9 pl-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">
          </div>
          <div class="relative w-52">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-blue-600">barcode_scanner</span>
            <input id="barcodeInput" type="text"
              onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter') App.handleBarcodeScan(this.value)"
              placeholder="امسح الباركود (Enter)..."
              class="w-full pr-9 pl-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold border-blue-500/40">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <button onclick="App.openPosScaleModal()" id="liveScaleBox"
            class="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs hover:border-emerald-500"
            title="فتح نافذة الميزان الإلكتروني">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm text-emerald-500">scale</span>
            <span id="liveScaleWeight" class="font-mono font-black text-xs">0.000 kg</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.switchView('caisse')" id="headerShiftBadge"
            class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">point_of_sale</span>
            <span id="headerShiftText">المناوبة نشطة</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.switchView('settings')" id="lanClientsBadge"
            class="hidden xl:flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/20 text-xs font-bold"
            title="الأجهزة المتصلة على الشبكة المحلية">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">lan</span>
            <span id="lanClientsCountText">LAN</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.openCustomerDisplayWindow()"
            class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"
            title="فتح شاشة عرض الزبون الثانية (Customer Display)">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">tv</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.openModal('virtualKeyboardModal')"
            class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
            title="لوحة المفاتيح اللمسية (Touch Keyboard)">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">keyboard</span>
          </button>

          <div class="relative">
            <button id="notificationsBellBtn" onclick="App.toggleNotificationsPopover()"
              class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 relative"
              title="تنبيهات المخزون والصلاحية والأقساط">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">notifications</span>
              <span id="notifCountBadge" class="hidden absolute -top-0.5 -left-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-rose-600 text-white rounded-full text-[10px] font-black">0</span>
            </button>
            <div id="notificationsPopover" class="hidden absolute left-0 mt-2 w-80 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-3 z-50 text-xs space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto"></div>
          </div>

          <button onclick="App.openAuditLogsModal()"
            class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-amber-500"
            title="سجل الرقابة الأمنية للكاشير (Anti-Theft Audit)">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">shield_person</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.openModal('shortcutsHelpModal')"
            class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"

            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">help</span>
          </button>

          <select id="langSwitcher" onchange="App.setLanguage(this.value)"

            <option value="ar">🇩🇿 العربية</option>
            <option value="fr">🇫🇷 Français</option>
            <option value="en">🇬🇧 English</option>

          <button onclick="App.toggleDarkMode()" class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800" title="الوضع الليلي / النهاري">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">dark_mode</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.toggleFullscreen()" class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800" title="ملء الشاشة">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">fullscreen</span>
          </button>

      <section id="view-pos" class="view-section active">

          <div class="flex flex-col gap-2.5 min-h-0 pl-1">

              <div id="posCategoryPills" class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5"></div>
              <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                <button onclick="App.openModal('posCustomizeModal')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">tune</span>
                  <span>تخصيص</span>

                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">filter_alt</span>
                  <span>فلتر</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.openPosQuickProduceModal()" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">

                  <span>إنتاج فوري</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.openFreeItemModal()" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">add_shopping_cart</span>
                  <span>منتج حر (F8)</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.toggleReturnMode()" id="btnReturnMode" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">keyboard_return</span>
                  <span>إرجاع</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.openProductModal()" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shadow">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">add</span>
                  <span>إضافة منتج</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="posProductsGrid" class="products-grid flex-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1"></div>

            <div id="posPaginationBar" class="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">
              <button onclick="App.changePosPage(-1)" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white">السابق</button>
              <span id="posPageInfoText" class="text-slate-500">صفحة 1 من 1</span>
              <button onclick="App.changePosPage(1)" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white">التالي</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- الفاصل القابل للسحب لتغيير عرض السلة (#posCartResizer) -->
          <div id="posCartResizer" title="اسحب لتكبير أو تصغير عرض السلة"
            class="w-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-blue-500 cursor-col-resize transition-colors"></div>

          <!-- يسار: سلة المشتريات والحسابات -->
          <div id="posCartContainer" class="cart-container">
            <!-- شريط تنبيه وضع تعديل فاتورة سابقة -->
            <div id="posEditSaleBanner" class="hidden px-3 py-2 bg-amber-500 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-between">
              <span id="posEditSaleBannerText">وضع تعديل الفاتورة #</span>
              <button onclick="App.cancelEditSaleMode()" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/25 hover:bg-black/40 text-[11px]">إلغاء التعديل ✕</button>
            </div>

            <div class="p-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2.5">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div id="multiCartTabs" class="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto"></div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <button onclick="App.openRecentSalesModal()" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1" title="آخر مبيعات الكاشير">
                    <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">history</span>
                    <span>سجل</span>
                  </button>
                  <button onclick="App.newCartTab()" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-blue-600/10 text-blue-600 text-xs font-bold">+ سلة</button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="flex gap-1.5">
                <select id="posCustomerSelect" class="flex-1 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold"></select>
                <button onclick="App.openCustomerModal()" class="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600/15 text-emerald-600" title="إضافة زبون جديد">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">person_add</span>
                </button>
                <select id="posPriceTierSelect" onchange="App.setCartPriceTier(this.value)" class="w-28 px-2 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">
                  <option value="retail">سعر التجزئة</option>
                  <option value="wholesale">سعر الجملة</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="posCartItems" class="cart-items p-3 space-y-2"></div>

            <div class="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/70 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2.5">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span class="text-slate-500 font-bold">المجموع الفرعي (<span id="cartItemsCountText">0</span> صنف):</span>
                <span id="cartSubtotalText" class="font-mono font-bold">0.00 د.ج</span>
              </div>
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <button onclick="App.openCartModifierModal()" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">calculate</span>
                  <span>التخفيض (% أو مبلغ):</span>
                </button>
                <input id="cartDiscountInput" type="number" step="any" value="0"
                  oninput="App.recalcCart()"
                  class="w-28 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-center font-mono font-bold">
              </div>
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                <span class="font-black text-sm">الإجمالي المستحق:</span>
                <span id="cartTotalText" class="text-2xl font-black font-mono text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">0.00 د.ج</span>
              </div>

              <div class="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold">
                <button onclick="App.clearCurrentCart()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-500/20">إلغاء (F4)</button>
                <button onclick="App.holdCurrentCart()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500/20">تعليق (F2)</button>
                <button onclick="App.openDraftsModal()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800">مسودات (<span id="draftsCountBadge">0</span>)</button>
                <button onclick="App.saveCartAsProforma()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500/20">كمبدئية</button>
                <button onclick="App.openOrderModalFromCart()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-teal-500/10 text-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-500/20">كطلبية</button>
              </div>

              <button onclick="App.openCheckoutModal()"
                class="w-full py-3.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl font-black text-base flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/25">
                <span class="material-symbols-rounded">payments</span>
                <span id="btnCheckoutMainText">تسديد الفاتورة (F1)</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
