```html
  <!-- 1. نافذة الدفع والتسديد الشاملة (Checkout Modal + Split Payment + Installments) -->
  <div id="checkoutModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-3xl p-6 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-xl font-black flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded text-blue-600">point_of_sale</span>
          <span>تسديد وإتمام الفاتورة (F1)</span>
        </h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('checkoutModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div id="creditLimitAlertBox" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/15 border border-rose-500/30 text-rose-600 text-xs font-bold"></div>

      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <div class="space-y-3">
          <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-blue-600/10 border border-blue-500/20 text-center">
            <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">الإجمالي المطلوب للدفع</div>
            <div id="chkTotalDue" class="text-3xl font-black font-mono text-blue-600 mt-1">0.00 د.ج</div>
          </div>

          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 cursor-pointer">
              <input id="chkApplyTva" type="checkbox" onchange="App.recalcCheckoutModal()">
              <span class="font-bold">تطبيق TVA (19%)</span>
            </label>
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 cursor-pointer">
              <input id="chkApplyStamp" type="checkbox" onchange="App.recalcCheckoutModal()">
              <span class="font-bold">حق الطابع (1%)</span>
            </label>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">طريقة الدفع</label>
            <select id="chkPaymentMethod" onchange="App.onCheckoutMethodChange(this.value)" class="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">
              <option value="cash">نقداً (Espèces / Cash)</option>
              <option value="credit">آجل / دين (À Terme)</option>
              <option value="cib">بطاقة ذهبية / بنكية (CIB / Edahabia)</option>
              <option value="baridimob">بريدي موب (BaridiMob / CCP)</option>
              <option value="cheque">شيك (Chèque)</option>
              <option value="split">دفع مختلط متعدد (Split Payment)</option>
              <option value="installment">بيع بالتقسيط (Vente par Facilité)</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div id="chkSplitPaymentBox" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/70 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2 text-xs">
            <div class="font-bold text-blue-600">تقسيم المبلغ على عدة طرق دفع:</div>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">نقداً (Cash)</label><input id="splitCashInput" type="number" step="any" value="0" oninput="App.recalcSplitTotals()" class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold"></div>
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">CIB / BaridiMob</label><input id="splitCardInput" type="number" step="any" value="0" oninput="App.recalcSplitTotals()" class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold"></div>
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">الباقي آجل (دين)</label><input id="splitCreditInput" type="number" step="any" readonly class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold text-rose-500"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div id="chkInstallmentBox" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 space-y-2 text-xs">
            <div class="font-bold text-amber-600">جدولة الأقساط الشهرية (Vente par Facilité):</div>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">الدفعة الأولى (تسبقة)</label><input id="instDownPayment" type="number" step="any" value="0" oninput="App.recalcCheckoutModal()" class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold"></div>
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">عدد الأشهر</label><input id="instMonthsCount" type="number" min="1" max="36" value="6" oninput="App.recalcCheckoutModal()" class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold"></div>
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">القسط الشهري</label><input id="instMonthlyVal" type="text" readonly class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <div>
              <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">المبلغ المستلم</label>
              <input id="chkPaidAmount" type="number" step="any"
                oninput="App.recalcCheckoutModal()"
                class="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-mono font-black text-base text-center">
            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">الباقي للزبون (Rendu)</label>
              <div id="chkChangeAmount" class="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 font-mono font-black text-base text-center">0.00</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="space-y-2">
          <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">الفئات النقدية الجزائرية السريعة (د.ج)</div>
          <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(2000)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-900 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">2000 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(1000)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-800 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">1000 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(500)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-800 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">500 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(200)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-600 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">200 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(100)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-sky-700 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">100 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(50)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-700 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">50 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(20)" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-600 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs">20 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(10)" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-600 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs">10 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.setExactCash()" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold text-xs">المبلغ الكامل</button>
          </div>
          <div class="pt-2">
            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">تاريخ استحقاق الدين (عند البيع الآجل)</label>
            <input id="chkDueDate" type="date" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
        <button onclick="App.submitSale('receipt')" class="py-3 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">receipt</span>
          <span>حفظ وطباعة وصل حراري</span>
        </button>
        <button onclick="App.submitSale('a4')" class="py-3 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">print</span>
          <span>حفظ وطباعة فاتورة A4</span>
        </button>
        <button onclick="App.submitSale('none')" class="py-3 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">check_circle</span>
          <span>حفظ فقط بدون طباعة</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 2. نافذة المسودات والفواتير المعلقة (Drafts Modal - F3) -->
  <div id="draftsModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-2xl p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black">الفواتير المعلقة والمسودات (F3)</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('draftsModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div id="draftsModalBody" class="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 3. نافذة سجل آخر مبيعات الكاشير السريع (Recent Sales Modal) -->
  <div id="recentSalesModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-3xl p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black">سجل آخر مبيعات الكاشير السريع</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('recentSalesModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div id="recentSalesModalBody" class="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 4. نافذة تخصيص عرض شاشة المبيعات المتقدمة (POS Customize Modal) -->
  <div id="posCustomizeModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black">تخصيص شبكة منتجات الكاشير وعرض السلة</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('posCustomizeModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="space-y-3 text-xs">
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">حجم بطاقات المنتجات</label>
          <select id="posCardSizeSelect" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">
            <option value="small">صغير (كثافة عالية)</option>
            <option value="medium" selected>متوسط (قياسي)</option>
            <option value="large">كبير (واضح للشاشات اللمسية)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">عدد المنتجات في كل صفحة</label>
          <select id="posPageSizeSelect" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold">
            <option value="18">18 منتج</option>
            <option value="24" selected>24 منتج</option>
            <option value="36">36 منتج</option>
            <option value="60">60 منتج</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">عرض السلة الجانبية (بالبيكسل)</label>
          <input id="posCartWidthInput" type="number" min="320" max="620" value="420" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold">
        </div>
        <label class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer pt-1">
          <input id="posShowImagesCheckbox" type="checkbox" checked>
          <span class="font-bold">إظهار صور المنتجات داخل البطاقات</span>
        </label>
        <label id="posShowCostRow" class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer pt-1">
          <input id="posShowCostCheckbox" type="checkbox">
          <span class="font-bold">إظهار سعر الشراء (التكلفة) بخط صغير على بطاقة المنتج</span>
        </label>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-3">
        <button onclick="App.savePosCustomization()" class="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">حفظ وتطبيق</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 5. نافذة الميزان الإلكتروني المباشر (POS Scale Modal) -->
  <div id="posScaleModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded text-emerald-500">scale</span>
          <span>الميزان الإلكتروني المباشر</span>
        </h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('posScaleModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 text-emerald-400 text-center font-mono">
        <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">الوزن الصافي المستقر</div>
        <div id="scaleModalWeightDisplay" class="text-4xl font-black">0.000 kg</div>
      </div>
      <div class="space-y-2 text-xs">
        <label class="block font-bold">اختر المنتج الموزون لإضافته للسلة:</label>
        <select id="scaleModalProductSelect" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold"></select>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-2">
          <button onclick="window.api.scale.zero()" class="py-2 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold">تصفير (Zero)</button>
          <button onclick="window.api.scale.tare()" class="py-2 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold">طارئة (Tare)</button>
          <button onclick="window.api.scale.readOnce()" class="py-2 bg-blue-600/15 text-blue-600 rounded-xl font-bold">قراءة الآن</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button onclick="App.addWeightedProductFromScaleModal()" class="w-full py-3 bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black">إضافة الوزن الحالي إلى السلة</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 6. نافذة اختيار المتغير / الدفعة / الرقم التسلسلي عند البيع (Variant/Batch/Serial Picker) -->
  <div id="posVariantBatchPickerModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-lg p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 id="pickerModalProductName" class="text-lg font-black">اختيار المتغير / الدفعة / الرقم التسلسلي</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('posVariantBatchPickerModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div id="pickerModalBody" class="space-y-3 text-xs max-h-96 overflow-y-auto"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 7. نافذة إضافة/تعديل منتج الشاملة بـ 5 تبويبات + Markup % + أدوات المتغيرات الجماعية -->
  <div id="productModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-3xl p-6 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 id="productModalTitle" class="text-lg font-black">إضافة / تعديل منتج</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('productModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <input id="prodIdInput" type="hidden">

      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-2 text-xs font-bold">
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('basic')" id="prodTabBtn-basic" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white">1. البيانات الأساسية</button>
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('pricing')" id="prodTabBtn-pricing" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">2. الأسعار وهامش الربح</button>
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('barcodes')" id="prodTabBtn-barcodes" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">3. الباركودات المتعددة</button>
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('variants')" id="prodTabBtn-variants" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">4. مصفوفة المتغيرات</button>
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('bom')" id="prodTabBtn-bom" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">5. التصنيع والضمان</button>
      </div>

      <!-- تبويب 1: البيانات الأساسية -->
      <div id="prodTabContent-basic" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-xs">
        <div class="md:col-span-2">
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">اسم المنتج *</label>
          <input id="prodNameInput" type="text" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">الباركود (يدعم القاموس الجزائري 613)</label>
          <div class="flex gap-1">
            <input id="prodBarcodeInput" type="text" onchange="App.autoFillFromDzDictionary(this.value)" class="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono">
            <button onclick="App.generateRandomBarcode()" class="px-2.5 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold" title="توليد باركود جزائري">⚡</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">الفئة (Catégorie)</label><input id="prodCategoryInput" type="text" placeholder="عام" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">العائلة (Famille)</label><input id="prodFamilyInput" type="text" placeholder="اختياري" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">المورد</label><input id="prodSupplierInput" type="text" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">وحدة البيع</label><input id="prodUnitInput" type="text" value="قطعة" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">الكمية الابتدائية</label><input id="prodStockInput" type="number" step="any" value="0" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">الحد الأدنى للتنبيه</label><input id="prodMinStockInput" type="number" value="5" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">تاريخ انتهاء الصلاحية</label><input id="prodExpiryInput" type="date" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">مكان التخزين (Rayon)</label><input id="prodLocationInput" type="text" placeholder="ممر A - رف 2" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">كود الميزان (PLU 5 digits)</label><input id="prodPluInput" type="text" placeholder="00105" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono"></div>
        <div class="md:col-span-3 flex items-center gap-3 pt-1">
          <input id="prodImageFileInput" type="file" accept="image/*" onchange="App.handleProductImageUpload(this)" class="text-xs">
          <input id="prodImageDataInput" type="hidden">
          <label class="flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
            <input id="prodFeaturedCheckbox" type="checkbox">
            <span class="font-bold">تمييز كمفضلة (Featured)</span>
          </label>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- تبويب 2: الأسعار وحاسبة هامش الربح % والجملة -->
      <div id="prodTabContent-pricing" class="hidden space-y-3 text-xs">
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">سعر التكلفة (الشراء)</label><input id="prodCostInput" type="number" step="any" value="0" oninput="App.onProdCostOrMarkupInput()" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold"></div>
          <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1 text-emerald-600">هامش الربح (% Markup)</label><input id="prodMarkupInput" type="number" step="any" placeholder="20%" oninput="App.onProdMarkupChange(this.value)" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600"></div>
          <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">سعر البيع (التجزئة)</label><input id="prodPriceInput" type="number" step="any" value="0" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold text-blue-600"></div>
          <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">سعر الجملة</label><input id="prodWholesaleInput" type="number" step="any" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono"></div>
          <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">اسم وحدة الجملة (كرتونة/صندوق)</label><input id="prodWholesaleUnitInput" type="text" placeholder="كرتونة" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"></div>
          <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">عدد القطع في الكرتونة</label><input id="prodWholesaleQtyInput" type="number" placeholder="12" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span class="font-bold">مستويات أسعار إضافية (نصف جملة، خاص، VIP):</span>
            <button onclick="App.addExtraPriceRow()" class="px-3 py-1 bg-blue-600/10 text-blue-600 rounded-lg font-bold">+ إضافة سعر</button>
          </div>
          <div id="prodExtraPricesContainer" class="space-y-1.5"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- تبويب 3: الباركودات المتعددة -->
      <div id="prodTabContent-barcodes" class="hidden space-y-3 text-xs">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span>ربط باركودات إضافية بنفس المنتج أو بتسعيرة محددة:</span>
          <button onclick="App.addExtraBarcodeRow()" class="px-3 py-1 bg-blue-600/10 text-blue-600 rounded-lg font-bold">+ إضافة باركود فرعي</button>
        </div>
        <div id="prodExtraBarcodesContainer" class="space-y-1.5"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- تبويب 4: مصفوفة المتغيرات + أدوات التطبيق الجماعي (Bulk Variant Tools) -->
      <div id="prodTabContent-variants" class="hidden space-y-3 text-xs">
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <label class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
            <input id="prodHasVariantsCheckbox" type="checkbox">
            <span class="font-bold">تفعيل المتغيرات لهذا المنتج (مقاس، لون...)</span>
          </label>
```

```html
      padding: 10px 14px;
    }

      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 900;

      color: #0f172a;

      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;

      margin-bottom: 3px;

      color: #334155;
      text-align: left;

      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .payment-meta {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #334155;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .totals-box {
      width: 270px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;

    }

      display: flex;

      font-size: 11px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    }
    .totals-row .val {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-weight: 800;
    }
    .totals-row.net-row {
      background: #1d4ed8;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 900;
      padding: 8px 12px;
    }
    .footer-sign {

<body>
  <div class="doc-container">
    <div class="header-bar">
      <div class="company-block">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="Logo" style="max-height:52px;margin-bottom:6px;object-fit:contain;">
        {{/if}}
        <h1 class="company-name">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        {{#if COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}<div class="company-desc">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</div>{{/if}}
        <div class="company-meta">
          {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<div>{{LBL_ADDRESS}} {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>{{/if}}
          <div>
            {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<span>{{LBL_TEL}}: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_FAX}}<span> | {{LBL_FAX}}: {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_EMAIL}}<span> | {{LBL_EMAIL}}: {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</span>{{/if}}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="fiscal-pills">
          <span>RC: {{COMPANY_RC}}</span>
          <span>NIF: {{COMPANY_NIF}}</span>
          <span>AI: {{COMPANY_AI}}</span>
          <span>NIS: {{COMPANY_NIS}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-badge">
        <div class="doc-type">{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="doc-num">N°: {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</div>
        <div class="doc-date">{{LBL_DATE}} {{DATE}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="party-card">
      <div>
        <div class="party-title">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="party-name">{{PARTY_NAME}}</div>
        <div class="party-details">
          {{#if PARTY_ADDRESS}}<span>{{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if PARTY_PHONE}}<span> | {{LBL_TEL}}: {{PARTY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="party-fiscal">
        <div><strong>RC:</strong> {{PARTY_RC}} | <strong>NIF:</strong> {{PARTY_NIF}}</div>
        <div><strong>AI:</strong> {{PARTY_AI}} | <strong>NIS:</strong> {{PARTY_NIS}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table class="items-table">
      <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:6%;">{{LBL_N_INDEX}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_REF}}</th>
        <th style="width:35%;">{{LBL_DESIGNATION}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_QTY}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_UNIT}}</th>
        <th style="width:11%;">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
        <th style="width:7%;">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="summary-section">
      <div class="words-and-payment">
        <div class="words-box">
          <div class="words-prefix">{{LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX}}</div>
          <div class="words-text">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="payment-meta">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} <span>{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="totals-box">
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{#if DISCOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="val">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TAX_TOTAL}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        <div class="totals-row net-row">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        
        {{#if REMAINING_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TOTAL_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer-sign">
      <div>Gherbi.Ai POS — نظام نقاط البيع والمحاسبة المتكامل</div>
      <div class="sign-box">{{LBL_SIGNATURE}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>{{LBL_INVOICE_TITLE}} - {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/css/fonts.css">
  <style>
    @page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 10mm; }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #0f172a;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 18px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }
    .doc-container {
      max-width: 210mm;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .header-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 16px;
      padding-bottom: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      border-bottom: 3px solid #047857;
      
    }
    .company-block { flex: 1; }
    .company-name {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #047857;
      margin: 0 0 4px 0;
    }
    .company-desc { font-size: 11px; color: #475569; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .company-meta { font-size: 10.5px; color: #334155; line-height: 1.5; }
    .fiscal-pills {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      color: #1e293b;
    }
    .fiscal-pills span {
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 5px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .doc-badge {
      text-align: left;
      min-width: 190px;
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-top: 4px solid #047857;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
    }
    .doc-type {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #047857;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .doc-num {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #0f172a;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .doc-date {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #475569;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .party-card {
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .party-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #047857;
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }
    .party-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; }
    .party-details { font-size: 10.5px; color: #334155; margin-top: 3px; }
    .party-fiscal {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      color: #334155;
      text-align: left;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    table.items-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    table.items-table th {
      background: #047857;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 7px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #047857;
      text-align: center;
    }
    table.items-table td {
      padding: 6px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      font-size: 11px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    table.items-table td.text-left,
    table.items-table td.desig {
      text-align: right;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    table.items-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
      background: #f8fafc;
    }
    .summary-section {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .words-and-payment { flex: 1; }
    .words-box {
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-right: 4px solid #047857;
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .words-prefix { font-size: 10.5px; color: #475569; font-weight: 700; }
    .words-text { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; margin-top: 3px; }
    .payment-meta {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #334155;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .totals-box {
      width: 270px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .totals-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      font-size: 11px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    }
    .totals-row .val {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-weight: 800;
    }
    .totals-row.net-row {
      background: #047857;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 900;
      padding: 8px 12px;
    }
    .footer-sign {
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding-top: 10px;
      border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #475569;
    }
    .sign-box {
      min-width: 160px;
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #0f172a;
      padding-bottom: 36px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="doc-container">
    <div class="header-bar">
      <div class="company-block">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="Logo" style="max-height:52px;margin-bottom:6px;object-fit:contain;">
        {{/if}}
        <h1 class="company-name">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        {{#if COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}<div class="company-desc">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</div>{{/if}}
        <div class="company-meta">
          {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<div>{{LBL_ADDRESS}} {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>{{/if}}
          <div>
            {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<span>{{LBL_TEL}}: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_FAX}}<span> | {{LBL_FAX}}: {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_EMAIL}}<span> | {{LBL_EMAIL}}: {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</span>{{/if}}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="fiscal-pills">
          <span>RC: {{COMPANY_RC}}</span>
          <span>NIF: {{COMPANY_NIF}}</span>
          <span>AI: {{COMPANY_AI}}</span>
          <span>NIS: {{COMPANY_NIS}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-badge">
        <div class="doc-type">{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="doc-num">N°: {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</div>
        <div class="doc-date">{{LBL_DATE}} {{DATE}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="party-card">
      <div>
        <div class="party-title">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="party-name">{{PARTY_NAME}}</div>
        <div class="party-details">
          {{#if PARTY_ADDRESS}}<span>{{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if PARTY_PHONE}}<span> | {{LBL_TEL}}: {{PARTY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="party-fiscal">
        <div><strong>RC:</strong> {{PARTY_RC}} | <strong>NIF:</strong> {{PARTY_NIF}}</div>
        <div><strong>AI:</strong> {{PARTY_AI}} | <strong>NIS:</strong> {{PARTY_NIS}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table class="items-table">
      <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:6%;">{{LBL_N_INDEX}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_REF}}</th>
        <th style="width:35%;">{{LBL_DESIGNATION}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_QTY}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_UNIT}}</th>
        <th style="width:11%;">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
        <th style="width:7%;">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="summary-section">
      <div class="words-and-payment">
        <div class="words-box">
          <div class="words-prefix">{{LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX}}</div>
          <div class="words-text">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="payment-meta">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} <span>{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="totals-box">
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{#if DISCOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="val">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TAX_TOTAL}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        <div class="totals-row net-row">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        
        {{#if REMAINING_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TOTAL_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer-sign">
      <div>Gherbi.Ai POS — نظام نقاط البيع والمحاسبة المتكامل</div>
      <div class="sign-box">{{LBL_SIGNATURE}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>

```

```html
<body>
  <div class="doc-container">
    <div class="header-bar">
      <div class="company-block">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="Logo" style="max-height:52px;margin-bottom:6px;object-fit:contain;">
        {{/if}}
        <h1 class="company-name">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        {{#if COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}<div class="company-desc">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</div>{{/if}}
        <div class="company-meta">
          {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<div>{{LBL_ADDRESS}} {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>{{/if}}
          <div>
            {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<span>{{LBL_TEL}}: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_FAX}}<span> | {{LBL_FAX}}: {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_EMAIL}}<span> | {{LBL_EMAIL}}: {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</span>{{/if}}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="fiscal-pills">
          <span>RC: {{COMPANY_RC}}</span>
          <span>NIF: {{COMPANY_NIF}}</span>
          <span>AI: {{COMPANY_AI}}</span>
          <span>NIS: {{COMPANY_NIS}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-badge">
        <div class="doc-type">{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="doc-num">N°: {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</div>
        <div class="doc-date">{{LBL_DATE}} {{DATE}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="party-card">
      <div>
        <div class="party-title">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="party-name">{{PARTY_NAME}}</div>
        <div class="party-details">
          {{#if PARTY_ADDRESS}}<span>{{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if PARTY_PHONE}}<span> | {{LBL_TEL}}: {{PARTY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="party-fiscal">
        <div><strong>RC:</strong> {{PARTY_RC}} | <strong>NIF:</strong> {{PARTY_NIF}}</div>
        <div><strong>AI:</strong> {{PARTY_AI}} | <strong>NIS:</strong> {{PARTY_NIS}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table class="items-table">
      <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:6%;">{{LBL_N_INDEX}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_REF}}</th>
        <th style="width:35%;">{{LBL_DESIGNATION}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_QTY}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_UNIT}}</th>
        <th style="width:11%;">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
        <th style="width:7%;">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="summary-section">
      <div class="words-and-payment">
        <div class="words-box">
          <div class="words-prefix">{{LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX}}</div>
          <div class="words-text">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="payment-meta">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} <span>{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="totals-box">
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{#if DISCOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="val">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TAX_TOTAL}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        <div class="totals-row net-row">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        
        {{#if REMAINING_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TOTAL_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer-sign">
      <div>Gherbi.Ai POS — نظام نقاط البيع والمحاسبة المتكامل</div>
      <div class="sign-box">{{LBL_SIGNATURE}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
  <div class="doc-container">
    <div class="header-bar">
      <div class="company-block">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="Logo" style="max-height:52px;margin-bottom:6px;object-fit:contain;">
        {{/if}}
        <h1 class="company-name">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        {{#if COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}<div class="company-desc">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</div>{{/if}}
        <div class="company-meta">
          {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<div>{{LBL_ADDRESS}} {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>{{/if}}
          <div>
            {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<span>{{LBL_TEL}}: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_FAX}}<span> | {{LBL_FAX}}: {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_EMAIL}}<span> | {{LBL_EMAIL}}: {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</span>{{/if}}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="fiscal-pills">
          <span>RC: {{COMPANY_RC}}</span>
          <span>NIF: {{COMPANY_NIF}}</span>
          <span>AI: {{COMPANY_AI}}</span>
          <span>NIS: {{COMPANY_NIS}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-badge">
        <div class="doc-type">{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="doc-num">N°: {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</div>
        <div class="doc-date">{{LBL_DATE}} {{DATE}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="party-card">
      <div>
        <div class="party-title">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="party-name">{{PARTY_NAME}}</div>
        <div class="party-details">
          {{#if PARTY_ADDRESS}}<span>{{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if PARTY_PHONE}}<span> | {{LBL_TEL}}: {{PARTY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="party-fiscal">
        <div><strong>RC:</strong> {{PARTY_RC}} | <strong>NIF:</strong> {{PARTY_NIF}}</div>
        <div><strong>AI:</strong> {{PARTY_AI}} | <strong>NIS:</strong> {{PARTY_NIS}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table class="items-table">
      <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:6%;">{{LBL_N_INDEX}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_REF}}</th>
        <th style="width:35%;">{{LBL_DESIGNATION}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_QTY}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_UNIT}}</th>
        <th style="width:11%;">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
        <th style="width:7%;">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="summary-section">
      <div class="words-and-payment">
        <div class="words-box">
          <div class="words-prefix">{{LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX}}</div>
          <div class="words-text">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="payment-meta">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} <span>{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="totals-box">
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{#if DISCOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="val">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TAX_TOTAL}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        <div class="totals-row net-row">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        
        {{#if REMAINING_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TOTAL_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer-sign">
      <div>Gherbi.Ai POS — نظام نقاط البيع والمحاسبة المتكامل</div>
      <div class="sign-box">{{LBL_SIGNATURE}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .words-prefix { font-size: 10.5px; color: #475569; font-weight: 700; }
    .words-text { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; margin-top: 3px; }
    .payment-meta {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #334155;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .totals-box {
      width: 270px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .totals-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;

      font-size: 11px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    }

      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-weight: 800;

      font-weight: 900;

      font-size: 11px;
      color: #475569;
    }

      min-width: 160px;
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #0f172a;
      padding-bottom: 36px;
    }
```

```html
</head>
<body>
  <div class="doc-container">
    <div class="header-bar">
      <div class="company-block">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="Logo" style="max-height:52px;margin-bottom:6px;object-fit:contain;">
        {{/if}}
        <h1 class="company-name">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        {{#if COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}<div class="company-desc">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</div>{{/if}}
        <div class="company-meta">
          {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<div>{{LBL_ADDRESS}} {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>{{/if}}
          <div>
            {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<span>{{LBL_TEL}}: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_FAX}}<span> | {{LBL_FAX}}: {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_EMAIL}}<span> | {{LBL_EMAIL}}: {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</span>{{/if}}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="fiscal-pills">
          <span>RC: {{COMPANY_RC}}</span>
          <span>NIF: {{COMPANY_NIF}}</span>
          <span>AI: {{COMPANY_AI}}</span>
          <span>NIS: {{COMPANY_NIS}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-badge">
        <div class="doc-type">{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="doc-num">N°: {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</div>
        <div class="doc-date">{{LBL_DATE}} {{DATE}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="party-card">
      <div>
        <div class="party-title">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="party-name">{{PARTY_NAME}}</div>
        <div class="party-details">
          {{#if PARTY_ADDRESS}}<span>{{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if PARTY_PHONE}}<span> | {{LBL_TEL}}: {{PARTY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="party-fiscal">
        <div><strong>RC:</strong> {{PARTY_RC}} | <strong>NIF:</strong> {{PARTY_NIF}}</div>
        <div><strong>AI:</strong> {{PARTY_AI}} | <strong>NIS:</strong> {{PARTY_NIS}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table class="items-table">
      <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:14%;">{{LBL_REF}}</th>
        <th style="width:40%;">{{LBL_DESIGNATION}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_QTY}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="summary-section">
      <div class="words-and-payment">
        <div class="words-box">
          <div class="words-prefix">{{LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX}}</div>
          <div class="words-text">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="payment-meta">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} <span>{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="totals-box">
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{#if DISCOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="val">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TAX_TOTAL}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        <div class="totals-row net-row">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        
        {{#if REMAINING_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TOTAL_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer-sign">
      <div>Gherbi.Ai POS — نظام نقاط البيع والمحاسبة المتكامل</div>
      <div class="sign-box">{{LBL_SIGNATURE}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\licenseManager.js`

```javascript
/**
 * licenseManager.js
 * نظام إدارة التراخيص والبصمة المادية للجهاز (HWID) لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS
 * مفعّل بالكامل مدى الحياة للمالك (PRO_LIFETIME) دون أي قيود تجريبية
 */

'use strict';

const crypto = require('crypto');
const os = require('os');

let machineIdSync = null;
try {
  machineIdSync = require('node-machine-id').machineIdSync;
} catch (_) {}

function getHWID() {
  try {
    if (typeof machineIdSync === 'function') {
      const rawId = machineIdSync(true);
      return crypto
        .createHash('sha256')
        .update(`${rawId}:GHERBI_AI_POS_MASTER`)
        .digest('hex')
        .slice(0, 24)
        .toUpperCase();
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  const fallbackSeed = `${os.hostname()}-${os.platform()}-${os.arch()}-${os.cpus()[0]?.model || 'cpu'}`;
  return crypto
    .createHash('sha256')
    .update(fallbackSeed)
    .digest('hex')
    .slice(0, 24)
    .toUpperCase();
}

function getPermanentProStatus() {
  const hwid = getHWID();
  return {
    valid: true,
    isActivated: true,
    activated: true,
    isTrial: false,
    hwid,
    code: 'GHERBI-AI-PRO-LIFETIME',
    licenseKey: 'GHERBI-AI-PRO-LIFETIME',
    plan: 'PRO_LIFETIME',
    activatedAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    trialLimit: 999999999,
    limit: 999999999,
    maxSales: 999999999,
    trialUsage: 0,
    usage: 0,
    salesCount: 0,
    trialRemaining: 999999999,
    remaining: 999999999,
    salesLeft: 999999999
  };
}

function verifyLicense() {
  return getPermanentProStatus();
}

function verifyMobileLicense() {
  return true;
}

function getLicenseCode() {
  return 'GHERBI-AI-PRO-LIFETIME';
}

async function getLicenseStatus() {
  return getPermanentProStatus();
}

async function getTrialStatus() {
  return getPermanentProStatus();
}

async function activateApp(_code) {
  return {
    success: true,
    isActivated: true,
    info: getPermanentProStatus()
  };
}

async function installOfflineLicense() {
  return {
    success: true,
    isActivated: true,
    info: getPermanentProStatus()
  };
}

async function deactivateApp() {
  return {
    success: true,
    isActivated: true
  };
}

async function checkTrialBeforeSale() {
  return { blocked: false, isActivated: true };
}

async function incrementTrialUsage() {
  return true;
}

async function getPromoStatus() {
  return {
    isPromoActive: false,
    enabled: false,
    installDate: '2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    promoEndDate: '2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z'
  };
}

module.exports = {
  getHWID,
  getHwid: getHWID,
  verifyLicense,
  verifyMobileLicense,
  getLicenseCode,
  getLicenseStatus,
  activateApp,
  installOfflineLicense,
  deactivateApp,
  getTrialStatus,
  checkTrialBeforeSale,
  incrementTrialUsage,
  getPromoStatus,
  isPromoActive: getPromoStatus
};
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\main.js`

```javascript
/**
 * main.js
 * العملية الرئيسية الشاملة (Electron Main Process) لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS
 * تدير النوافذ، شاشة عرض الزبون الثانية، قاعدة البيانات، الطباعة الصامتة،
 * استيراد وتصدير Excel الكامل، النسخ الاحتياطي، القاموس الجزائري 613، الأقساط، وسجل الرقابة الأمنية
 */

'use strict';

process.env.ELECTRON_DISABLE_SECURITY_WARNINGS = 'true';

const { app, BrowserWindow, ipcMain, dialog, shell, screen } = require('electron');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const XLSX = require('xlsx');
const AdmZip = require('adm-zip');
const QRCode = require('qrcode');
const bwipjs = require('bwip-js');

const db = require('./database');
const { processImage, getImagesDir } = require('./imageUtils');
const productWriterMod = require('./product-write');
const batchAlloc = require('./batch-alloc');
const stockLedger = require('./stock-ledger');
const tillLedger = require('./till-ledger');
const analyticsQueries = require('./analytics-queries');
const productionGuard = require('./manufacturing/production-guard');
const stocktakeGuard = require('./stocktake/stocktake-guard');
const { getDataRevision } = require('./data-revision');
const lanClient = require('./api-client');
const scaleBridge = require('./scale-bridge');
const licenseManager = require('./licenseManager');
const deviceAuth = require('./device-auth');
const cloudDbSyncMod = require('./cloud-db-sync');
const cloudDiagnostics = require('./cloud-diagnostics');
const {
  startLocalServer,
  generateNextDocNumber,
  enrichProductsFull,
  getProductFullDetails,
  getPaymentDetailsFull,
  executeSaleTransaction,
  recordAuditLog,
  createInstallmentPlanRecord,
  buildProductsQueryOrder
} = require('./server');

const productWriter = productWriterMod.createProductWriter(db);

let mainWindow = null;
let customerDisplayWindow = null;
let localServerHandle = null;
let cloudDbSync = null;
let activeServerPort = 8080;

const dbGet = (sql, params = []) => db.dbGet(sql, params);
const dbAll = (sql, params = []) => db.dbAll(sql, params);
const dbRun = (sql, params = []) => db.dbRun(sql, params);

async function getSetting(key, fallback = '') {
  return await db.getSetting(key, fallback);
}

async function setSetting(key, value) {
  await dbRun('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)', [
    String(key),
    value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value)
  ]);
}

async function getAllSettingsObject() {
  const rows = await dbAll('SELECT key, value FROM settings');
  const obj = {};
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (r.value !== 'undefined' && r.value !== 'null') {
      obj[r.key] = r.value;
    }
  }
  const shopRow = await dbGet(
    'SELECT * FROM shop_info WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1'
  );
  if (shopRow) {
    if (shopRow.name && !obj.shop_name) obj.shop_name = shopRow.name;
    if (shopRow.description && !obj.shop_description) obj.shop_description = shopRow.description;
    if (shopRow.address && !obj.shop_address) obj.shop_address = shopRow.address;
    if (shopRow.phone && !obj.shop_phone) obj.shop_phone = shopRow.phone;
    if (shopRow.fax && !obj.shop_fax) obj.shop_fax = shopRow.fax;
    if (shopRow.email && !obj.shop_email) obj.shop_email = shopRow.email;
    if (shopRow.rc && !obj.shop_rc) obj.shop_rc = shopRow.rc;
    if (shopRow.nif && !obj.shop_nif) obj.shop_nif = shopRow.nif;
    if (shopRow.ai && !obj.shop_ai) obj.shop_ai = shopRow.ai;
    if (shopRow.nis && !obj.shop_nis) obj.shop_nis = shopRow.nis;
    if (shopRow.logo && !obj.shop_logo) obj.shop_logo = shopRow.logo;
  }
  return obj;
}

async function isLanClientMode() {
  const scope = (await getSetting('network_scope', 'local')).toLowerCase();
  const mode = (await getSetting('network_mode', 'server')).toLowerCase();
  if ((scope === 'local' || scope === 'lan' || scope === 'both') && mode === 'client') {
    const serverIp = await getSetting('server_ip', '192.168.1.15');
    const serverPort = Number(await getSetting('server_port', '8080')) || 8080;
    const instanceId = await getSetting('instance_id', 'lan-client');
    lanClient.setTarget(serverIp, serverPort, instanceId);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function getLocalIpv4List() {
  const nets = os.networkInterfaces();
  const list = [];
  for (const [name, addrs] of Object.entries(nets)) {
    for (const addr of addrs || []) {
      if (addr.family === 'IPv4' && !addr.internal) {
        list.push({ name, address: addr.address, netmask: addr.netmask });
      }
    }
  }
  return list;
}

function getPrimaryLocalIp() {
  const list = getLocalIpv4List();
  return list.length > 0 ? list[0].address : '127.0.0.1';
}

async function ensureSupplierByName(supplierName) {
  const clean = String(supplierName || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return null;
  const existing = await dbGet(
    'SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1',
    [clean]
  );
  if (existing) return existing.id;
  const ins = await dbRun(
    'INSERT INTO suppliers (name, initial_debt, initial_debt_paid) VALUES (?, 0, 0)',
    [clean]
  );
  return ins.lastID;
}

// ============================================================================
// إنشاء النافذة الرئيسية وشاشة عرض الزبون الثانية (Customer Facing Display)
// ============================================================================
function createMainWindow() {
  mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1420,
    height: 890,
    minWidth: 1024,
    minHeight: 700,
    title: 'Gherbi.Ai POS',
    backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
    autoHideMenuBar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      preload: path.join(__dirname, 'preload.js'),
      contextIsolation: true,
      nodeIntegration: false,
      sandbox: false
    }
  });

  mainWindow.loadFile(path.join(__dirname, 'index.html'));

  if (process.argv.includes('--dev')) {
    mainWindow.webContents.openDevTools({ mode: 'detach' });
  }

  mainWindow.on('closed', () => {
    mainWindow = null;
    if (customerDisplayWindow && !customerDisplayWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      customerDisplayWindow.close();
    }
  });
}

async function openCustomerFacingWindow() {
  if (customerDisplayWindow && !customerDisplayWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    customerDisplayWindow.focus();
    return { success: true, alreadyOpen: true };
  }

  const displays = screen.getAllDisplays();

    width: 900,

    }

      } else {

          </div>\`).join('');

}

// بث قراءات الميزان الحية إلى الواجهة الأمامية
scaleBridge.on('reading', (reading) => {

function registerIpcHandlers() {
  ipcMain.on('get-hwid-sync', (event) => {
    event.returnValue = licenseManager.getHWID();
  });

  // 1. المراجعات والإعدادات ومعلومات النظام

  ipcMain.handle('setup-first-admin', async (_e, arg1, arg2, arg3) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.setupFirstAdmin(arg1);
    const d =
      typeof arg1 === 'object' && arg1 !== null
        ? arg1
        : { name: arg1, username: arg2, password: arg3 };

    const name = String(d.name || d.username || 'Admin').trim();
    const username = String(d.username || d.name || 'admin').trim();
    const rawPass = String(d.password || '1234');
    const hashed = bcrypt.hashSync(rawPass, 10);

    await dbRun(
      "UPDATE users SET username = username || '~del~' || id WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND username NOT LIKE '%~del~%'"
    );

    const existing = await dbGet(
      'SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ? COLLATE NOCASE LIMIT 1',
      [username]
    );

    let userId;
    if (existing && existing.id) {
      userId = existing.id;
      await dbRun(
        "UPDATE users SET name = ?, username = ?, password = ?, role = 'Admin', status = 'Active', deleted_at = NULL WHERE id = ?",
        [name, username, hashed, userId]
      );
    } else {
      const ins = await dbRun(
        "INSERT INTO users (name, username, password, role, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'Admin', 'Active')",
        [name, username, hashed]
      );
      userId = ins.lastID;
    }

    const userObj = { id: userId, name, username, role: 'Admin', status: 'Active' };
    return { success: true, ok: true, ...userObj, user: userObj };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('login-user', async (_e, arg1, arg2) => {
    const username = String(
      (typeof arg1 === 'object' && arg1 !== null ? arg1.username : arg1) || ''
    ).trim();
    const password = String(
      (typeof arg1 === 'object' && arg1 !== null ? arg1.password : arg2) || ''
    );
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.loginUser(username, password);

    const user = await dbGet(
      'SELECT id, name, username, password, role, permissions_json, status FROM users WHERE username = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1',
      [username]
    );
    if (!user) return { success: false, error: 'invalid_creds' };
    if (user.status && String(user.status).toLowerCase() !== 'active') {
      return { success: false, error: 'account_disabled' };
    }

    let valid = false;
    if (String(user.password || '').startsWith('$2')) {
      valid = bcrypt.compareSync(password, user.password);
    } else {
      const sha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(password).digest('hex');
      valid = user.password === password || user.password === sha;
      if (valid) {
        await dbRun('UPDATE users SET password = ? WHERE id = ?', [
          bcrypt.hashSync(password, 10),
          user.id
        ]);
      }
    }

    if (!valid) {
      await recordAuditLog({
        user_name: username,
        action_type: 'login_failed',
        severity: 'warning',
        details: { attempted_username: username }
      });
      return { success: false, error: 'invalid_creds' };
    }

    const safeUser = {
      id: user.id,
      name: user.name,
      username: user.username,
      role: user.role || 'Admin',
      permissions_json: user.permissions_json || null,
      status: user.status || 'Active'
    };
    return { success: true, ok: true, ...safeUser, user: safeUser };
  });

    const perms = u.permissions_json
      ? typeof u.permissions_json === 'string'
        ? u.permissions_json
        : JSON.stringify(u.permissions_json)
      : null;
    const status = u.status || 'Active';

    await dbRun(
      "UPDATE users SET username = username || '~del~' || id WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND username NOT LIKE '%~del~%'"
    );
    const existing = await dbGet(
      'SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND deleted_at IS NULL',
      [username]
    );
    if (existing) {
      await dbRun(
        'UPDATE users SET name = ?, password = ?, role = ?, permissions_json = ?, status = ? WHERE id = ?',
        [name, hashed, role, perms, status, existing.id]
      );
      return { success: true, id: existing.id };
    }
    const ins = await dbRun(
      'INSERT INTO users (name, username, password, role, permissions_json, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [name, username, hashed, role, perms, status]
    );
    return { success: true, id: ins.lastID };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-products', async (_e, filters = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getProducts(filters);
    const conds = ['p.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const params = [];

    if (filters && filters.category) {
      conds.push('p.category = ?');
      params.push(filters.category);
    }
    if (filters && filters.family) {
      conds.push('p.family = ?');
      params.push(filters.family);
    }
    if (filters && filters.supplier) {
      conds.push('p.supplier = ?');
      params.push(filters.supplier);
    }
    if (filters && filters.search) {
      const q = `%${String(filters.search).trim()}%`;
      conds.push('(p.name LIKE ? OR p.barcode LIKE ? OR p.category LIKE ? OR p.plu_code LIKE ?)');
      params.push(q, q, q, q);
    }

    const { stockJoinSql, orderBySql } = buildProductsQueryOrder(filters && filters.sort);
    const rows = await dbAll(
      `SELECT p.* FROM products p ${stockJoinSql} WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')} ${orderBySql}`,
      params
    );
    return await enrichProductsFull(rows);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-product-analytics', async (_e, productId) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getProductAnalytics(productId);
    const pid = Number(productId);
    const summary = await dbGet(
      `SELECT
         COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity), 0) AS total_sold_qty,
         COALESCE(SUM(si.subtotal), 0) AS total_revenue,
         COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity * COALESCE(si.cost_price, ib.cost_price, 0)), 0) AS total_cost
       FROM sale_items si
       INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
       LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.id = si.batch_id
       WHERE si.product_id = ? AND si.deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [pid]
    );
    const rev = Number((summary && summary.total_revenue) || 0);
    const cost = Number((summary && summary.total_cost) || 0);
    return {
      product_id: pid,
      total_sold_qty: Number((summary && summary.total_sold_qty) || 0),
      total_revenue: rev,
      total_cost: cost,
      total_profit: Number((rev - cost).toFixed(2))
    };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('add-product', async (_e, p = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addProduct(p);
    const barcode = p.barcode ? String(p.barcode).trim() : null;
    if (barcode) await productWriter.freeTombstonedProductBarcode(barcode);
    if (p.supplier) await ensureSupplierByName(p.supplier);

    const img = p.image ? processImage(p.image) : null;

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const ins = await dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO products (
          barcode, name, category, family, supplier, description, min_stock,
          image, unit, color, weight_volume, wholesale_unit, wholesale_qty,
          plu_code, has_variants, is_featured, material_role, track_serial, warranty_months, hide_from_pos
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          barcode,
          String(p.name || 'منتج جديد').trim(),
          p.category || 'عام',
          p.family || null,
          p.supplier || null,
          p.description || null,
          Number(p.min_stock ?? 5),
          img,
          p.unit || 'قطعة',
          p.color || null,
          p.weight_volume || null,
          p.wholesale_unit || null,
          p.wholesale_qty ? Number(p.wholesale_qty) : null,
          p.plu_code || null,
          p.has_variants ? 1 : 0,
          p.is_featured ? 1 : 0,
          p.material_role || null,
          p.track_serial ? 1 : 0,
          Number(p.warranty_months ?? 0),
          p.hide_from_pos ? 1 : 0
        ]
      );
      const productId = ins.lastID;

      await productWriter.insertExtraBarcodesAndPrices(
        productId,
        p.extra_barcodes || p.barcodes || [],
        p.extra_prices || p.prices || []
      );

      if (p.has_variants && Array.isArray(p.variants) && p.variants.length > 0) {
        await productWriter.insertVariantData(
          productId,
          p.option_groups || [],
          p.variants,
          p.location || null
        );
      } else {
        await dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO inventory_batches (
            product_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price, wholesale_price, expiry_date, location
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          [
            productId,
            Number(p.stock ?? 0),
            Number(p.cost_price ?? 0),
            Number(p.selling_price ?? 0),
            p.wholesale_price !== undefined && p.wholesale_price !== ''
              ? Number(p.wholesale_price)
              : null,
            p.expiry_date || null,
            p.location || null
          ]
        );
      }

      return { success: true, id: productId };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-sales', async (_e, filters = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getSales(filters);
    const conds = ['s.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const params = [];

    if (filters.customerId || filters.customer_id) {
      conds.push('s.customer_id = ?');
      params.push(Number(filters.customerId || filters.customer_id));
    }
    if (filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from) {
      conds.push('date(s.sale_date) >= date(?)');
      params.push(String(filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from).slice(0, 10));
    }
    if (filters.dateTo || filters.date_to) {
      conds.push('date(s.sale_date) <= date(?)');
      params.push(String(filters.dateTo || filters.date_to).slice(0, 10));
    }

    return await dbAll(
      `SELECT
         s.*,
         c.name AS customer_name,
         c.phone AS customer_phone,
         u.name AS seller_name
       FROM sales s
       LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
       LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
       WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')}
       ORDER BY s.id DESC
       LIMIT 500`,
      params
    );

  ipcMain.handle('get-sale-details', async (_e, saleId) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getSaleDetails(saleId);
    const sid = Number(saleId);
    const sale = await dbGet(
      `SELECT
         s.*,
         c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, c.address AS customer_address,
         c.rc AS customer_rc, c.nif AS customer_nif, c.ai AS customer_ai, c.nis AS customer_nis,
         u.name AS seller_name
       FROM sales s
       LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
       LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
       WHERE s.id = ? AND s.deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [sid]
    );
    if (!sale) return null;

    sale.items = await dbAll(
      `SELECT
         si.*,
         COALESCE(p.name, si.custom_product_name, 'منتج') AS product_name,
         p.barcode AS product_barcode,
         p.unit AS product_unit
       FROM sale_items si
       LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
       WHERE si.sale_id = ? AND si.deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [sid]
    );
    sale.payments = await dbAll(
      'SELECT * FROM sale_payments WHERE sale_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC',
      [sid]
    );
    return sale;
  });

  ipcMain.handle('add-sale-payment', async (_e, saleId, amount, date, meta = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addSalePayment(saleId, amount, date, meta);
    const sid = Number(saleId);
    const amt = Number(amount || 0);
    const payDate = date || new Date().toISOString();
    const sale = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM sales WHERE id = ?', [sid]);
    if (!sale) throw new Error('الفاتورة غير موجودة');

    const receiptNum = await generateNextDocNumber('payment_receipt');
    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const ins = await dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO sale_payments (sale_id, customer_id, amount, date, payment_method, reference, receipt_number, notes)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          sid,
          sale.customer_id,
          amt,
          payDate,
          meta.payment_method || 'cash',
          meta.reference || null,
          receiptNum,
          meta.notes || null
        ]
      );
      await dbRun('UPDATE sales SET paid_amount = COALESCE(paid_amount, 0) + ? WHERE id = ?', [
        amt,
        sid
      ]);
      const activeSess = await tillLedger.resolveOpenSession(db, null, meta.userId);
      if (activeSess && (!meta.payment_method || meta.payment_method === 'cash')) {
        await dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO caisse_transactions (session_id, type, amount, category, description, reference_id)
           VALUES (?, 'debt_payment', ?, 'sales', ?, ?)`,
          [activeSess, amt, `تسديد فاتورة بيع #${sid}`, ins.lastID]
        );
      }
      return { success: true, paymentId: ins.lastID, receiptNumber: receiptNum };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('delete-sale', async (_e, saleId) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.deleteSale(saleId);
    const sid = Number(saleId);
    const items = await dbAll(
      'SELECT * FROM sale_items WHERE sale_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL',
      [sid]
    );

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      for (const it of items) {
        if (it.batch_id && Number(it.sold_without_stock || 0) === 0) {
          await batchAlloc.restoreBatch(db, {
            batchId: it.batch_id,
            quantity: it.quantity,
            soldWithoutStock: it.sold_without_stock
          });
        }
      }
      await tillLedger.reverseSaleTill(db, sid);
      await dbRun('DELETE FROM stock_debt WHERE sale_id = ?', [sid]);
      await dbRun('DELETE FROM sale_payments WHERE sale_id = ?', [sid]);
      await dbRun('DELETE FROM sale_items WHERE sale_id = ?', [sid]);
      await dbRun('DELETE FROM sales WHERE id = ?', [sid]);
      return { success: true };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-customer-credit-summary', async (_e, customerId, excludeSaleId = null) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getCustomerCreditSummary(customerId, excludeSaleId);
    const cid = Number(customerId);
    const cust = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [cid]);
    if (!cust) return null;

    const salesDebtRow = await dbGet(
      `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total - paid_amount), 0) AS sales_debt
       FROM sales
       WHERE customer_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (? IS NULL OR id <> ?)`,
      [cid, excludeSaleId, excludeSaleId]
    );

    const initDebt = Math.max(0, Number(cust.initial_debt || 0) - Number(cust.initial_debt_paid || 0));
    const currentDebt = Number((initDebt + Number((salesDebtRow && salesDebtRow.sales_debt) || 0)).toFixed(2));
    const creditLimit = Number(cust.credit_limit || 0);

    return {
      customer_id: cid,
      name: cust.name,
      current_debt: currentDebt,
      credit_limit: creditLimit,
      available_credit: creditLimit > 0 ? Math.max(0, Number((creditLimit - currentDebt).toFixed(2))) : null,
      exceeded: creditLimit > 0 && currentDebt > creditLimit
    };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('add-customer-payment', async (_e, customerId, amount, date, meta = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addCustomerPayment(customerId, amount, date, meta);
    const cid = Number(customerId);
    let remainingAmt = Number(amount || 0);
    const payDate = date || new Date().toISOString();
    const receiptNum = await generateNextDocNumber('payment_receipt');

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const cust = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id = ?', [cid]);
      if (cust) {
        const initRem = Math.max(0, Number(cust.initial_debt || 0) - Number(cust.initial_debt_paid || 0));
        if (initRem > 0 && remainingAmt > 0) {
          const takeInit = Math.min(initRem, remainingAmt);
          await dbRun(
            'UPDATE customers SET initial_debt_paid = COALESCE(initial_debt_paid, 0) + ? WHERE id = ?',
            [takeInit, cid]
          );
          remainingAmt = Number((remainingAmt - takeInit).toFixed(2));
        }
      }

      const unpaidSales = await dbAll(
        'SELECT id, total, paid_amount FROM sales WHERE customer_id = ? AND (total - paid_amount) > 0.009 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sale_date ASC, id ASC',
        [cid]
      );

      for (const s of unpaidSales) {
        if (remainingAmt <= 0.009) break;
        const due = Number((Number(s.total) - Number(s.paid_amount)).toFixed(2));
        const apply = Math.min(due, remainingAmt);
        await dbRun('UPDATE sales SET paid_amount = paid_amount + ? WHERE id = ?', [apply, s.id]);
        remainingAmt = Number((remainingAmt - apply).toFixed(2));
      }

      const ins = await dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO sale_payments (sale_id, customer_id, amount, date, payment_method, reference, receipt_number, notes)
         VALUES (NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          cid,
          Number(amount || 0),
          payDate,
          meta.payment_method || 'cash',
          meta.reference || null,
          receiptNum,
          meta.notes || null
        ]
      );

      const activeSess = await tillLedger.resolveOpenSession(db, null, meta.userId);
      if (activeSess && (!meta.payment_method || meta.payment_method === 'cash')) {
        await dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO caisse_transactions (session_id, type, amount, category, description, reference_id)
           VALUES (?, 'debt_payment', ?, 'sales', ?, ?)`,
          [activeSess, Number(amount || 0), `تسديد دين زبون #${cid}`, ins.lastID]
        );
      }

      return { success: true, paymentId: ins.lastID, receiptNumber: receiptNum };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-customer-sales-aggregated', async (_e, payload = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getCustomerSalesAggregated(payload);
    const cid = Number(payload.customerId || payload.customer_id);
    const dateFrom = payload.dateFrom || payload.date_from || null;
    const dateTo = payload.dateTo || payload.date_to || null;

    const conds = ['s.customer_id = ?', 's.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const params = [cid];
    if (dateFrom) { conds.push('date(s.sale_date) >= date(?)'); params.push(String(dateFrom).slice(0, 10)); }
    if (dateTo) { conds.push('date(s.sale_date) <= date(?)'); params.push(String(dateTo).slice(0, 10)); }

    const sales = await dbAll(
      `SELECT * FROM sales s WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')} ORDER BY s.sale_date ASC`,
      params
    );
    const items = await dbAll(
      `SELECT
         COALESCE(p.name, si.custom_product_name, 'منتج') AS product_name,
         p.barcode AS product_barcode,
         p.unit,
         SUM(si.quantity) AS total_qty,
         AVG(si.price) AS avg_price,
         SUM(si.subtotal) AS total_subtotal
       FROM sale_items si
       INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
       LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
       WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')} AND si.deleted_at IS NULL
       GROUP BY COALESCE(si.product_id, si.custom_product_name)`,
      params
    );
    return { sales, items };
  });
```
