```javascript
  ipcMain.handle('add-supplier-payment', async (_e, supplierId, amount, date, meta = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addSupplierPayment(supplierId, amount, date, meta);
    const sid = Number(supplierId);
    let rem = Number(amount || 0);
    const payDate = date || new Date().toISOString();
    const receiptNum = await generateNextDocNumber('payment_receipt');

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const sup = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM suppliers WHERE id = ?', [sid]);
      if (sup) {
        const initRem = Math.max(0, Number(sup.initial_debt || 0) - Number(sup.initial_debt_paid || 0));
        if (initRem > 0 && rem > 0) {
          const take = Math.min(initRem, rem);
          await dbRun(
            'UPDATE suppliers SET initial_debt_paid = COALESCE(initial_debt_paid, 0) + ? WHERE id = ?',
            [take, sid]
          );
          rem = Number((rem - take).toFixed(2));
        }
      }

      const openInvoices = await dbAll(
        'SELECT id, total, paid_amount FROM purchase_invoices WHERE supplier_id = ? AND (total - paid_amount) > 0.009 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY date ASC, id ASC',
        [sid]
      );
      for (const inv of openInvoices) {
        if (rem <= 0.009) break;
        const due = Number((Number(inv.total) - Number(inv.paid_amount)).toFixed(2));
        const apply = Math.min(due, rem);
        await dbRun('UPDATE purchase_invoices SET paid_amount = paid_amount + ? WHERE id = ?', [
          apply,
          inv.id
        ]);
        rem = Number((rem - apply).toFixed(2));
      }

      const ins = await dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO invoice_payments (invoice_id, supplier_id, amount, date, payment_method, reference, receipt_number, notes)
         VALUES (NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          sid,
          Number(amount || 0),
          payDate,
          meta.payment_method || 'cash',
          meta.reference || null,
          receiptNum,
          meta.notes || null
        ]
      );

      return { success: true, paymentId: ins.lastID, receiptNumber: receiptNum };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('save-purchase', async (_e, data = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.savePurchase(data);
    const items = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : [];
    const supplierId = data.supplier_id || data.supplierId ? Number(data.supplier_id || data.supplierId) : null;
    const subtotal = Number(data.subtotal ?? 0);
    const taxPercentage = Number(data.tax_percentage ?? 0);
    const additionalCosts = Number(data.additional_costs ?? 0);
    const total = Number(data.total ?? 0);
    const paidAmount = Number(data.paid_amount ?? 0);
    const invDate = data.date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const invNumber = data.invoice_number || `ACH-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(Date.now()).slice(-4)}`;

    const totalUnits = items.reduce((sum, it) => sum + Math.max(0, Number(it.quantity || 0)), 0);
    const extraCostPerUnit = totalUnits > 0 ? additionalCosts / totalUnits : 0;

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const ins = await dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO purchase_invoices (
          invoice_number, supplier_id, subtotal, tax_percentage, additional_costs, total, paid_amount, due_date, date
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [invNumber, supplierId, subtotal, taxPercentage, additionalCosts, total, paidAmount, data.due_date || null, invDate]
      );
      const invoiceId = ins.lastID;

      if (paidAmount > 0) {
        await dbRun(
          'INSERT INTO invoice_payments (invoice_id, supplier_id, amount, date, payment_method) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
          [invoiceId, supplierId, paidAmount, invDate, 'cash']
        );
      }

      for (const it of items) {
        const pid = Number(it.product_id || it.productId);
        const qty = Number(it.quantity ?? 1);
        const baseCost = Number(it.cost_price ?? 0);
        const effectiveCostPrice = Number((baseCost + extraCostPerUnit).toFixed(2));
        const sellPrice = Number(it.selling_price ?? 0);

        const batchIns = await dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO inventory_batches (
            product_id, variant_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price, wholesale_price, expiry_date, location, supplier_id
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          [
            pid,
            it.variant_id || null,
            qty,
            effectiveCostPrice,
            sellPrice,
            it.wholesale_price || null,
            it.expiry_date || null,
            it.location || null,
            supplierId
          ]
        );

        await dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO purchase_items (
            invoice_id, product_id, batch_id, variant_id, quantity, cost_price, selling_price, total_cost
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          [
            invoiceId,
            pid,
            batchIns.lastID,
            it.variant_id || null,
            qty,
            effectiveCostPrice,
            sellPrice,
            Number((qty * effectiveCostPrice).toFixed(2))
          ]
        );

        await batchAlloc.reconcileStockDebt(db, pid, batchIns.lastID);
      }

      return { success: true, id: invoiceId, invoice_number: invNumber };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('add-invoice-payment', async (_e, invoiceId, amount, date, meta = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addInvoicePayment(invoiceId, amount, date, meta);
    const id = Number(invoiceId);
    const amt = Number(amount || 0);
    const inv = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM purchase_invoices WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    if (!inv) throw new Error('فاتورة الشراء غير موجودة');

    const receiptNum = await generateNextDocNumber('payment_receipt');
    await dbRun('UPDATE purchase_invoices SET paid_amount = COALESCE(paid_amount, 0) + ? WHERE id = ?', [amt, id]);
    const ins = await dbRun(
      'INSERT INTO invoice_payments (invoice_id, supplier_id, amount, date, payment_method, receipt_number) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [id, inv.supplier_id, amt, date || new Date().toISOString(), meta.payment_method || 'cash', receiptNum]
    );
    return { success: true, paymentId: ins.lastID, receiptNumber: receiptNum };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('delete-purchase', async (_e, invoiceId) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.deletePurchase(invoiceId);
    const id = Number(invoiceId);
    const items = await dbAll('SELECT batch_id FROM purchase_items WHERE invoice_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [id]);
    const batchIds = items.map((x) => x.batch_id).filter(Boolean);
    if (batchIds.length > 0) await batchAlloc.voidBatches(db, batchIds);
    await dbRun('DELETE FROM invoice_payments WHERE invoice_id = ?', [id]);
    await dbRun('DELETE FROM purchase_items WHERE invoice_id = ?', [id]);
    await dbRun('DELETE FROM purchase_invoices WHERE id = ?', [id]);
    return { success: true };
  });

    return await dbAll(
      `SELECT ib.*, p.name AS product_name, p.barcode, p.unit
       FROM inventory_batches ib
       INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = ib.product_id
       WHERE ib.supplier_id = ? AND ib.stock > 0 AND ib.deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [Number(supplierId)]
    );

  ipcMain.handle('save-supplier-return', async (_e, data = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.saveSupplierReturn(data);
    const returnNum = data.return_number || (await generateNextDocNumber('supplier_return'));
    const items = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : [];
    const total = Number(data.total ?? 0);

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const ins = await dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO supplier_returns (
          return_number, supplier_id, subtotal, total, credit_applied, refund_amount, refund_method, reason, notes, date
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          returnNum,
          Number(data.supplier_id),
          total,
          total,
          Number(data.credit_applied ?? total),
          Number(data.refund_amount ?? 0),
          data.refund_method || 'credit',
          data.reason || null,
          data.notes || null,
          data.date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
        ]
      );
      const returnId = ins.lastID;

      for (const it of items) {
        const qty = Number(it.quantity ?? 1);
        if (it.batch_id) {
          await dbRun('UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = MAX(0, COALESCE(stock, 0) - ?) WHERE id = ?', [
            qty,
            Number(it.batch_id)
          ]);
        }
        await dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO supplier_return_items (
            return_id, product_id, variant_id, batch_id, quantity, cost_price, total_cost
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          [
            returnId,
            Number(it.product_id),
            it.variant_id || null,
            it.batch_id || null,
            qty,
            Number(it.cost_price ?? 0),
            Number((qty * Number(it.cost_price ?? 0)).toFixed(2))
          ]
        );
      }
      return { success: true, id: returnId, return_number: returnNum };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('create-proforma', async (_e, d = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.createProforma(d);
    const docNum = d.doc_number || (await generateNextDocNumber('proforma'));
    const items = Array.isArray(d.items) ? d.items : [];
    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const ins = await dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO proforma_invoices (
          doc_number, customer_id, subtotal, tax_percentage, discount, total, validity_days, notes, status, user_id
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', ?)`,
        [
          docNum,
          d.customer_id || null,
          Number(d.subtotal ?? 0),
          Number(d.tax_percentage ?? 0),
          Number(d.discount ?? 0),
          Number(d.total ?? 0),
          Number(d.validity_days ?? 15),
          d.notes || null,
          d.user_id || null
        ]
      );
      const pid = ins.lastID;
      for (const it of items) {
        await dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO proforma_items (proforma_id, product_id, batch_id, variant_id, quantity, price, subtotal, custom_product_name)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          [
            pid,
            it.product_id || null,
            it.batch_id || null,
            it.variant_id || null,
            Number(it.quantity ?? 1),
            Number(it.price ?? 0),
            Number(it.subtotal ?? 0),
            it.custom_product_name || it.name || null
          ]
        );
      }
      return { success: true, id: pid, doc_number: docNum };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('check-proforma-stock', async (_e, proformaId) => {
    const pid = Number(proformaId);
    const items = await dbAll(
      `SELECT pi.product_id, pi.variant_id, pi.quantity, pi.custom_product_name, p.name AS product_name
       FROM proforma_items pi
       LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = pi.product_id
       WHERE pi.proforma_id = ? AND pi.deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [pid]
    );
    const shortages = [];
    for (const it of items) {
      if (!it.product_id) continue;
      const row = await dbGet(
        'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(stock), 0) AS available FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL',
        [it.product_id]
      );
      const avail = Number((row && row.available) || 0);
      if (avail < Number(it.quantity || 0)) {
        shortages.push({
          product_id: it.product_id,
          product_name: it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || 'منتج',
          requested: Number(it.quantity || 0),
          available: avail,
          shortage: Number((Number(it.quantity || 0) - avail).toFixed(3))
        });
      }
    }
    return { ok: shortages.length === 0, shortages };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('convert-proforma-to-sale', async (_e, proformaId, extra = {}) => {
    const pid = Number(proformaId);
    const head = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM proforma_invoices WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [pid]);
    if (!head) throw new Error('الفاتورة الشكلية غير موجودة');
    const items = await dbAll('SELECT * FROM proforma_items WHERE proforma_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [pid]);
    const saleOut = await executeSaleTransaction({
      customer_id: head.customer_id,
      subtotal: head.subtotal,
      tax_percentage: head.tax_percentage,
      discount: head.discount,
      total: head.total,
      paid_amount: extra.paid_amount !== undefined ? Number(extra.paid_amount) : head.total,
      payment_method: extra.payment_method || 'cash',
      items
    });
    await dbRun(
      "UPDATE proforma_invoices SET status = 'converted', converted_to_sale_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
      [saleOut.saleId, pid]
    );
    return { success: true, saleId: saleOut.saleId, docNumber: saleOut.docNumber };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('create-order', async (_e, d = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.createOrder(d);
    const docNum = d.doc_number || (await generateNextDocNumber('order'));
    const items = Array.isArray(d.items) ? d.items : [];
    const deposit = Number(d.deposit_amount ?? 0);

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const ins = await dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO customer_orders (
          doc_number, customer_id, subtotal, tax_percentage, discount, total,
          deposit_amount, expected_delivery_date, notes, status, reserves_stock, user_id
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', ?, ?)`,
        [
          docNum,
          d.customer_id || null,
          Number(d.subtotal ?? 0),
          Number(d.tax_percentage ?? 0),
          Number(d.discount ?? 0),
          Number(d.total ?? 0),
          deposit,
          d.expected_delivery_date || null,
          d.notes || null,
          d.reserves_stock !== undefined ? (d.reserves_stock ? 1 : 0) : 1,
          d.user_id || null
        ]
      );
      const oid = ins.lastID;
      for (const it of items) {
        await dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO customer_order_items (order_id, product_id, batch_id, variant_id, quantity, price, subtotal, custom_product_name)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          [
            oid,
            it.product_id || null,
            it.batch_id || null,
            it.variant_id || null,
            Number(it.quantity ?? 1),
            Number(it.price ?? 0),
            Number(it.subtotal ?? 0),
            it.custom_product_name || it.name || null
          ]
        );
        if (d.reserves_stock !== false && it.product_id) {
          await dbRun(
            'INSERT INTO inventory_reservations (order_id, batch_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
            [oid, it.batch_id || null, Number(it.product_id), Number(it.quantity ?? 1)]
          );
        }
      }

      if (deposit > 0) {
        const activeSess = await tillLedger.resolveOpenSession(db, null, d.user_id);
        if (activeSess) {
          await dbRun(
            `INSERT INTO caisse_transactions (session_id, type, amount, category, description, reference_id)
             VALUES (?, 'order_deposit', ?, 'orders', ?, ?)`,
            [activeSess, deposit, `عربون طلبية #${docNum}`, oid]
          );
        }
      }
      return { success: true, id: oid, doc_number: docNum };
    });
  });

  // 7. الخزينة والمناوبات، المصاريف، رأس المال، الباقات، والعروض
  ipcMain.handle('open-caisse-session', async (_e, payload = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.openCaisseSession(payload);
    const userId =
      typeof payload === 'object' ? payload.userId || payload.user_id : Number(payload);
    const openingBalance =
      typeof payload === 'object' ? Number(payload.openingBalance ?? payload.opening_balance ?? 0) : 0;
    const deviceId = await getSetting('instance_id', 'local');

    const ins = await dbRun(
      `INSERT INTO caisse_sessions (user_id, device_id, opening_balance, status, opened_at)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'open', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)`,
      [userId || null, deviceId, openingBalance]
    );
    return await tillLedger.computeSessionSummary(db, ins.lastID);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('close-caisse-session', async (_e, payload = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.closeCaisseSession(payload);
    const sessionId = Number(payload.sessionId || payload.session_id || payload.id);
    const closingBalance = Number(payload.closingBalance ?? payload.closing_balance ?? 0);
    const closeNote = payload.closeNote || payload.close_note || payload.note || null;

    const info = await tillLedger.computeSessionSummary(db, sessionId);
    const expected = info ? info.summary.expectedBalance : 0;
    const diff = Number((closingBalance - expected).toFixed(2));

    await dbRun(
      `UPDATE caisse_sessions
       SET closing_balance = ?, expected_balance = ?, difference = ?,
           status = 'closed', closed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, close_note = ?
       WHERE id = ?`,
      [closingBalance, expected, diff, closeNote, sessionId]
    );
    return { success: true, sessionId, expectedBalance: expected, closingBalance, difference: diff };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-active-session', async (_e, userId) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getActiveSession(userId);
    const uid = typeof userId === 'object' && userId !== null ? userId.userId : userId;
    const deviceId = await getSetting('instance_id', 'local');
    const sessId = await tillLedger.resolveOpenSession(db, null, uid, deviceId);
    if (!sessId) return null;
    return await tillLedger.computeSessionSummary(db, sessId);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('add-expense', async (_e, exp = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addExpense(exp);
    const amt = Number(exp.amount || 0);
    const ins = await dbRun(
      'INSERT INTO expenses (category, description, amount, date, user_id, session_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [
        exp.category || 'عام',
        exp.description || null,
        amt,
        exp.date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        exp.user_id || null,
        exp.session_id || null
      ]
    );
    if (exp.deductFromCaisse || exp.session_id) {
      const sessId = await tillLedger.resolveOpenSession(db, exp.session_id, exp.user_id);
      if (sessId) {
        await dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO caisse_transactions (session_id, type, amount, category, description, reference_id)
           VALUES (?, 'expense', ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          [sessId, amt, exp.category || 'عام', exp.description || 'مصروف', ins.lastID]
        );
      }
    }
    return { success: true, id: ins.lastID };

  ipcMain.handle('save-bundle', async (_e, data = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.saveBundle(data);
    const items = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : [];
    const barcode = data.barcode ? String(data.barcode).trim() : null;
    if (barcode) await productWriter.freeTombstonedProductBarcode(barcode);

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      let bid = data.id ? Number(data.id) : null;
      if (bid) {
        await dbRun(
          'UPDATE product_bundles SET name = ?, barcode = ?, selling_price = ?, cost_price = ?, description = ?, is_active = ? WHERE id = ?',
          [
            String(data.name || '').trim(),
            barcode,
            Number(data.selling_price ?? 0),
            Number(data.cost_price ?? 0),
            data.description || null,
            data.is_active !== undefined ? (data.is_active ? 1 : 0) : 1,
            bid
          ]
        );
        await dbRun('DELETE FROM bundle_items WHERE bundle_id = ?', [bid]);
      } else {
        const ins = await dbRun(
          'INSERT INTO product_bundles (name, barcode, selling_price, cost_price, description, is_active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)',
          [
            String(data.name || '').trim(),
            barcode,
            Number(data.selling_price ?? 0),
            Number(data.cost_price ?? 0),
            data.description || null
          ]
        );
        bid = ins.lastID;
      }

      for (const it of items) {
        await dbRun('INSERT INTO bundle_items (bundle_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', [
          bid,
          Number(it.product_id || it.productId),
          Number(it.quantity ?? 1)
        ]);
      }
      return { success: true, id: bid };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-notifications', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getNotifications();
    const lowStock = await dbAll(
      `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.min_stock, p.unit, COALESCE(SUM(ib.stock), 0) AS stock
       FROM products p
       LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.product_id = p.id AND ib.deleted_at IS NULL
       WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
       GROUP BY p.id
       HAVING stock <= COALESCE(p.min_stock, 5)
       LIMIT 50`
    );
    const expiring = await dbAll(
      `SELECT ib.id, p.id AS product_id, p.name, ib.stock, ib.expiry_date
       FROM inventory_batches ib
       INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = ib.product_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
       WHERE ib.deleted_at IS NULL AND ib.stock > 0
         AND ib.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ib.expiry_date) <> ''
         AND date(ib.expiry_date) <= date('now', '+30 days')
       ORDER BY date(ib.expiry_date) ASC LIMIT 50`
    );
    const dueInstallments = await dbAll(
      `SELECT s.*, p.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone
       FROM installment_schedules s
       INNER JOIN installment_plans p ON p.id = s.plan_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
       LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id
       WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.status <> 'paid'
         AND date(s.due_date) <= date('now', '+7 days')
       ORDER BY date(s.due_date) ASC LIMIT 50`
    );
    return { lowStock, expiring, dueInstallments };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('lookup-warranty-serial', async (_e, rawSerial) => {
    const serial = String(rawSerial || '').trim();
    if (!serial) return null;

    const item = await dbGet(
      `SELECT
         si.*,
         COALESCE(p.name, si.custom_product_name, 'منتج') AS product_name,
         p.barcode AS product_barcode,
         p.warranty_months AS default_warranty_months,
         s.doc_number,
         s.sale_date,
         s.total AS sale_total,
         c.name AS customer_name,
         c.phone AS customer_phone
       FROM sale_items si
       INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
       LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
       LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
       WHERE si.serial_number = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND si.deleted_at IS NULL
       ORDER BY si.id DESC LIMIT 1`,
      [serial]
    );

    if (!item) return { found: false, serial };

    const months = Number(item.warranty_months || item.default_warranty_months || 12);
    const startDate = new Date(item.sale_date || Date.now());
    const endDate = new Date(startDate);
    endDate.setMonth(endDate.getMonth() + months);
    const daysLeft = Math.ceil((endDate.getTime() - Date.now()) / 86400000);

    return {
      found: true,
      serial,
      sale_id: item.sale_id,
      doc_number: item.doc_number || ('#' + item.sale_id),
      sale_date: String(item.sale_date || '').slice(0, 10),
      product_name: item.product_name,
      product_barcode: item.product_barcode || '',
      price: item.price,
      customer_name: item.customer_name || 'زبون عابر',
      customer_phone: item.customer_phone || '',
      warranty_months: months,
      warranty_end_date: endDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      days_remaining: daysLeft,
      is_valid: daysLeft >= 0
    };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('import-dz-dictionary-csv', async () => {
    const { canceled, filePaths } = await dialog.showOpenDialog(mainWindow, {
      title: 'استيراد قاموس المنتجات الجزائرية (CSV / Excel)',
      properties: ['openFile'],
      filters: [{ name: 'CSV / Excel', extensions: ['csv', 'xlsx', 'xls'] }]
    });
    if (canceled || !filePaths || filePaths.length === 0) return { canceled: true };

    const wb = XLSX.readFile(filePaths[0], { raw: false });
    const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]]);
    let imported = 0;

    await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const stmt = db._rawPrepare(
        'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dz_product_dictionary (barcode, name, category, brand, unit, suggested_price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
      );
      for (const r of rows) {
        const bc = String(r.barcode || r.code || r['الباركود'] || '').trim();
        const name = String(r.name || r.product_name || r['الاسم'] || '').trim();
        if (!bc || !name) continue;
        const cat = String(r.category || r['الفئة'] || 'مواد غذائية').trim().slice(0, 50);
        const brand = String(r.supplier || r.brand || r['الماركة'] || '').trim().slice(0, 50);
        const unit = String(r.unit || r['الوحدة'] || 'قطعة').trim();
        const price = Number(r.selling_price || r.suggested_price || 0) || 0;
        stmt.run(bc, name.slice(0, 120), cat, brand, unit, price);
        imported += 1;
      }
      stmt.finalize();
    });

    return { success: true, imported };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('pay-installment-schedule', async (_e, scheduleId, amount) => {
    const sid = Number(scheduleId);
    const sched = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM installment_schedules WHERE id = ?', [sid]);
    if (!sched) throw new Error('القسط المطلوب غير موجود');
    const payAmt = amount !== undefined ? Number(amount) : Number(sched.amount) - Number(sched.paid_amount || 0);
    const newPaid = Number((Number(sched.paid_amount || 0) + payAmt).toFixed(2));
    const newStatus = newPaid >= Number(sched.amount) - 0.01 ? 'paid' : 'partial';
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      await dbRun(
        'UPDATE installment_schedules SET paid_amount = ?, status = ?, paid_at = ? WHERE id = ?',
        [newPaid, newStatus, nowIso, sid]
      );
      await dbRun(
        'UPDATE installment_plans SET remaining_amount = MAX(0, COALESCE(remaining_amount, 0) - ?) WHERE id = ?',
        [payAmt, sched.plan_id]
      );
      const pendingRow = await dbGet(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM installment_schedules WHERE plan_id = ? AND status <> 'paid' AND deleted_at IS NULL",
        [sched.plan_id]
      );
      if (Number((pendingRow && pendingRow.c) || 0) === 0) {
        await dbRun("UPDATE installment_plans SET status = 'completed' WHERE id = ?", [sched.plan_id]);
      }
      return { success: true, scheduleId: sid, status: newStatus };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-printers', async () => {
    if (!mainWindow || mainWindow.isDestroyed()) return [];
    try {
      return await mainWindow.webContents.getPrintersAsync();
    } catch (_) {
      return [];
    }
  });

  ipcMain.handle('print-silent', async (_e, options = {}) => {
    const htmlContent = options.html || options.content || '';
    if (!htmlContent) return { success: false, error: 'empty_html' };

    const printWin = new BrowserWindow({
      show: false,
      webPreferences: { contextIsolation: true }
    });

    try {
      await printWin.loadURL(`data:text/html;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(htmlContent)}`);
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 350));

      return await new Promise((resolve) => {
        printWin.webContents.print(
          {
            silent: Boolean(options.silent ?? true),
            printBackground: true,
            deviceName: options.printerName || options.deviceName || undefined
          },
          (success, failureReason) => {
            printWin.close();
            resolve({ success, error: failureReason || null });
          }
        );
      });
    } catch (err) {
      printWin.close();
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
  });

  ipcMain.handle('export-pdf', async (_e, options = {}) => {
    const htmlContent = options.html || options.content || '';
    const defaultName = options.filename || `Gherbi_Document_${Date.now()}.pdf`;
    const { canceled, filePath } = await dialog.showSaveDialog(mainWindow, {
      defaultPath: defaultName,
      filters: [{ name: 'PDF Document', extensions: ['pdf'] }]
    });
    if (canceled || !filePath) return { canceled: true };

    const pdfWin = new BrowserWindow({ show: false });
    try {
      await pdfWin.loadURL(`data:text/html;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(htmlContent)}`);
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 350));
      const pdfBuf = await pdfWin.webContents.printToPDF({ printBackground: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, pdfBuf);
      pdfWin.close();
      return { success: true, filePath };
    } catch (err) {
      pdfWin.close();
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
  });

        bcid: opts.bcid || 'code128',
        text: String(text || '00000000'),
        scale: opts.scale || 3,
        height: opts.height || 10,
        includetext: Boolean(opts.includetext ?? false)
      });
      return `data:image/png;base64,${png.toString('base64')}`;
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  });

  ipcMain.handle('export-db-backup', async () => {
    const { canceled, filePath } = await dialog.showSaveDialog(mainWindow, {
      defaultPath: `Gherbi_POS_Backup_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.zip`,
      filters: [{ name: 'ZIP Backup', extensions: ['zip'] }]
    });
    if (canceled || !filePath) return { canceled: true };

    const zip = new AdmZip();
    if (fs.existsSync(db.dbPath)) {
      zip.addLocalFile(db.dbPath);
    }
    const imgDir = getImagesDir();
    if (fs.existsSync(imgDir)) {
      zip.addLocalFolder(imgDir, 'product_images');
    }
    zip.writeZip(filePath);
    return { success: true, filePath };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('import-db-backup', async () => {
    const { canceled, filePaths } = await dialog.showOpenDialog(mainWindow, {
      properties: ['openFile'],
      filters: [{ name: 'Backup File', extensions: ['zip', 'db'] }]
    });
    if (canceled || !filePaths || filePaths.length === 0) return { canceled: true };

    const chosen = filePaths[0];
    if (chosen.toLowerCase().endsWith('.zip')) {
      const zip = new AdmZip(chosen);
      const tempDir = path.join(app.getPath('temp'), `gherbi_restore_${Date.now()}`);
      zip.extractAllTo(tempDir, true);
      const dbEntry = fs.readdirSync(tempDir).find((f) => f.endsWith('.db'));
      if (dbEntry) {
        fs.copyFileSync(path.join(tempDir, dbEntry), db.dbPath);
      }
    } else {
      fs.copyFileSync(chosen, db.dbPath);
    }
    return { success: true };
  });

      expiry_date: p.expiry_date || ''
    }));

    const { canceled, filePath } = await dialog.showSaveDialog(mainWindow, {
      defaultPath: `Gherbi_Inventory_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.xlsx`,
      filters: [{ name: 'Excel', extensions: ['xlsx'] }]

  ipcMain.handle('import-products-excel', async () => {
    const { canceled, filePaths } = await dialog.showOpenDialog(mainWindow, {
      properties: ['openFile'],
      filters: [{ name: 'Excel / CSV', extensions: ['xlsx', 'xls', 'csv'] }]
    });
    if (canceled || !filePaths || filePaths.length === 0) return { canceled: true };

    const wb = XLSX.readFile(filePaths[0]);
    const sheet = wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]];
    const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet);
    let imported = 0;

    await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      for (const r of rows) {
        const name = String(r.name || r['الاسم'] || r['اسم المنتج'] || r.Designation || '').trim();
        if (!name) continue;
        const barcode = String(r.barcode || r['الباركود'] || r.Code || '').trim() || null;
        if (barcode) await productWriter.freeTombstonedProductBarcode(barcode);
        const supplier = String(r.supplier || r['المورد'] || '').trim() || null;
        if (supplier) await ensureSupplierByName(supplier);

        const ins = await dbRun(
          'INSERT INTO products (barcode, name, category, family, supplier, unit, min_stock) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
          [
            barcode,
            name,
            String(r.category || r['الفئة'] || 'عام').trim(),
            String(r.family || r['العائلة'] || '').trim() || null,
            supplier,
            String(r.unit || r['الوحدة'] || 'قطعة').trim(),
            Number(r.min_stock ?? 5)
          ]
        );
        await dbRun(
          'INSERT INTO inventory_batches (product_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price, wholesale_price, expiry_date) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
          [
            ins.lastID,
            Number(r.stock ?? r['الكمية'] ?? 0),
            Number(r.cost_price ?? r['سعر الشراء'] ?? 0),
            Number(r.selling_price ?? r['سعر البيع'] ?? 0),
            r.wholesale_price ? Number(r.wholesale_price) : null,
            r.expiry_date || null
          ]
        );
        imported += 1;
      }
    });
    return { success: true, imported };
  });

      { barcode: '6130001000043', name: 'سكر أبيض سيفيتال 1 كغ (Scor)', category: 'مواد غذائية', supplier: 'مجمع سيفيتال', unit: 'كيس', cost_price: 85, selling_price: 105, wholesale_price: 98, stock: 120, min_stock: 20 },
      { barcode: '6130005000032', name: 'عصير رويبة ممتاز 1 لتر (Rouiba)', category: 'مشروبات وقهوة', supplier: 'مؤسسة المشروبات', unit: 'علبة', cost_price: 115, selling_price: 160, wholesale_price: 145, stock: 75, min_stock: 12 },
      { barcode: '6130008000022', name: 'كسكس ماما رقيق 1 كغ (Mama)', category: 'مواد غذائية', supplier: 'مطاحن الشرق', unit: 'كيس', cost_price: 125, selling_price: 160, wholesale_price: 148, stock: 90, min_stock: 15 },
      { barcode: '6130003000034', name: 'جبن طري شيدر الصومام 16 قطعة', category: 'أجبان وألبان', supplier: 'مؤسسة الألبان', unit: 'علبة', cost_price: 170, selling_price: 210, wholesale_price: 195, stock: 65, min_stock: 10 },
      { barcode: '6130005000018', name: 'ماء معدني إيفري 1.5 لتر (Ifri)', category: 'مشروبات وقهوة', supplier: 'مؤسسة المشروبات', unit: 'قارورة', cost_price: 30, selling_price: 45, wholesale_price: 38, stock: 200, min_stock: 24 },
      { barcode: '00105', plu_code: '00105', name: 'لوز مقشر ممتاز (ميزان)', category: 'مكسرات وحلويات', supplier: 'مؤسسة التوزيع الغذائي', unit: 'كغ', cost_price: 1900, selling_price: 2400, wholesale_price: 2200, stock: 25, min_stock: 5 }
    ];

    await db.withTransaction(async () => {

        if (ex) continue;
        await ensureSupplierByName(p.supplier);

  ipcMain.handle('reconnect-relay', () => ({ status: 'disconnected' }));

  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:status', () => (cloudDbSync ? cloudDbSync.getStatus() : { enabled: false }));
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:trigger', () => (cloudDbSync ? cloudDbSync.triggerNow() : { ok: false }));
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:set-mode', (_e, mode) =>
    cloudDbSync ? cloudDbSync.setMode(mode) : { enabled: false }
  );
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:snapshot', () => (cloudDbSync ? cloudDbSync.pushSnapshot() : { ok: false }));
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:wipe', () => (cloudDbSync ? cloudDbSync.wipeCloudData() : { ok: true }));
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:join-with-code', (_e, code) => deviceAuth.joinWithCode(db, code));
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:get-join-info', () => deviceAuth.getJoinInfo(db));
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:leave-cloud', () => deviceAuth.leaveCloud(db));
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:issue-mobile-pair-code', () => deviceAuth.issueMobilePairCode(db));
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:backfill-from-owner', () =>
    cloudDbSync ? cloudDbSync.backfillFromOwner() : { ok: true }
  );
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:reset-and-resync', () =>
    cloudDbSync ? cloudDbSync.resetAndResync() : { ok: true }
  );
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:fresh-bootstrap', () =>
    cloudDbSync ? cloudDbSync.runFreshBootstrap() : { ok: true }
  );
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:recompute-stock', () => stockLedger.recomputeAllBatches(db));
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:repair-ledger', () => stockLedger.repairMissingMovements(db));
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:inspect-ledger', () => stockLedger.inspectLedger(db));
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:deep-diagnose', () => cloudDiagnostics.deepDiagnose(db));
  ipcMain.handle('cloud-sync:send-diagnostics', (_e, payload) =>
    cloudDiagnostics.sendDiagnostics(db, payload)
  );

  ipcMain.handle('get-license-status', () => licenseManager.getLicenseStatus());
  ipcMain.handle('activate-software', (_e, code) => licenseManager.activateApp(code));
  ipcMain.handle('activate-software-offline', () => licenseManager.installOfflineLicense());
  ipcMain.handle('deactivate-software', () => licenseManager.deactivateApp());
  ipcMain.handle('get-trial-status', () => licenseManager.getTrialStatus());
  ipcMain.handle('get-promo-status', () => licenseManager.getPromoStatus());
  ipcMain.handle('send-purchase-request', async () => ({ ok: true }));
  ipcMain.handle('send-support-message', async () => ({ ok: true }));
  ipcMain.handle('get-performance-metrics', () => db._writeQueue.getStats());
}

app.whenReady().then(async () => {
  await dbRun("DELETE FROM settings WHERE value IN ('undefined', 'null')");
  await stockLedger.seedStartupMovements(db);

  cloudDbSync = cloudDbSyncMod.createCloudDbSync({
    db,
    getSetting,
    setSetting,
    getMainWindow: () => mainWindow
  });

  activeServerPort = Number(await getSetting('server_port', '8080')) || 8080;
  localServerHandle = startLocalServer(activeServerPort);

  registerIpcHandlers();
  createMainWindow();

  app.on('activate', () => {
    if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0) createMainWindow();
  });
});

app.on('window-all-closed', () => {
  if (process.platform !== 'darwin') {
    app.quit();
  }
});
```

```html
  <div class="doc-container">
    <div class="header-bar">
      <div class="company-block">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="Logo" style="max-height:52px;margin-bottom:6px;object-fit:contain;">
        {{/if}}
        <h1 class="company-name">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        {{#if COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}<div class="company-desc">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</div>{{/if}}
        <div class="company-meta">
          {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<div>{{LBL_ADDRESS}} {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>{{/if}}
          <div>
            {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<span>{{LBL_TEL}}: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_FAX}}<span> | {{LBL_FAX}}: {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>{{/if}}

          </div>

          <span>NIF: {{COMPANY_NIF}}</span>
          <span>AI: {{COMPANY_AI}}</span>
          <span>NIS: {{COMPANY_NIS}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="doc-type">سند طلبية زبون (BON DE COMMANDE)</div>
        <div class="doc-num">N°: {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</div>
        <div class="doc-date">{{LBL_DATE}} {{DATE}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="party-card">
      <div>
        <div class="party-title">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="party-name">{{PARTY_NAME}}</div>
        <div class="party-details">
          {{#if PARTY_ADDRESS}}<span>{{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if PARTY_PHONE}}<span> | {{LBL_TEL}}: {{PARTY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="party-fiscal">
        <div><strong>RC:</strong> {{PARTY_RC}} | <strong>NIF:</strong> {{PARTY_NIF}}</div>
        <div><strong>AI:</strong> {{PARTY_AI}} | <strong>NIS:</strong> {{PARTY_NIS}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table class="items-table">
      <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:6%;">{{LBL_N_INDEX}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_REF}}</th>
        <th style="width:35%;">{{LBL_DESIGNATION}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_QTY}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_UNIT}}</th>
        <th style="width:11%;">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
        <th style="width:7%;">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="summary-section">
      <div class="words-and-payment">
        <div class="words-box">
          <div class="words-prefix">{{LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX}}</div>
          <div class="words-text">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="payment-meta">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} <span>{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="totals-box">
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{#if DISCOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="val">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TAX_TOTAL}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        <div class="totals-row net-row">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        
        {{#if REMAINING_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TOTAL_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer-sign">
      <div>Gherbi.Ai POS — نظام نقاط البيع والمحاسبة المتكامل</div>
      <div class="sign-box">{{LBL_SIGNATURE}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} <span>{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="totals-box">
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{#if DISCOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="val">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TAX_TOTAL}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        <div class="totals-row net-row">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        
        {{#if REMAINING_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TOTAL_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer-sign">
      <div>Gherbi.Ai POS — نظام نقاط البيع والمحاسبة المتكامل</div>
      <div class="sign-box">{{LBL_SIGNATURE}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
```

```javascript
/**

 */

'use strict';

const { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } = require('electron');

contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('activationAPI', {
  getHWID: () => ipcRenderer.sendSync('get-hwid-sync'),
  activate: (code) => ipcRenderer.invoke('activate-software', code),
  activateOffline: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('activate-software-offline'),
  getStatus: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('get-license-status')
});
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\preload.js`

```javascript
/**
 * preload.js
 * جسر الربط الآمن الشامل 100% (ContextBridge) بين العملية الرئيسية والواجهة الأمامية
 * يضم كافة دوال Lumina POS + الميزات الجزائرية الـ 6 + فاحص الضمان + استيراد قاموس 613 + عدادات الفواتير
 */

'use strict';

const { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } = require('electron');

const invoke = (channel, ...args) => ipcRenderer.invoke(channel, ...args);

function createEventSubscriber(channel) {
  return (callback) => {
    if (typeof callback !== 'function') return () => {};
    const handler = (_event, payload) => callback(payload);
    ipcRenderer.on(channel, handler);
    return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener(channel, handler);
  };
}

const api = {
  // 1. المراجعات، الإعدادات، ومعلومات التطبيق
  getDataRevision: () => invoke('get-data-revision'),
  getAppVersion: () => invoke('get-app-version'),
  checkUpdate: () => invoke('check-update'),
  openExternalLink: (url) => invoke('open-external-link', url),
  openYoutubeVideo: (url) => invoke('open-youtube-video', url),
  relaunchApp: () => invoke('app-relaunch'),
  getSettings: () => invoke('get-settings'),
  updateSettings: (settingsObj) => invoke('update-settings', settingsObj),
  resetSystem: () => invoke('reset-system'),
  seedDemoData: () => invoke('seed-demo-data'),
  getPerformanceMetrics: () => invoke('get-performance-metrics'),
  getDocCounters: () => invoke('get-doc-counters'),
  updateDocCounter: (payload) => invoke('update-doc-counter', payload),

  // 2. المستخدمون والحسابات
  checkFirstRun: () => invoke('check-first-run'),
  setupFirstAdmin: (...args) => invoke('setup-first-admin', ...args),
  loginUser: (...args) => invoke('login-user', ...args),
  getUsers: () => invoke('get-users'),
  addUser: (userData) => invoke('add-user', userData),
  updateUser: (...args) => invoke('update-user', ...args),
  deleteUser: (id) => invoke('delete-user', id),
  updateAccount: (...args) => invoke('update-account', ...args),

  // 3. المنتجات، الدفعات، الباركودات، المتغيرات، والأرقام التسلسلية
  getCategories: () => invoke('get-categories'),
  getFamilies: () => invoke('get-families'),
  getProductSuppliers: () => invoke('get-product-suppliers'),
  getProducts: (filters) => invoke('get-products', filters),
  getPosStock: () => invoke('get-pos-stock'),
  getProductFull: (productId) => invoke('get-product-full', productId),
  getProductAnalytics: (productId) => invoke('get-product-analytics', productId),
  addProduct: (productData) => invoke('add-product', productData),
  updateProduct: (...args) => invoke('update-product', ...args),
  deleteProduct: (productId) => invoke('delete-product', productId),
  addBatch: (...args) => invoke('add-batch', ...args),
  updateBatch: (...args) => invoke('update-batch', ...args),
  deleteBatch: (batchId) => invoke('delete-batch', batchId),
  saveProductVariants: (productId, variantData) =>
    invoke('save-product-variants', productId, variantData),

  processSale: (saleData) => invoke('process-sale', saleData),

    readOnce: () => invoke('scale:read-once'),
    tare: () => invoke('scale:tare'),
    zero: () => invoke('scale:zero'),
    send: (cmd) => invoke('scale:send', cmd),
    sniff: (opts) => invoke('scale:sniff', opts),
    probe: (opts) => invoke('scale:probe', opts),
    listPorts: () => invoke('scale:list-ports'),
    onReading: createEventSubscriber('scale:reading'),
    onStatus: createEventSubscriber('scale:status'),
    onRaw: createEventSubscriber('scale:raw')
  },

  cloudSync: {
    status: () => invoke('cloud-sync:status'),
    trigger: () => invoke('cloud-sync:trigger'),
    setMode: (mode) => invoke('cloud-sync:set-mode', mode),
    snapshot: () => invoke('cloud-sync:snapshot'),
    wipe: () => invoke('cloud-sync:wipe'),
    joinWithCode: (code) => invoke('cloud-sync:join-with-code', code),
    getJoinInfo: () => invoke('cloud-sync:get-join-info'),
    leaveCloud: () => invoke('cloud-sync:leave-cloud'),
    issueMobilePairCode: () => invoke('cloud-sync:issue-mobile-pair-code'),
    backfillFromOwner: () => invoke('cloud-sync:backfill-from-owner'),
    resetAndResync: () => invoke('cloud-sync:reset-and-resync'),
    freshBootstrap: () => invoke('cloud-sync:fresh-bootstrap'),
    recomputeStock: () => invoke('cloud-sync:recompute-stock'),
    repairLedger: () => invoke('cloud-sync:repair-ledger'),
    inspectLedger: () => invoke('cloud-sync:inspect-ledger'),
    deepDiagnose: () => invoke('cloud-sync:deep-diagnose'),
    sendDiagnostics: (payload) => invoke('cloud-sync:send-diagnostics', payload),
    onStatus: createEventSubscriber('cloud-sync:status'),
    onDataChanged: createEventSubscriber('cloud-sync:data-changed')
  },

  getLicenseStatus: () => invoke('get-license-status'),
  activateSoftware: (code) => invoke('activate-software', code),
  activateSoftwareOffline: () => invoke('activate-software-offline'),
  deactivateSoftware: () => invoke('deactivate-software'),
  getTrialStatus: () => invoke('get-trial-status'),
  getPromoStatus: () => invoke('get-promo-status'),
  sendPurchaseRequest: (data) => invoke('send-purchase-request', data),
  sendSupportMessage: (data) => invoke('send-support-message', data)
};

contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('api', api);
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\print-engine.js`

```javascript
/**
 * print-engine.js
 * محرك الطباعة وتوليد المستندات الشامل لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS (13 نوع مستند + 53 قالب HTML)
 * يشمل:
 * - الفواتير الرسمية (مع تفصيل الدفع المختلط Split Payment Breakdown)
 * - الوصولات الحرارية (مع باركود الفاتورة وتفصيل الدفع المختلط)
 * - إشعار الدائن (Facture d'Avoir)
 * - وصل التوصيل (Bon de Livraison A4/A5/Thermal)
 * - وصل الاستلام المخزني (Bon de Réception)
 * - الفاتورة الشكلية (Facture Proforma)
 * - سند الطلبية (Bon de Commande)
 * - وصل تسديد الديون (Reçu de Paiement)
 * - الفاتورة المجمعة (Facture Récapitulative)
 * - قائمة الأسعار (Catalogue des Prix)
 * - ملصق الباركود المفرد + طابور طباعة الملصقات بالجملة (renderBatchBarcodeLabelsHtml)
 * - شهادة الضمان (Certificat de Garantie IMEI/Serial)
 * - عقد البيع بالتقسيط الرسمي (Contrat de Vente par Facilité A4)
 */

'use strict';

if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
  module.exports = {};
} else {
  const PrintEngine = (function () {
    const templateCache = new Map();

    const TEMPLATE_FILES = {
      template1: 'invoice_template_1.html',
      template2: 'invoice_template_2.html',
      template3: 'invoice_template_3.html',
      template4: 'invoice_template_4.html',
      template5: 'invoice_template_5.html',
      template6: 'invoice_template_6.html',
      template7: 'invoice_template_7.html',
      template8: 'invoice_template_8.html',
      template9: 'invoice_template_9.html',
      a5: 'invoice_template_a5.html',
      detailed: 'invoice_template_detailed.html',
      thermal80: 'invoice_thermal_80.html',
      receipt1_ar: 'receipt_template_1.html',
      receipt1_fr: 'receipt_template_1_fr.html',
      receipt1_en: 'receipt_template_1_en.html',
      receipt2_ar: 'receipt_template_2.html',
      receipt2_fr: 'receipt_template_2_fr.html',
      receipt2_en: 'receipt_template_2_en.html',
      receipt3_ar: 'receipt_template_3.html',
      receipt3_fr: 'receipt_template_3_fr.html',
      receipt3_en: 'receipt_template_3_en.html',
      receipt4_ar: 'receipt_template_4.html',
      receipt4_fr: 'receipt_template_4_fr.html',
      receipt4_en: 'receipt_template_4_en.html',
      receipt5_ar: 'receipt_template_5.html',
      receipt5_fr: 'receipt_template_5_fr.html',
      receipt5_en: 'receipt_template_5_en.html',
      credit_note_ar: 'credit_note_ar.html',
      credit_note_fr: 'credit_note_fr.html',
      credit_note_en: 'credit_note_en.html',
      delivery_ar: 'delivery_note_ar.html',
      delivery_fr: 'delivery_note_fr.html',
      delivery_en: 'delivery_note_en.html',
      delivery_a5: 'delivery_note_a5.html',
      delivery_thermal: 'delivery_note_thermal.html',
      order_ar: 'order_receipt_ar.html',
      order_fr: 'order_receipt_fr.html',
      proforma_ar: 'proforma_invoice_ar.html',
      proforma_fr: 'proforma_invoice_fr.html',
      payment_ar: 'payment_receipt_ar.html',
      payment_fr: 'payment_receipt_fr.html',
      recap_ar: 'recap_invoice_ar.html',
      recap_fr: 'recap_invoice_fr.html',
      recap_en: 'recap_invoice_en.html',
      reception_ar: 'reception_note_ar.html',
      reception_fr: 'reception_note_fr.html',
      reception_en: 'reception_note_en.html',
      sales_summary_ar: 'sales_summary_ar.html',
      sales_summary_fr: 'sales_summary_fr.html',
      sales_summary_en: 'sales_summary_en.html',
      price_list: 'price_list.html',
      barcode_label: 'barcode_label_template_1.html'
    };

    function formatMoney(value, decimals = 2) {
      const num = Number(value || 0);
      if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return '0.00';
      return num.toLocaleString('en-US', {
        minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
        maximumFractionDigits: decimals
      });
    }

    function escapeHtml(str) {
      return String(str ?? '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
    }

    function toWords(amount, lang = 'ar') {
      if (window.NumberToWords && typeof window.NumberToWords.toWords === 'function') {
        return window.NumberToWords.toWords(Number(amount || 0), lang);
      }
      return `${formatMoney(amount)} DZD`;
    }

    function formatPaymentMethodWithSplits(saleOrInvoice = {}) {
      const rawMethod = String(saleOrInvoice.payment_method || 'cash').toLowerCase();
      const map = {
        cash: 'نقداً (Espèces)',
        credit: 'آجل / دين (À Terme)',
        cib: 'بطاقة بنكية / الذهبية (CIB)',
        baridimob: 'بريدي موب (BaridiMob)',
        cheque: 'شيك (Chèque)',
        installment: 'بيع بالتقسيط (Facilités)',
        split: 'دفع مختلط (Multi-Paiement)'
      };
      if (saleOrInvoice.split_payments_json) {
        try {
          const splits =
            typeof saleOrInvoice.split_payments_json === 'string'
              ? JSON.parse(saleOrInvoice.split_payments_json)
              : saleOrInvoice.split_payments_json;
          if (Array.isArray(splits) && splits.length > 0) {
            const parts = splits.map(
              (s) => `${s.method === 'cib' ? 'CIB/BaridiMob' : 'نقداً'}: ${formatMoney(s.amount)} د.ج`
            );
            const total = Number(saleOrInvoice.total || 0);
            const paid = Number(saleOrInvoice.paid_amount || 0);
            if (total - paid > 0.01) {
              parts.push(`آجل: ${formatMoney(total - paid)} د.ج`);
            }
            return parts.join(' | ');
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      return saleOrInvoice.payment_method_label || map[rawMethod] || saleOrInvoice.payment_method || 'نقداً';
    }

    async function loadTemplateHtml(fileNameOrKey) {
      const fileName = TEMPLATE_FILES[fileNameOrKey] || fileNameOrKey;
      if (templateCache.has(fileName)) {
        return templateCache.get(fileName);
      }
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`./${fileName}`);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
        const text = await res.text();
        templateCache.set(fileName, text);
        return text;
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`[PrintEngine] Could not load template ${fileName}:`, err.message);
        return '';
      }
    }

    function compileTemplate(rawHtml, data = {}) {
      if (!rawHtml) return '';
      let out = String(rawHtml);

      out = out.replace(/\{\{#if\s+([A-Z0-9_]+)\}\}([\s\S]*?)\{\{\/if\}\}/g, (_match, key, inner) => {
        const val = data[key];
        const isTruthy =
          val !== undefined &&
          val !== null &&
          val !== false &&
          val !== '' &&
          val !== '0' &&
          val !== '0.00';
        return isTruthy ? inner : '';
      });

      out = out.replace(
        /\{\{#unless\s+([A-Z0-9_]+)\}\}([\s\S]*?)\{\{\/unless\}\}/g,
        (_match, key, inner) => {
          const val = data[key];
          const isTruthy =
            val !== undefined &&
            val !== null &&
            val !== false &&
            val !== '' &&
            val !== '0' &&
            val !== '0.00';
          return !isTruthy ? inner : '';
        }
      );

      out = out.replace(/\{\{\s*([A-Z0-9_]+)\s*\}\}/g, (_match, key) => {
        const val = data[key];
        return val !== undefined && val !== null ? String(val) : '';
      });

      return out;
    }

    function buildCompanyVars(settings = {}) {
      return {
        COMPANY_NAME: settings.shop_name || 'Gherbi.Ai POS',
        COMPANY_DESCRIPTION: settings.shop_description || '',
        COMPANY_ADDRESS: settings.shop_address || '',
        COMPANY_PHONE: settings.shop_phone || '',
        COMPANY_FAX: settings.shop_fax || '',
        COMPANY_EMAIL: settings.shop_email || '',
        COMPANY_RC: settings.shop_rc || '-',
        COMPANY_NIF: settings.shop_nif || '-',
        COMPANY_AI: settings.shop_ai || '-',
        COMPANY_NIS: settings.shop_nis || '-',
        COMPANY_LOGO: settings.shop_logo || ''
      };
    }

    function getInvoiceLabels(lang = 'ar', isPurchase = false, taxPercent = 0) {
      const dicts = {
        ar: {
          LBL_INVOICE_TITLE: 'فاتورة',
          INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL: isPurchase ? 'فاتورة شراء' : 'فاتورة بيع',
          CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL: isPurchase ? 'المورد' : 'الزبون',
          LBL_N_INDEX: 'الرقم',
          LBL_REF: 'المرجع',
          LBL_DESIGNATION: 'البيان',
          LBL_QTY: 'الكمية',
          LBL_UNIT: 'الوحدة',
          LBL_UNIT_PRICE: 'سعر الوحدة',
          LBL_TVA: 'TVA',
          LBL_TOTAL_HT: 'المجموع',
          LBL_SUBTOTAL: 'المجموع الفرعي :',
          LBL_DISCOUNT: 'التخفيض :',
          LBL_TAX_TOTAL: `الضريبة (${taxPercent}%) :`,
          LBL_STAMP: 'حق الطابع :',
          LBL_NET_PAY: 'الصافي للدفع :',
          LBL_OLD_BALANCE: 'الدين السابق :',
          LBL_CURRENT_DEBT: 'إجمالي الدين :',
          LBL_REMAINING_PAY: 'الباقي من الفاتورة :',
          LBL_TOTAL_DEBT: 'إجمالي الدين الحالي :',
          LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT: 'طريقة الدفع :',

    async function renderInvoiceHtml(invoiceData = {}, settings = {}, options = {}) {
      const lang = options.lang || settings.receipt_lang || settings.app_lang || 'ar';
      const templateKey = options.template || settings.invoice_template || 'template1';
      const fileName = TEMPLATE_FILES[templateKey] || 'invoice_template_1.html';
      const rawTpl = await loadTemplateHtml(fileName);

      const items = Array.isArray(invoiceData.items) ? invoiceData.items : [];
      const taxPercent = Number(invoiceData.tax_percentage || 0);
      const subtotal = Number(invoiceData.subtotal ?? invoiceData.total ?? 0);
      const discount = Number(invoiceData.discount || 0);
      const stampAmount = Number(invoiceData.stamp_amount || 0);
      const taxTotal = Number(((subtotal - discount) * (taxPercent / 100)).toFixed(2));
      const netToPay = Number(invoiceData.total ?? (subtotal - discount + taxTotal + stampAmount));
      const paidAmount = Number(invoiceData.paid_amount ?? netToPay);
      const remainingDebt = Math.max(0, Number((netToPay - paidAmount).toFixed(2)));
      const oldBalance = Number(invoiceData.old_balance || 0);
      const totalDebt = Number((oldBalance + remainingDebt).toFixed(2));

      const isThermal = fileName.includes('thermal');
      const isTemplate9 = fileName.includes('template_9');
      const isTemplate3 = fileName.includes('template_3') && !rawTpl.includes('LBL_REF');

      let itemsRowsHtml = '';
      items.forEach((it, idx) => {
        const name = escapeHtml(it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || it.name || 'منتج');
        const serialBadge = it.serial_number
          ? ` <small style="font-family:monospace;">[S/N: ${escapeHtml(it.serial_number)}]</small>`
          : '';
        const ref = escapeHtml(it.product_barcode || it.barcode || it.id || idx + 1);
        const unit = escapeHtml(it.product_unit || it.unit || 'قطعة');
        const qty = Number(it.quantity || 1);
        const price = Number(it.price ?? it.cost_price ?? it.selling_price ?? 0);
        const lineTotal = Number(it.subtotal ?? it.total_cost ?? qty * price);

        if (isThermal) {
          itemsRowsHtml += `
            <div class="t-item">
              <div class="t-name">${idx + 1}. ${name}${serialBadge}</div>
              <div class="t-line">
                <span class="muted2">${qty} × ${formatMoney(price)}</span>
                <span class="b">${formatMoney(lineTotal)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        } else if (isTemplate9) {
          itemsRowsHtml += `
            <tr>
              <td>${ref}</td>
              <td class="desig">${name}${serialBadge}</td>
              <td>${taxPercent > 0 ? taxPercent + '%' : '-'}</td>
              <td>${qty}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(price)}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(lineTotal)}</td>
            </tr>`;
        } else if (isTemplate3) {
          itemsRowsHtml += `
            <tr>
              <td>${idx + 1}</td>
              <td>${name}${serialBadge}</td>
              <td>${qty}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(price)}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(lineTotal)}</td>
            </tr>`;
        } else {
          itemsRowsHtml += `
            <tr>
              <td>${idx + 1}</td>
              <td>${ref}</td>
              <td class="text-left">${name}${serialBadge}</td>
              <td>${qty}</td>
              <td>${unit}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(price)}</td>
              <td>${taxPercent > 0 ? taxPercent + '%' : '0%'}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(lineTotal)}</td>
            </tr>`;
        }
      });

      const lbl = getInvoiceLabels(lang, Boolean(invoiceData.is_purchase), taxPercent);
      const dateStr = String(invoiceData.sale_date || invoiceData.date || new Date().toISOString()).slice(0, 10);

      const vars = {
        ...buildCompanyVars(settings),
        ...lbl,
        INVOICE_NUMBER: invoiceData.doc_number || invoiceData.invoice_number || invoiceData.id || '0001',
        DOC_NUMBER: invoiceData.doc_number || invoiceData.invoice_number || invoiceData.id || '0001',
        DATE: dateStr,
        PARTY_NAME: invoiceData.customer_name || invoiceData.supplier_name || invoiceData.party_name || 'زبون عابر',
        PARTY_PHONE: invoiceData.customer_phone || invoiceData.supplier_phone || '',
        PARTY_ADDRESS: invoiceData.customer_address || invoiceData.supplier_address || '',
        PARTY_RC: invoiceData.customer_rc || invoiceData.supplier_rc || '-',
        PARTY_NIF: invoiceData.customer_nif || invoiceData.supplier_nif || '-',
        PARTY_AI: invoiceData.customer_ai || invoiceData.supplier_ai || '-',
        PARTY_NIS: invoiceData.customer_nis || invoiceData.supplier_nis || '-',
        ITEMS_ROWS: itemsRowsHtml,
        SUBTOTAL: formatMoney(subtotal),
        DISCOUNT: discount > 0 ? formatMoney(discount) : '',
        TAX_TOTAL: taxTotal > 0 ? formatMoney(taxTotal) : '',
        STAMP_AMOUNT: stampAmount > 0 ? formatMoney(stampAmount) : '',
        NET_TO_PAY: formatMoney(netToPay),
        PAID_AMOUNT: formatMoney(paidAmount),
        OLD_BALANCE: oldBalance > 0 ? formatMoney(oldBalance) : '',
        CLIENT_OLD_DEBT: formatMoney(oldBalance),
        REMAINING_DEBT: remainingDebt > 0 ? formatMoney(remainingDebt) : '',
        TOTAL_DEBT: totalDebt > 0 ? formatMoney(totalDebt) : '',
        CLIENT_TOTAL_DEBT: formatMoney(totalDebt),
        PAYMENT_MODE: formatPaymentMethodWithSplits(invoiceData),
        TOTAL_IN_WORDS: toWords(netToPay, lang)
      };

      return compileTemplate(rawTpl, vars);
    }

    async function renderReceiptHtml(saleData = {}, settings = {}, options = {}) {
      const lang = options.lang || settings.receipt_lang || 'ar';
      const baseNum = String(options.template || settings.receipt_template || 'receipt1').replace(/\D/g, '') || '1';
      const suffix = lang === 'fr' ? '_fr' : lang === 'en' ? '_en' : '';
      const fileName = `receipt_template_${baseNum}${suffix}.html`;
      const rawTpl = await loadTemplateHtml(fileName);

      const items = Array.isArray(saleData.items) ? saleData.items : [];
      const subtotal = Number(saleData.subtotal ?? saleData.total ?? 0);
      const discount = Number(saleData.discount || 0);
      const total = Number(saleData.total ?? subtotal - discount);
      const paid = Number(saleData.paid_amount ?? total);
      const rest = Math.max(0, Number((total - paid).toFixed(2)));
      const change = Math.max(0, Number((paid - total).toFixed(2)));
      const oldBalance = Number(saleData.old_balance || 0);

      let itemsRowsHtml = '';
      items.forEach((it) => {
        const name = escapeHtml(it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || it.name || 'منتج');
        const qty = Number(it.quantity || 1);
        const price = Number(it.price ?? it.selling_price ?? 0);
        const lineSub = Number(it.subtotal ?? qty * price);
        itemsRowsHtml += `
          <tr>
            <td>${name}</td>
            <td>${qty}</td>
            <td>${formatMoney(price)}</td>
            <td>${formatMoney(lineSub)}</td>
          </tr>`;
      });

      const now = new Date(saleData.sale_date || Date.now());
      const dateStr = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const timeStr = now.toTimeString().slice(0, 5);
      const receiptNum = String(saleData.doc_number || saleData.id || '0001');
      const paperWidthMm = Number(settings.receipt_paper_width_mm || 80);

      const vars = {
        ...buildCompanyVars(settings),
        RECEIPT_NUMBER: receiptNum,
        DATE: dateStr,
        TIME: timeStr,
        CLIENT_NAME: saleData.customer_name || 'زبون عابر',
        CLIENT_CODE: saleData.customer_id || '-',
        SELLER_NAME: saleData.seller_name || 'البائع',
        ITEMS_COUNT: items.length,
        ITEMS_ROWS: itemsRowsHtml,
        SUBTOTAL: formatMoney(subtotal),
        DISCOUNT: discount > 0 ? formatMoney(discount) : '',
        TOTAL: formatMoney(total),
        PAID: formatMoney(paid),
        RECEIPT_REST: rest > 0 ? formatMoney(rest) : '',
        REST: formatMoney(oldBalance + rest),
        OLD_BALANCE: formatMoney(oldBalance),
        CHANGE: change > 0 ? formatMoney(change) : '',
        PAYMENT_MODE: formatPaymentMethodWithSplits(saleData),
        TOTAL_IN_WORDS: toWords(total, lang)
      };

      let compiled = compileTemplate(rawTpl, vars);

      if (paperWidthMm === 58) {
        compiled = compiled.replace('width: 74mm;', 'width: 54mm;');
      }

      if (saleData.split_payments_json) {
        const splitLine = `<div style="font-size:9.5px;border-top:1px dotted #000;margin-top:4px;padding-top:3px;text-align:center;font-weight:700;">${escapeHtml(
          formatPaymentMethodWithSplits(saleData)
        )}</div>`;
        compiled = compiled.replace('</body>', `${splitLine}</body>`);
      }

      if (String(settings.show_receipt_barcode) !== 'false' && window.api && window.api.generateBarcodeImage) {
        try {
          const bcDataUrl = await window.api.generateBarcodeImage(receiptNum, {
            bcid: 'code128',
            height: 8,
            scale: 2
          });
          if (bcDataUrl) {
            compiled = compiled.replace(
              '</body>',
              `<div style="text-align:center;margin-top:8px;"><img src="${bcDataUrl}" style="max-width:56mm;height:11mm;object-fit:contain;"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:9px;">${receiptNum}</div></div></body>`
            );
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      return compiled;
    }

    async function renderCreditNoteHtml(saleData = {}, settings = {}, lang = 'ar') {
      const fileKey = `credit_note_${lang}`;
      const rawTpl = await loadTemplateHtml(TEMPLATE_FILES[fileKey] || 'credit_note_ar.html');
      const items = Array.isArray(saleData.items) ? saleData.items : [];
      const taxPercent = Number(saleData.tax_percentage || 0);
      const subtotalHt = Number(saleData.subtotal ?? saleData.total ?? 0);
      const discount = Number(saleData.discount || 0);
      const tvaAmount = Number(((subtotalHt - discount) * (taxPercent / 100)).toFixed(2));
      const totalTtc = Number((subtotalHt - discount + tvaAmount).toFixed(2));
      const stampAmount = Number(saleData.stamp_amount || 0);
      const netToPay = Number((totalTtc + stampAmount).toFixed(2));

      const rowsHtml = items
        .map((it, idx) => {
          const name = escapeHtml(it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || it.name || 'منتج');
          const ref = escapeHtml(it.product_barcode || it.barcode || idx + 1);
          const unit = escapeHtml(it.product_unit || it.unit || 'قطعة');
          const qty = Math.abs(Number(it.quantity || 1));
          const price = Number(it.price || 0);
          const sub = Number((qty * price).toFixed(2));
          return `<tr><td>${idx + 1}</td><td>${ref}</td><td>${name}</td><td>${unit}</td><td>${qty}</td><td>${formatMoney(
            price
          )}</td><td>${taxPercent}%</td><td>${formatMoney(sub)}</td></tr>`;
        })
        .join('');

      const lbl = getInvoiceLabels(lang, false, taxPercent);
      const vars = {
        ...buildCompanyVars(settings),
        ...lbl,
        CREDIT_NOTE_NUMBER:
          saleData.credit_note_number || `AV-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${saleData.id || '001'}`,
        INVOICE_NUMBER: saleData.credit_note_number || saleData.doc_number || saleData.id || '001',
        ORIGINAL_INVOICE_NUMBER: saleData.original_invoice_number || saleData.doc_number || `#${saleData.id}`,
        ORIGINAL_INVOICE_DATE: String(
          saleData.original_invoice_date || saleData.sale_date || new Date().toISOString()
        ).slice(0, 10),
        RETURN_REASON: saleData.credit_note_reason || saleData.reason || 'إرجاع بضاعة / تصحيح فاتورة',
        DATE: String(saleData.credit_note_issued_at || new Date().toISOString()).slice(0, 10),
        PARTY_NAME: saleData.customer_name || 'زبون عابر',
        PARTY_ADDRESS: saleData.customer_address || '',
        PARTY_RC: saleData.customer_rc || '-',
        PARTY_NIF: saleData.customer_nif || '-',
        PARTY_AI: saleData.customer_ai || '-',
        PARTY_NIS: saleData.customer_nis || '-',
        ITEMS_ROWS: rowsHtml,
        SUBTOTAL_HT: formatMoney(subtotalHt),
        SUBTOTAL: formatMoney(subtotalHt),
        DISCOUNT: formatMoney(discount),
        TAX_PERCENT: taxPercent,
        TVA_AMOUNT: formatMoney(tvaAmount),
        TAX_TOTAL: formatMoney(tvaAmount),
        TOTAL_TTC: formatMoney(totalTtc),
        STAMP_AMOUNT: formatMoney(stampAmount),
        NET_TO_PAY: formatMoney(netToPay),
        TOTAL_IN_WORDS: toWords(netToPay, lang)
      };

      return compileTemplate(rawTpl, vars);
    }

    async function renderDeliveryNoteHtml(deliveryData = {}, settings = {}, modeOrLang = 'ar') {
      const keyMap = {
        ar: 'delivery_ar',
        fr: 'delivery_fr',
        en: 'delivery_en',
        a5: 'delivery_a5',
        thermal: 'delivery_thermal'
      };
      const fileName = TEMPLATE_FILES[keyMap[modeOrLang] || 'delivery_ar'];
      const rawTpl = await loadTemplateHtml(fileName);
      const isThermal = modeOrLang === 'thermal';
      const items = Array.isArray(deliveryData.items) ? deliveryData.items : [];

      let rowsHtml = '';
      items.forEach((it, idx) => {
        const name = escapeHtml(it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || it.name || 'منتج');
        const ref = escapeHtml(it.product_barcode || it.barcode || idx + 1);
        const unit = escapeHtml(it.product_unit || it.unit || 'قطعة');
        const qty = Number(it.quantity || 1);
        if (isThermal) {
          rowsHtml += `<tr><td>${idx + 1}</td><td>${name}</td><td>${qty} ${unit}</td></tr>`;
        } else {
          rowsHtml += `<tr><td>${idx + 1}</td><td>${ref}</td><td>${name}</td><td>${qty}</td><td>${unit}</td></tr>`;
        }
      });

      const lbl = getInvoiceLabels(modeOrLang === 'fr' ? 'fr' : modeOrLang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'ar');
      const vars = {
        ...buildCompanyVars(settings),
        ...lbl,
        DELIVERY_NUMBER:
          deliveryData.delivery_number ||
          deliveryData.doc_number ||
          `BL-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${deliveryData.id || '001'}`,
        DOC_NUMBER:
          deliveryData.delivery_number ||
          deliveryData.doc_number ||
          `BL-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${deliveryData.id || '001'}`,
        ORDER_NUMBER: deliveryData.order_number || deliveryData.doc_number || '-',

        VEHICLE_PLATE: deliveryData.vehicle_plate || '-',
        ITEMS_ROWS: rowsHtml
      };

      return compileTemplate(rawTpl, vars);
    }
```
