```javascript
/**
 * stocktake/stocktake-guard.js
 * محرك الجرد المخزني الفعلي (Physical Stocktake Sheet, Variance Calculation & Batch Stock Reconciliation)
 */

'use strict';

function resolveHelpers(ctx) {
  const db = ctx && ctx.db ? ctx.db : ctx;
  const dbGet = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbGet === 'function') return ctx.dbGet(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbGet === 'function') return db.dbGet(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.get(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
    });
  };
  const dbAll = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbAll === 'function') return ctx.dbAll(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbAll === 'function') return db.dbAll(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.all(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
    });
  };
  const dbRun = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbRun === 'function') return ctx.dbRun(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbRun === 'function') return db.dbRun(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.run(sql, params, function onDone(err) {
        if (err) return reject(err);
        resolve({ lastID: this ? this.lastID : null, changes: this ? this.changes : 0 });
      });
    });
  };
  const withTx = (workFn) => {
    if (db && typeof db.withTransaction === 'function') {
      return db.withTransaction((tx) => workFn(tx));
    }
    return workFn({ db, dbGet, dbAll, dbRun });
  };
  const nextNumber = async (docType = 'stocktake') => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.nextNumber === 'function') return ctx.nextNumber(docType);
    if (db && typeof db.nextNumber === 'function') return db.nextNumber(docType);
    return `INV-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(Date.now()).slice(-4)}`;
  };

  return { db, dbGet, dbAll, dbRun, withTx, nextNumber };
}

/**
 * 1. تحميل ورقة الجرد الحالية (Stocktake Sheet) مع التصفية حسب الفئة أو العائلة أو البحث
 */
async function loadSheet(ctx, filters = {}) {
  const { dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const scopeType = String(filters.scopeType || filters.scope_type || 'all').toLowerCase();
  const scopeValue = filters.scopeValue || filters.scope_value || filters.category || filters.family || '';
  const search = filters.search ? String(filters.search).trim() : '';

  const conds = ['p.deleted_at IS NULL'];
  const params = [];

  if (scopeType === 'category' && scopeValue) {
    conds.push('p.category = ?');
    params.push(String(scopeValue));
  } else if (scopeType === 'family' && scopeValue) {
    conds.push('p.family = ?');
    params.push(String(scopeValue));
  } else if (filters.category) {
    conds.push('p.category = ?');
    params.push(String(filters.category));
  } else if (filters.family) {
    conds.push('p.family = ?');
    params.push(String(filters.family));
  }

  if (search) {
    conds.push('(p.name LIKE ? OR p.barcode LIKE ? OR p.category LIKE ?)');
    const q = `%${search}%`;
    params.push(q, q, q);
  }

  const rows = await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      p.id AS product_id,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode,
      p.category,
      p.family,
      p.unit,
      ib.id AS batch_id,
      ib.variant_id,
      ib.expiry_date,
      ib.location,
      COALESCE(ib.cost_price, 0) AS cost_price,
      COALESCE(ib.selling_price, 0) AS selling_price,
      COALESCE(ib.stock, 0) AS book_qty
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.product_id = p.id AND ib.deleted_at IS NULL
    WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')}
    ORDER BY p.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC, ib.id ASC
    `,
    params
  );

  return rows;
}

/**
 * 2. عرض سجل عمليات الجرد السابقة
 */
async function listStocktakes(ctx, filters = {}) {
  const { dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const conds = ['st.deleted_at IS NULL'];
  const params = [];

  if (filters.status) {
    conds.push('st.status = ?');
    params.push(String(filters.status));
  }
  if (filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from) {
    conds.push('date(COALESCE(st.closed_at, st.started_at, st.created_at)) >= date(?)');
    params.push(String(filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from).slice(0, 10));
  }
  if (filters.dateTo || filters.date_to) {
    conds.push('date(COALESCE(st.closed_at, st.started_at, st.created_at)) <= date(?)');
    params.push(String(filters.dateTo || filters.date_to).slice(0, 10));
  }

  return await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      st.*,
      u.name AS user_name,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stocktake_items sti WHERE sti.stocktake_id = st.id AND sti.deleted_at IS NULL) AS items_count,
      (
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stocktake_items sti2
        WHERE sti2.stocktake_id = st.id
          AND sti2.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND sti2.counted_qty IS NOT NULL
          AND ABS(COALESCE(sti2.counted_qty, 0) - COALESCE(sti2.book_qty, 0)) > 0.0001
      ) AS discrepancies_count
    FROM stocktakes st
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = st.user_id
    WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')}
    ORDER BY st.id DESC
    LIMIT 200
    `,
    params
  );
}

/**
 * 3. جلب تفاصيل عملية جرد محددة مع كافة أسطرها وفروقاتها المالية
 */
async function getStocktake(ctx, stocktakeId) {
  const { dbGet, dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const id = Number(
    stocktakeId && typeof stocktakeId === 'object'
      ? stocktakeId.id || stocktakeId.stocktakeId
      : stocktakeId
  );

  const stocktake = await dbGet(
    `
    SELECT st.*, u.name AS user_name
    FROM stocktakes st
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = st.user_id
    WHERE st.id = ? AND st.deleted_at IS NULL
    `,
    [id]
  );
  if (!stocktake) return null;

  const items = await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      sti.*,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode,
      p.category,
      p.unit,
      ib.expiry_date,
      ib.location,
      COALESCE(ib.cost_price, 0) AS cost_price,
      COALESCE(ib.selling_price, 0) AS selling_price,
      (COALESCE(sti.counted_qty, sti.book_qty) - COALESCE(sti.book_qty, 0)) AS diff_qty,
      ((COALESCE(sti.counted_qty, sti.book_qty) - COALESCE(sti.book_qty, 0)) * COALESCE(ib.cost_price, 0)) AS diff_cost_value
    FROM stocktake_items sti
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = sti.product_id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.id = sti.batch_id
    WHERE sti.stocktake_id = ? AND sti.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY p.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC, sti.id ASC
    `,
    [id]
  );

  stocktake.items = items;
  return stocktake;
}

/**
 * 4. اعتماد وحفظ جلسة جرد مخزني وتعديل أرصدة الدفعات آلياً بالكميات الفعلية المعدودة
 */
async function createStocktake(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbGet, withTx, nextNumber } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const items = Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : [];
  if (items.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('لا توجد عناصر في قائمة الجرد لحفظها');
  }

  const docNumber = payload.number || (await nextNumber('stocktake'));
  const scopeType = payload.scope_type || payload.scopeType || 'all';
  const scopeValue = payload.scope_value || payload.scopeValue || null;
  const userId = payload.user_id || payload.userId || null;
  const note = payload.note || null;
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const applyAdjustments = payload.applyAdjustments !== false;

  return await withTx(async (tx) => {
    const ins = await tx.dbRun(
      `
      INSERT INTO stocktakes (
        number, status, scope_type, scope_value, user_id, note, started_at, closed_at
      ) VALUES (?, 'closed', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `,
      [docNumber, scopeType, scopeValue, userId, note, payload.started_at || nowIso, nowIso]
    );
    const stocktakeId = ins.lastID;

    for (const item of items) {
      const productId = Number(item.product_id || item.productId);
      if (!productId) continue;

      let batchId = item.batch_id || item.batchId ? Number(item.batch_id || item.batchId) : null;
      const variantId = item.variant_id || item.variantId ? Number(item.variant_id || item.variantId) : null;

      let bookQty = Number(item.book_qty ?? item.bookQty ?? 0);
      const hasCounted =
        item.counted_qty !== undefined && item.counted_qty !== null && String(item.counted_qty).trim() !== '';
      const countedQty = hasCounted ? Number(item.counted_qty) : bookQty;

      // إذا لم يكن للمنتج دفعة مسجلة بعد وتم عده بكمية موجبة، ننشئ له دفعة ابتدائية
      if (!batchId) {
        const existingBatch = await dbGet(
          'SELECT id, stock FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1',
          [productId]
        );
        if (existingBatch) {
          batchId = existingBatch.id;
          bookQty = Number(existingBatch.stock || 0);
        } else if (applyAdjustments && countedQty > 0) {
          const newB = await tx.dbRun(
            'INSERT INTO inventory_batches (product_id, variant_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price) VALUES (?, ?, 0, 0, 0)',
            [productId, variantId]
          );
          batchId = newB.lastID;
          bookQty = 0;
        }
      }

      await tx.dbRun(
        `
        INSERT INTO stocktake_items (
          stocktake_id, product_id, variant_id, batch_id, book_qty, counted_qty
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `,
        [stocktakeId, productId, variantId, batchId, bookQty, countedQty]
      );

      // تطبيق التسوية المخزنية على الدفعة إذا تغيرت الكمية المعدودة عن الكمية الدفترية
      if (applyAdjustments && batchId && hasCounted && Math.abs(countedQty - bookQty) > 0.0001) {
        await tx.dbRun('UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = ? WHERE id = ?', [countedQty, batchId]);
      }
    }

    return await getStocktake(ctx, stocktakeId);
  });
}

module.exports = {
  loadSheet,
  getStocktakeSheet: loadSheet,
  listStocktakes,
  getStocktakes: listStocktakes,
  getStocktake,
  createStocktake
};
```

```javascript
/**
 * stocktake/stocktake-ui.js
 * محرك واجهة الجرد المخزني الفعلي (Physical Stocktake & Variance Reconciliation UI)
 */

'use strict';

(function () {
  let currentSheetRows = [];
  let historyList = [];

  async function renderStocktakeView(filters = {}) {
    const container = document.getElementById('stocktake-view-root');
    if (!container || !window.api) return;

    const [sheet, stocktakes] = await Promise.all([
      window.api.getStocktakeSheet(filters).catch(() => []),
      window.api.getStocktakes({}).catch(() => [])
    ]);

    currentSheetRows = (Array.isArray(sheet) ? sheet : []).map((row) => ({
      ...row,
      counted_qty: row.book_qty
    }));
    historyList = Array.isArray(stocktakes) ? stocktakes : [];

    drawStocktakeInterface(container);
  }

  function drawStocktakeInterface(container) {
    container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="space-y-6">
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h2 class="text-2xl font-black">الجرد المخزني الفعلي (Physical Stocktake)</h2>
            <p class="text-xs text-slate-500">مقارنة الرصيد الدفتري بالرصيد الفعلي المعدود وتسوية الفروقات آلياً</p>
          </div>
          <div class="flex gap-2">
            <button onclick="window.StocktakeUI.printBlankSheet()"
              class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">print</span>
              <span>طباعة ورقة الجرد</span>
            </button>
            <button onclick="window.StocktakeUI.commitStocktake()"
              class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/20">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">Fact_Check</span>
              <span>اعتماد الجرد وتسوية الأرصدة</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- جدول إدخال الجرد الحي -->
        <div class="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4">
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <h3 class="font-black text-base">ورقة العد المباشر (${currentSheetRows.length} دفعة/منتج)</h3>
            <input id="stocktakeNoteInput" type="text" placeholder="ملاحظة على جلسة الجرد (اختياري)..."
              class="w-72 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs">
          </div>

          <div class="overflow-x-auto max-h-[460px]">
            <table class="w-full text-xs text-right">
              <thead class="sticky top-0 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900">
                <tr class="text-slate-500">
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">المنتج</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الباركود</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الفئة</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الرصيد الدفتري</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الكمية المعدودة فعلياً</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الفارق</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700/50">
                ${
                  currentSheetRows.length === 0
                    ? '<tr><td colspan="6" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">لا توجد منتجات للجرد</td></tr>'
                    : currentSheetRows
                        .map((r, idx) => {
                          const diff = Number((Number(r.counted_qty ?? r.book_qty) - Number(r.book_qty || 0)).toFixed(3));
                          const diffClass =
                            diff > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 font-bold' : diff < 0 ? 'text-rose-500 font-bold' : 'text-slate-400';
                          return `
                            <tr>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3 font-bold">${r.product_name}</td>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3 font-mono text-slate-500">${r.barcode || '-'}</td>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3">${r.category || 'عام'}</td>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3 font-mono font-bold">${r.book_qty} ${r.unit || ''}</td>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3">
                                <input type="number" step="any" value="${r.counted_qty}"
                                  oninput="window.StocktakeUI.updateCountedQty(${idx}, this.value)"
                                  class="w-28 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono text-center font-bold">
                              </td>
                              <td id="stk-diff-${idx}" class="py-2 px-3 font-mono ${diffClass}">
                                ${diff > 0 ? '+' + diff : diff}
                              </td>
                            </tr>`;
                        })
                        .join('')
                }
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- سجل عمليات الجرد السابقة -->
        <div class="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-3">
          <h3 class="font-black text-sm">سجل عمليات الجرد السابقة (${historyList.length})</h3>
          <div class="overflow-x-auto">
            <table class="w-full text-xs text-right">
              <thead>
                <tr class="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-500">
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">رقم الجرد</th>
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">التاريخ</th>
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">عدد العناصر</th>
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">الفروقات المسجلة</th>
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">ملاحظة</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700/50">
                ${historyList
                  .map(
                    (st) => `
                  <tr>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2 font-mono font-bold">${st.number || '#' + st.id}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2 font-mono">${String(st.closed_at || st.created_at || '').slice(0, 16)}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2">${st.items_count || 0}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2 font-bold text-amber-500">${st.discrepancies_count || 0}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2 text-slate-500">${st.note || '-'}</td>
                  </tr>`
                  )
                  .join('')}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function updateCountedQty(index, rawValue) {
    if (!currentSheetRows[index]) return;
    const val = parseFloat(rawValue);
    currentSheetRows[index].counted_qty = Number.isFinite(val) ? val : currentSheetRows[index].book_qty;
    const diff = Number(
      (Number(currentSheetRows[index].counted_qty) - Number(currentSheetRows[index].book_qty || 0)).toFixed(3)
    );
    const cell = document.getElementById(`stk-diff-${index}`);
    if (cell) {
      cell.textContent = diff > 0 ? `+${diff}` : String(diff);
      cell.className = `py-2 px-3 font-mono ${
        diff > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 font-bold' : diff < 0 ? 'text-rose-500 font-bold' : 'text-slate-400'
      }`;
    }
  }

  async function commitStocktake() {
    if (currentSheetRows.length === 0) return;
    if (!confirm('سيتم اعتماد الكميات المعدودة وتحديث أرصدة المخزون فعلياً. هل أنت متأكد؟')) return;

    const noteEl = document.getElementById('stocktakeNoteInput');
    const note = noteEl ? noteEl.value.trim() : '';

    try {
      await window.api.createStocktake({
        scope_type: 'all',
        note,
        applyAdjustments: true,
        items: currentSheetRows
      });
      await renderStocktakeView();
      if (window.showToast) window.showToast('تم اعتماد الجرد وتحديث الأرصدة بنجاح', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'حدث خطأ أثناء حفظ الجرد');
    }
  }

  function printBlankSheet() {
    const rowsHtml = currentSheetRows
      .map(
        (r, i) => `
        <tr>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;text-align:center;">${i + 1}</td>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;">${r.product_name}</td>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;text-align:center;">${r.barcode || ''}</td>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;text-align:center;">${r.book_qty}</td>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;"></td>
        </tr>`
      )
      .join('');

    const html = `
      <!DOCTYPE html>
      <html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
      <head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>ورقة جرد المخزون</title></head>
      <body style="font-family:Cairo,Arial,sans-serif;padding:20px;">
        <h2 style="text-align:center;">ورقة الجرد المخزني — Gherbi.Ai POS</h2>
        <p style="text-align:center;font-size:12px;">التاريخ: ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}</p>
        <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;">
          <thead>
            <tr style="background:#f1f5f9;">
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">#</th>
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">المنتج</th>
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">الباركود</th>
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">الرصيد الدفتري</th>
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;width:120px;">الكمية المعدودة</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
        </table>
      </body>
      </html>`;

    if (window.PrintEngine) {
      window.PrintEngine.printHtmlDocument(html, { silent: false });
    }
  }

  window.StocktakeUI = {
    renderStocktakeView,
    updateCountedQty,
    commitStocktake,
    printBlankSheet
  };
})();
```

```javascript
(function () {

    ? window.TemplatePresets.getPreset('modern_a4')

  let savedTemplates = [];

  const sampleDocData = {
    doc_number: 'FAC-2026-0105',

                onchange="window.TemplateBuilder.updateProp('showSignature', this.checked)">
              <span>إظهار خانة الختم والإمضاء</span>

              oninput="window.TemplateBuilder.updateProp('footerNote', this.value)"
              class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs">

            <div class="text-xs font-bold mb-2">القوالب المحفوظة (${savedTemplates.length})</div>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">

                  (t) => `
                <button onclick="window.TemplateBuilder.loadSaved(${t.id})"
                  class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-blue-50">

                .join('')}

          <iframe id="td-preview-frame" class="w-full h-[520px] border border-slate-200 rounded-xl bg-white"></iframe>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    refreshPreview();
  }

  function updateProp(key, val) {
    currentLayout[key] = val;
    refreshPreview();
  }

  function refreshPreview() {
    const frame = document.getElementById('td-preview-frame');
    if (!frame || !window.TemplateRenderer) return;
    const settings = (window.AppState && window.AppState.settings) || {};
    const html = window.TemplateRenderer.renderCustomTemplateHtml(currentLayout, sampleDocData, settings);
    const doc = frame.contentWindow.document;
    doc.open();
    doc.write(html);
    doc.close();
  }

  async function saveCurrent() {
    if (!window.api || !window.api.saveCustomTemplate) return;
    await window.api.saveCustomTemplate({
      id: currentLayout.id || undefined,
      name: currentLayout.name || 'قالب مخصص',
      doc_type: currentLayout.doc_type || 'invoice',
      paper: currentLayout.paper || 'a4',
      lang: currentLayout.lang || 'ar',
      layout_json: JSON.stringify(currentLayout),
      is_default: 1
    });
    if (window.showToast) window.showToast('تم حفظ القالب المخصص بنجاح', 'success');
    await initTemplateBuilder();
  }

  async function loadSaved(id) {
    const found = savedTemplates.find((x) => Number(x.id) === Number(id));
    if (!found) return;
    try {
      currentLayout = { ...JSON.parse(found.layout_json || '{}'), id: found.id, name: found.name };
      await initTemplateBuilder();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  window.TemplateBuilder = {
    initTemplateBuilder,
    updateProp,
    refreshPreview,
    saveCurrent,
    loadSaved
  };
})();
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\template-designer\template-renderer.js`

```javascript
/**
 * template-designer/template-renderer.js
 * محرك تحويل مخطط القالب المخصص (JSON Layout) إلى مستند HTML جاهز للطباعة
 */

'use strict';

(function () {
  function renderCustomTemplateHtml(layout = {}, docData = {}, settings = {}) {
    const lang = layout.lang || 'ar';
    const dir = lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
    const accent = layout.accentColor || '#1d4ed8';
    const cols = layout.columns || {};
    const items = Array.isArray(docData.items) ? docData.items : [];

    const subtotal = Number(docData.subtotal ?? docData.total ?? 0);
    const discount = Number(docData.discount || 0);
    const total = Number(docData.total ?? (subtotal - discount));
    const paid = Number(docData.paid_amount ?? total);
    const rest = Math.max(0, Number((total - paid).toFixed(2)));
    const oldDebt = Number(docData.old_balance || 0);

    const words =
      window.NumberToWords && typeof window.NumberToWords.toWords === 'function'
        ? window.NumberToWords.toWords(total, lang)
        : `${total.toFixed(2)} DZD`;

    const headersHtml = `
      ${cols.index !== false ? '<th>#</th>' : ''}
      ${cols.barcode ? '<th>المرجع</th>' : ''}
      <th>البيان / المنتج</th>
      ${cols.qty !== false ? '<th>الكمية</th>' : ''}
      ${cols.unit ? '<th>الوحدة</th>' : ''}
      ${cols.unitPrice !== false ? '<th>سعر الوحدة</th>' : ''}
      ${cols.tva ? '<th>TVA</th>' : ''}
      <th>المجموع</th>
    `;

    const rowsHtml = items
      .map(
        (it, i) => `
      <tr>
        ${cols.index !== false ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${i + 1}</td>` : ''}
        ${cols.barcode ? `<td>${it.barcode || it.product_barcode || '-'}</td>` : ''}
        <td style="font-weight:700;">${it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || it.name || 'منتج'}</td>
        ${cols.qty !== false ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${it.quantity || 1}</td>` : ''}
        ${cols.unit ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${it.unit || 'قطعة'}</td>` : ''}
        ${cols.unitPrice !== false ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${Number(it.price || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>` : ''}
        ${cols.tva ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${Number(docData.tax_percentage || 0)}%</td>` : ''}
        <td style="text-align:center;font-weight:700;">${Number(it.subtotal || (it.quantity || 1) * (it.price || 0)).toFixed(2)}</td>
      </tr>`
      )
      .join('');

    return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="${lang}" dir="${dir}">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <style>
    body { font-family: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', sans-serif; font-size: ${layout.fontSize || 12}px; color: #0f172a; margin: 0; padding: 20px; }
    .header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; border-bottom: 3px solid ${accent}; padding-bottom: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .shop-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; color: ${accent}; }
    .meta-box { background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    th { background: ${accent}; color: #fff; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid ${accent}; }
    td { padding: 7px 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; }
    .totals { width: 280px; margin-right: auto; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
    .totals-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
    .totals-row.grand { background: ${accent}; color: #fff; font-weight: 900; font-size: 14px; }
    .words-box { margin-top: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #f1f5f9; border-right: 4px solid ${accent}; font-weight: 700; }
    .footer { margin-top: 28px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; color: #475569; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="header">
    <div>
      <div class="shop-title">${settings.shop_name || 'Gherbi.Ai POS'}</div>
      <div>${settings.shop_description || ''}</div>
      <div>${settings.shop_address || ''} ${settings.shop_phone ? ' | ' + settings.shop_phone : ''}</div>
      ${
        layout.showFiscal
          ? `<div style="font-size:10px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;">RC: ${settings.shop_rc || '-'} | NIF: ${settings.shop_nif || '-'} | AI: ${settings.shop_ai || '-'} | NIS: ${settings.shop_nis || '-'}</div>`
          : ''
      }
    </div>
    <div style="text-align:left;">
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:${accent};">فاتورة رقم: ${docData.doc_number || 'FAC-2026-0001'}</div>
      <div>التاريخ: ${String(docData.sale_date || new Date().toISOString()).slice(0, 10)}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="meta-box">
    <div>
      <strong>الزبون:</strong> ${docData.customer_name || 'زبون عابر'}
      ${docData.customer_phone ? ` | <strong>الهاتف:</strong> ${docData.customer_phone}` : ''}
    </div>
    <div><strong>طريقة الدفع:</strong> ${docData.payment_method || 'نقداً'}</div>
  </div>

  <table>
    <thead><tr>${headersHtml}</tr></thead>
    <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
  </table>

  <div class="totals">
    <div class="totals-row"><span>المجموع الفرعي:</span><span>${subtotal.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>
    ${discount > 0 ? `<div class="totals-row"><span>التخفيض:</span><span>${discount.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>` : ''}
    <div class="totals-row grand"><span>الصافي للدفع:</span><span>${total.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>
    <div class="totals-row"><span>المدفوع:</span><span>${paid.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>
    ${rest > 0 ? `<div class="totals-row"><span>الباقي من الفاتورة:</span><span>${rest.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>` : ''}
    ${layout.showOldDebt && oldDebt > 0 ? `<div class="totals-row"><span>الدين السابق:</span><span>${oldDebt.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>` : ''}
  </div>

  ${layout.showAmountInWords ? `<div class="words-box">أوقفت هذه الفاتورة على مبلغ: ${words}</div>` : ''}

  <div class="footer">
    <div>${layout.footerNote || ''}</div>
    ${layout.showSignature ? '<div style="font-weight:700;">الختم والإمضاء</div>' : ''}
  </div>
</body>
</html>`;
  }

  window.TemplateRenderer = {
    renderCustomTemplateHtml
  };
})();
```
